title: BMW Technician
description:
As an Automotive Technician at Scharmach Automotive Group, you will diagnose, repair, and maintain vehicles to ensure they operate safely and efficiently. You will work closely with the service team to provide excellent customer service by delivering high-quality repairs and maintenance in a timely manner.

Pay: $50,000.00-$175,000.00 per year

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose mechanical and electrical issues in vehicles using diagnostic tools and software.

  • Adhere to department processes for video electronic Multipoint Inspections.

  • Perform routine maintenance services, such as oil changes, brake replacements, tire rotations, and fluid flushes.

  • Repair or replace parts, such as engines, transmissions, and suspension components, according to manufacturer specifications.

  • Document all services performed, including diagnostic findings, repairs completed, and parts used.

  • Adhere to all safety protocols and environmental standards in the workplace.

  • Stay updated on technical training and certifications for various vehicle makes and models.

  • Communicate clearly and effectively with service advisors and customers about vehicle issues, repair timelines, and costs.

title: Web Application Security Engineers APAC
description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer Group Ltd. acts in the sector Private Banking and is present in over 25 countries and around 60 locations. With the Headquartered in Zurich, we have offices in key locations including Bangkok, Dubai, Dublin, Frankfurt, Geneva, Hong Kong, London, Luxembourg, Madrid, Mexico City, Milan, Monaco, Mumbai, Santiago de Chile, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, Tel Aviv and Tokyo.

Join our global team and play a critical role in safeguarding our digital landscape as a Web Application Security Engineer. We're seeking a skilled expert to maintain and enhance the protection of our online platforms, ensuring the highest level of security for our clients worldwide.

YOUR CHALLENGE

KEY FEATURES OF THE POSITION

Main Job Responsibilities

  • Work closely with our global team of engineers to ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) infrastructure
  • Enhance the security of web applications and APIs by implementing advanced protective measures on the WAF and configuring custom application-specific security policies
  • Onboard new web applications and APIs onto the WAF infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and optimal security
  • Evaluate new or changed business requirements and assess their feasibility, as well as their impact on surrounding systems, standards, and guidelines
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to WAF, identifying root causes and developing effective solutions
  • Participate in the 2nd and 3rd level support organization, providing on-duty support and collaborating with other teams to resolve incidents
  • Continuously improve the service reliability, security, performance, monitoring, and automation of the WAF infrastructure, with a focus on enhancing overall system availability and efficiency

Client Management (internal & external)

  • Various IT functions, both regionally and globally
  • Local Legal and Compliance functions

Business Management

  • Key local stakeholders include IT Service Owners, IT Infrastructure, IT Application Managers, IT Architecture and Project Managers
  • CRO functions – including Business Operational Risk, Information Security and Compliance functions
  • Global functions – IT Security Solutions, Security Architecture
  • Establish strong relationship with key stakeholders and across the internal IT

Regulatory Responsibilities &/OR Risk Management

  • Ensure appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour within the area of responsibility by clear demonstration of appropriate values and behaviours including but not limited to standards on honesty and integrity, due care and diligence, fair dealing (treating customers fairly), management of conflicts of interest, competence and continuous development, adequate risk management, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations

YOUR PROFILE

SKILLS REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION

Professional and Technical

  • Profound understanding of security best practices of web applications and APIs
  • Solid understanding of web communication protocols such as HTTP, TLS, Websocket, etc.
  • Hands-on operational experience with highly available and scalable web infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with operating WAF or reverse-proxy solutions such as F5, Imperva, Nevis, Cloudflare, or open-source alternatives like ModSecurity
  • Experience in software engineering (Java, Spring Boot, React, Typescript) and operational experience with Kubernetes-based environments
  • Strong troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills
  • Skilled in log analytics and correlation, with hands-on experience in Splunk, Elastic or similar toolings, to investigate incidents and identify root causes
  • Familiarity with the implementation of authentication and federation mechanisms such as SAML, OAuth and OIDC and FIDO
  • Good technical foundation of Linux operating systems and its command line tools
  • Relevant academic background (e.g., Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field) or industry-recognized certifications (e.g. CISSP) with relevant practical knowledge is desired

Personal and Social

  • Team player, strong collaborator with the willingness to take ownership
  • Excellent communication skills in spoken and written form
  • Strong desire to learn and develop new skills
  • Methodical and results-driven approach to new challenges and tasks
  • Independent and self-driven
  • Ability to thrive in a globally distributed team environment

Regulatory

  • Good understanding of the technology regulatory framework in Singapore and Hong Kong

title: Sr. Application Developer
description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of RichmondWhen you join the Federal Reserve—the nation's central bank—you’ll play a key role, collaborating with leading tech professionals to strengthen and protect our economic, financial and payments systems. We invest in contemporary and emerging technology each year to support the Federal Reserve and our economy, and we’re building a dynamic and diverse team for our future.

The Federal Reserve Financial Services portfolio provides technology capabilities that power the U.S. payment systems infrastructure. This portfolio enables critical payment services that are foundational to the nation's financial system, focusing on delivering speed, resilience, and choice to meet evolving marketplace needs.

Join a high-impact modernization initiative supporting Federal Reserve System applications. As a Senior Application Developer, you will help modernize and migrate mission-critical enterprise systems to AWS while delivering secure, scalable solutions across the Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and PostgreSQL stack. This role is designed for an experienced engineer who can work independently, make sound technical decisions, collaborate across disciplines, and contribute quickly in a highly regulated environment.

What You’ll Deliver

  • Modernize and migrate enterprise applications and databases to AWS with an emphasis on reliability, security, and operational continuity.
  • Deliver production-ready Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs, and Angular/TypeScript user experiences.
  • Improve deployment consistency through automated CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, security scanning, and observability.
  • Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and production issues through structured analysis and testing.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Translate complex business and technical requirements into secure, maintainable application designs and delivery plans.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and document enhancements to large-scale, mission-critical systems.
  • Recommend architecture and implementation approaches, identify technical risks, and make pragmatic trade-offs within organizational standards.
  • Build and integrate Java/Spring Boot services, REST APIs, Angular/TypeScript interfaces, and database solutions.
  • Plan and execute cloud and database migration activities, including validation, cutover, rollback, and operational-readiness considerations.
  • Conduct performance, load, and stress testing when needed to validate scalability and service-level expectations.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for complex defects and production issues, coordinating timely resolution with engineering, cloud, security, and operations teams.
  • Review code and technical designs, share best practices, and provide guidance to other contributors.
  • Create clear architecture, implementation, deployment, support, and decision documentation.

Requirements:

  • Enterprise delivery: Demonstrated experience delivering and supporting complex, mission-critical applications, including cloud adoption, modernization, or migration initiatives in regulated or similarly high-reliability environments.
  • Backend development: Typically requires 5 or more years of hands-on experience with Java and enterprise frameworks such as Spring Boot, Spring, and Hibernate.
  • Front-end development: Experience building enterprise applications with Angular and TypeScript. Node.js experience is valuable where used for supporting services or development tooling.
  • API engineering: Extensive experience designing, developing, securing, documenting, and integrating RESTful services; Spring REST experience is preferred.
  • Cloud architecture and migration: Strong hands-on AWS experience across:
    • Compute and containers (ECS, ECR)
    • Networking and routing (ALB, Route 53)
    • Storage and databases (S3, RDS, DMS)
    • Security and configuration (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, SSM, Config),
    • Observability and logging (CloudWatch)
    • Integration services (Lambda, SNS, SQS).
  • Data platforms: Experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL, including PL/SQL development, data modeling, query tuning, and database migration. Experience with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL is required.
  • Infrastructure and containers: Hands-on experience implementing infrastructure as code with Terraform and deploying containerized workloads with Docker and Kubernetes or comparable AWS container services.
  • DevSecOps: Experience building or supporting automated delivery pipelines using tools such as Maven, Jenkins, GitLab, Nexus, Fortify, SonarQube, and Nexus IQ, including automated testing and security or quality gates.
  • Engineering practices: Strong knowledge of software design patterns, secure coding, automated testing, code review, observability, and agile delivery practices.
  • Communication and leadership: Ability to explain technical decisions clearly, produce high-quality documentation, collaborate with business and technical stakeholders, and guide other contributors.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, development tools, and responsible enterprise use cases.
  • Extensive experience on SAFe or Scrum Teams.
  • AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Certified Developer – Associate.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications into cloud-native or microservices-based architectures.
  • Experience supporting systems with demanding availability, auditability, security, or disaster-recovery requirements.

Locations:

The selected candidate will reside within a reasonable commuting distance, as defined by the employing Reserve Bank, and will work full-time onsite.

  • Eligible Locations for Hire: Richmond, VA and San Francisco, CA
  • The following Reserve Bank locations are preferred due to the concentration of System IT team members in these locations: San Francisco & Richmond

Base Salary Range: Min: $120,000 Mid: $155,800 Max: $191,700 (Location: San Francisco)

  • The listed salary is applicable to 12th District/San Francisco. Final offers are determined by factors including the candidate’s qualifications, internal alignment considerations, district assignment, and geographic location.

Screening:

Due to the nature of access to sensitive information all final offers are subject to the clearance of an enhanced background check. This enhanced screening will require the following items: academic and employment verifications, FBI fingerprint check (criminal and civil cases), credit check, family history, residential records and foreign travel for the previous 7 years, citizenship verification, reference checks, and personal interview with an investigator and can take between 21 – 60 days to clear.


Sponsorship:

Individuals who need immigration sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for this position.

Must be a U.S Citizen or a Green card holder with intent to become a U.S Citizen.

We offer a wonderful benefits package including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Pre-tax Flexible Spending Account, Backup Child Care Program, Pre-Tax Day Care Flexible Spending Account, Paid Family Care Leave, Vacation Days, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, Pet Insurance, Matching 401(k), and Retirement/Pension.

The Bank is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. The SF Fed is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at sf.hr.recruitment@sf.frb.org.

title: Personal Health Assistant
description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. We pride ourselves on our best-in-class employees and strive to maintain an innovative and inclusive environment that allows them to thrive. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The Personal Health Assistant - Community-Based (PHA) supports members through an integrated approach that combines care coordination and community outreach. The PHA is responsible for helping members navigate and access physician services, healthcare services, community services, and other resources, as well as answer or address benefit and health plan questions, to assist the member in maintaining and/or achieving healthcare treatment and healthcare status goals.

What You'll Do

  • Possess solid knowledge base for community resources and services to provide referrals to members for local services/community agencies as appropriate.
  • Exhibit excellent working relations with members and staff, effectively communicating goals and objectives of PHA services program.
  • Assist member, and if needed, serve as a liaison between the member and community service organizations.
  • Identify members who may need clinical triage, assessment and intervention, and immediately notify the clinical team member for guidance and next steps.
  • Resolve problems including, but not limited to billing, claims and benefit issues and assisting patients with resolution within various departments within the organization.
  • Identify providers and physicians to meet the needs of the assigned member to fit their specific needs for treatment.
  • Refer and assist members with appointment scheduling for services, providers and facilities for needed healthcare appointments, services and appointment reminders.
  • Accountable for maintaining members treatment and healthcare goals by identifying challenges to members ability to access healthcare services.
  • Contact, engage and communicate with assigned members.
  • Proactively refer members to Case Management, Chronic Care Program or other Horizon programs that they would benefit from.

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required.
  • Requires a minimum of 1 year experience in customer service in healthcare industry.
  • Prefer 2 years' experience in a Managed Care company.
  • Prefer 2 years' experience in medical billing and claims coding/processing.

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Requires a valid driver's license and access to transportation/vehicle.

Knowledge:

  • Understanding of the community served and community connectivity required.
  • Medical terminology knowledge required.
  • Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and supporting software in a Windows based environment, including MS Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook, Lync, and PowerPoint).
  • Should be knowledgeable in the use of intranet and internet applications.

Skills and Abilities:

  • Requires good communication skills, such as listening well, strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to explain healthcare terminology i.e., co-pays, primary care physician, patient-centered care, etc., (not clinical terminology), to a lay audience.
  • Requires ability to use a personal computer and applicable software and systems.
  • Requires ability to make sound decisions under the direction of Supervisor.
  • Requires strong analytical and interpersonal skills.
  • Prefers experience working in a customer service, healthcare setting, or community-based setting.
  • Prefers the ability to analyze and resolve problems with minimal supervision.

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Salary Range:

$56,200 - $75,285

​This compensation range is specific to the job level and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Horizon also provides a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes:

  • Comprehensive health benefits (Medical/Dental/Vision)

  • Retirement Plans

  • Generous PTO

  • Incentive Plans

  • Wellness Programs

  • Paid Volunteer Time Off

  • Tuition Reimbursement

Horizon BCBSNJ employees must live in New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Connecticut or Delaware. This job summary has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by colleagues within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of colleagues assigned to this job.

title: Connections Specialist
description:
About the team

Buying, selling and financing homes is a complicated process with uncertain timelines. The Connections team is passionate about changing that. We interact and support movers to improve their experience, tailoring our approach to meet each customer where they are at in the process. Our team is responsible for delivering an outstanding consumer experience and tapping into our expertise to get every customer moving in unlocking their next chapter. We are central to the B2C mission of integrating offerings across the Zillow platform, making it easier for customers to buy and sell their homes.

About the role

Are you a high-energy team-player with excellent organization and interpersonal skills? Are you motivated to achieve and exceed monthly targets on a consistent basis while providing outstanding service? The Connections Specialist is a highly sociable individual who plays an instrumental role in revolutionizing the way consumers connect with Zillow products and Real Estate professionals. You will be engaged in our dynamic environment and expected to live Zillow Group’s Core Values. If you are ready to work hard, learn, and be challenged to grow and improve- we look forward to talking with you soon.


Responsibilities

  • Interact directly with customers to discover their needs and offer solutions using Zillow’s products and services
  • Get customers connected to the right Zillow products and professionals through an understanding of real estate and a dedication to crafting an outstanding customer experience
  • Collaborate with peers and leadership to build an environment rooted in trust, self-discipline, and friendly competition to achieve goals together
  • Drive accountability for yourself and your team through proactive engagement with your peers and active involvement in team discussions and initiatives
  • Ensure compliance to Zillow Group and real estate norms, policies, and regulations to the highest degree
  • Respond to changes in the business with agility and skill at navigating ambiguity

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $16.30 - $24.50 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $15.50 - $23.30 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Confident working in a high energy, customer facing, demand generation workflow
  • Strong communication skills through email, phone, text, and personal interaction
  • Ability to thrive in a team environment, excited to share new insights to help the team grow and succeed
  • Internally motivated to achieve results, and you pride yourself on continuous improvement in your work
  • Believe in the principle that crafting strong rapport with customers and colleagues alike is essential to long-term success
  • Understand that process matters, and follow SOPs to ensure consistency in the customer experience
  • Familiarity with real estate industry a plus

Required Experience:

  • 2+ years experience in account management, customer service, demand generation or an inbound/outbound sales role with a proven track record of goal achievement and the ability to deliver an excellent customer experience
  • Quick and flexible learner, willing and able to adapt rapidly to change
  • Must be comfortable conducting both inbound and outbound consultative sales calls; skilled in discovery, handling initial reluctance, and objection handling.
  • Ability to storytell - to be engaging and authentic with customers and drive trust in Zillow products
  • Must possess great interpersonal skills; knowing how to actively listen and use objections as a space to ask more questions
  • Must possess excellent presentation skills, providing recommendations to customers that meet their needs
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a technical ability to listen and hear opportunities that lead to success for our customers
  • Willing to work flexible schedules that include early mornings, late nights, weekends and holidays
  • Must have experience with web-based products, MS Office and Google Suite

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

title: Financial Assistant
description:
Overview

As the Program Financial Assistant, you will assist the Program Director with managing and maintaining financial records for the LifeWise program.

Job Responsibilities Overview

  • Prepare and maintain an annual budget
  • Log donations and manage records online in The LIST
  • Monitor "declined" donations on The LIST and contact those who had declined donations
  • Send thank-you notes and log sent date in The LIST
  • Oversee payment requests submitted on behalf of the program and respond promptly with any adjustments needed to the request
  • Oversee and approve program expense card purchases as the Expense Admin, ensuring the appropriate fund and budget line was selected for each transaction
  • Review monthly financial reports for accuracy and alignment with the program budget
  • Attend regular board meetings and give a financial update based on an assessment of the program's most recent financial report in relation to the planned budget
  • Use Google Workspace apps such as Gmail, Drive, Meet, Calendar, Sheets and Docs
  • Use a variety of websites keeping records and logging hours worked
  • Lead the processes for collection and record-keeping of donations for fundraising events

Qualifications and Experience

  • A mature personal Christian faith in agreement with the "What We Believe" section of the LifeWise Academy Statement of Faith

title: Warranty Representative
description:
For more than 50 years, Cannondale has been a leading innovator in the cycling world. As more riders of all ages and abilities get on the roads, trails, and streets than ever before, we're here to do the best work of our lives to push the greatest human-powered machine into the future each and every day. The Warranty Representative manages end-to-end warranty claims, providing high-touch technical customer service and warranty evaluations to support our riders, retailers, and key partners.   • Tech and research savvy.

title: Senior Product Designer
location: Office West Palm FL PSP - West Palm Beach, FL 33401
description:
Help firms get paid faster, right inside the software they already use

Getting paid is one of the most important parts of running a practice, and for too many law and accounting firms it is still manual, slow work. ProfitSolv's Payments and Embedded Finance team is building one platform that helps firms get paid faster and manage their money as part of running their practice, right inside the software they use every day, from small practices to midmarket and large firms. AI is reshaping how firms get paid, turning time-consuming work into smarter workflows that anticipate what firms need. We're building toward that future, so firms can spend less time chasing payments and more time serving their clients.

We're a company of builders and problem-solvers, around 300 people who care about the craft, back each other up, and celebrate the wins together. If you want your work to be visible, valued, and genuinely fun, you'll fit right in.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to help define what that future looks like, and to grow with us.

The role

As our Senior Product Designer, you'll own design for payments and embedded finance across ProfitSolv's portfolio of legal and accounting software, helping firms get paid, manage their money, and run their business. We're looking for a strong product mindset, not just UI skills. You'll partner closely with PM and engineering to deeply understand customer problems and shape the best experience for them, then stay hands-on to get it built well. Money movement is complex and high-trust, so you'll help shape the product vision and roadmap while getting the details right with engineers, and you'll help define what AI-powered payments should mean for our customers.

  • Find and frame the right problems by talking to customers, digging into data, and mapping their journeys to understand what's really getting in the way and why it matters to them and to the business
  • Shape the vision and roadmap with PM, bringing evidence-based ideas to the table, challenging assumptions, and helping decide what we build next and why
  • Turn big, ambiguous problems into clear direction, prototyping and testing early with customers to learn what works before we commit to building it, from quick wins to bigger bets
  • Design end to end and stay close to engineering, working through states, edge cases, and constraints with engineers from early on so what ships is clear, reliable, and trustworthy
  • Measure what matters by defining success with PM and tracking it after launch, connecting user experience to outcomes like adoption, payment volume, and retention

What makes you a great fit

  • 5+ years in product design for B2B or SaaS products, with real ownership of a complex area
  • Experience designing payments, billing, banking, or other money-movement products
  • A strong product mindset: you start from the customer problem, can explain why it matters to the business, and know how to measure success
  • Comfort leading your own discovery, from customer conversations and journey mapping to working with data
  • A track record of influencing product direction, not just executing on requirements
  • Hands-on collaboration with engineers, including thinking through technical constraints, edge cases, and failure states
  • Clear, concise communication, in writing and in the room

Bonus points if you bring

  • 0-to-1 or complex project experience, especially where you filled gaps beyond design
  • Experience with Stripe or similar payment platforms
  • Familiarity with legal or accounting software, such as trust accounting, client billing, or books close
  • Experience designing AI-powered workflows, especially where users need to trust and approve what the AI does
  • Comfort using AI tools or code to prototype and explore ideas quickly

What we offer

  • Performance-based compensation, so your results are recognized and rewarded
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, including HSA and FSA options
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays
  • Fully remote work, U.S. based.
  • A collaborative, high-trust team of smart, curious, hardworking people

About ProfitSolv

ProfitSolv is the SaaS company behind the tools that thousands of law firms, accounting practices, and healthcare providers rely on every day: billing, payments, and practice management software that helps professionals get paid faster and run smarter businesses. We're growing quickly, and we've built a culture to match: smart and curious people, real ownership of your work, leadership that listens, and wins that get celebrated properly. We're fully remote across the U.S., seriously invested in our people, and just getting started.

Physical requirements

This role involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, the ability to lift up to 15 pounds at times, and travel as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Our commitment to you

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We embrace a diverse group of backgrounds and experiences to connect with clients, solve problems, and innovate.

title: Assistant Managing Editor, National
description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest.

Applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis. While the anticipated application deadline is December 31st at 11:59 PM ET, the role may close earlier if a candidate is hired. We encourage interested applicants to apply as soon as possible.

ProPublica is seeking an accomplished senior-level investigative editor to help oversee and elevate the accountability journalism produced by editors and reporters on our national staff and serve as part of ProPublica’s masthead leadership team.

The assistant managing editor, national, will supervise teams of editors and reporters and, depending on the candidate, may also directly supervise one or more investigative reporters. The ideal candidate enjoys the challenge of helping editors and reporters envision the most ambitious and creative paths for their projects; deeply understands and embraces ProPublica’s accountability mission; has a facility for high-level story honing and writing; and is dedicated to helping our editors grow and develop. We’re looking for an experienced editor with sound news judgment who is equally comfortable and adept weighing in on what’s working, or not, in a long-form narrative as in a complicated, multipart investigation.

This position involves juggling a variety of high-level projects, weighing in on story selection and direction, providing top-level guidance and editing, as well as working with staffers from other ProPublica teams, from data and research to video and audience.

The assistant managing editor, national, will report to the managing editor of the national staff.

What you would be doing:

  • Supervising teams of national reporters and editors working on revelatory, important stories and projects.
  • Providing support and guidance to ensure projects are conceived of and told as ambitiously and creatively as possible.
  • Working with editors and reporters to select stories with the potential for impact, and helping them overcome reporting hurdles
  • Editing, including identifying and fixing structural issues and elevating writing when necessary.
  • Helping teams collaborate with researchers, data visualization reporters, engagement reporters, audience and visual staffers, and story producers.
  • Coaching editors to stretch and develop their skills and ambitions.
  • Serving as a champion for accountability journalism.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • At least 10 years experience overseeing investigative and/or accountability reporting and has managed teams of reporters and editors.
  • A track record as an editor of landing revelatory stories about abuses of power.
  • A passion for and experience with accountability journalism.
  • The ability to juggle many different responsibilities, meet deadlines and handle pressure while remaining calm.
  • Exceptional organizational skills.
  • A collaborative mindset. As a leader, you should work seamlessly with staffers throughout the newsroom.
  • The ability to adroitly handle fast-breaking stories, monthslong reporting projects and exquisitely written narratives.

This job is full time and includes benefits.

We’re open to remote candidates based and authorized to work in the United States. Candidates in the New York City region will be expected to work in our office at least two days a week. We also have offices in Washington, D.C.; Atlanta; Chicago; Phoenix; and Berkeley, California. Though not currently in place, an in-person requirement could be introduced at these locations in the future.

The expected salary range for this position is $200,000 to $250,000.

This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The final salary figure will take into account a person’s experience, accomplishment and location. ProPublica is committed to paying its staff equitably, and these ranges should not be considered career salary limits or caps.

What you should send us:

  • The most important part by far is your past work. We’d like to see examples of projects that show how you work as both a direct editor and as a top editor. Specifically:
    • (1) Send us links to the investigative stories you directly edited that you are most proud of. These should be stories where you worked directly with a reporter to shape and guide the focus of an investigation. Don’t be shy — tell us what worked (numbers and evidence of impact welcome) and how you’d do it differently next time. Editing is about far more than moving around words. Show us how you think.
    • (2) Send us a project or story in which you made a significant difference as a top editor. This should be where you honed the structure or narrative or where you identified missing elements necessary before publication. Let us know how your contributions elevated the work.
  • Your resume.

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, but we will continue to consider candidates as long as the posting remains live on our site.

Questions? Send an email to talent@propublica.org.

No phone calls, please.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law. We are dedicated to building an inclusive newsroom and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Clinical Endoscopy Tech - Per diem
description:
Tufts Medicine is a leading integrated health system bringing together the best of academic and community health care to deliver exceptional, connected and accessible care experiences to consumers across Massachusetts. Comprised of Tufts Medical Center, Lowell General Hospital, Melrose/Wakefield Healthcare, an expansive home care network and a large clinically integrated physician network, Tufts Medicine has more than 15,000 dedicated employees and caregivers.


Job Profile Summary

​This role focuses on providing medical and clinical support services to patients. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Surgical Services duties: Responsible for medical services involving the excision or incision of a patient's body, such as interventional pain management and other procedures. This position also works to provide a safe environment for patients undergoing invasive procedures or surgery. A clinical technologist role that has specialized knowledge or skills gained through a combination of vocational education, training, and experience. This role will be most commonly applied to patient care and/or scientific/laboratory jobs. An entry-level role typically requiring little to no prior knowledge or experience and requiring vocational or technical education. Work is routine or follows standard procedures, is closely supervised, and communicates information that requires little explanation or interpretation.


Job Overview

This position is responsible for assisting with endoscopic procedures under the supervision of a Registered Nurse. Also responsible for equipment and supply maintenance.


Job Description

Minimum Qualifications:

1. High School diploma or equivalent.


Preferred Qualifications:

1. One (1) year of operating room experience.


What We Offer

Competitive salaries & benefits that start on day one

403(b) retirement with company match

Tuition reimbursement

Free on-campus parking

Career growth opportunities

Guaranteed hours and set schedule ​


Location: Lowell General Hospital - 295 Varnum Avenue - Lowell, MA


Hours: Per diem, as needed. Typically, 7:30am-4pm or 8am-4:30pm. Every other weekend (Sat-Sun) and every other holiday is required.


Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.


1. Properly reprocess endoscopes according to Infection control and hospital guidelines.

2. Ensures equipment is in working order.

3. Keeps accurate documentation for cleaning/testing of equipment and supplies.

4. Cleans endoscopy procedure rooms after use and prepares for next procedure.

5. Operates and handles equipment properly during Endoscopic procedures.

6. Properly collects, handles, labels, and transports specimens according to policy.

7. Informs Clinical leader of any equipment problems.

8. Performs as an assistant during endoscopic procedures.

9. Escorts patients into the Procedure rooms and obtains baseline vital signs and connects patient to monitoring equipment.

10. Reports all unusual observations or reactions of the patient to the nurse assigned to the patient or charge nurse.

11. Adheres to all infection control policies and procedures including hand hygiene, isolation protocol, and cleaning of patient care devices and equipment.

12. Turns over procedure rooms in a timely manner.

13. Sets up daily procedure rooms with established Endoscopy protocols and physician preferences.

14. Circulates regularly throughout unit to assist nurses and physicians as needed in pre, intra and post procedure.

15. Under the review of the RN obtains pre-procedure data, including but not limited to; height, weight, allergies, NPO status, post-procedure ride contact and call back number.

16. Restocks Endoscopy rooms and checking and cleaning equipment on a daily basis.


Physical Requirements:

1. Occasional lifting of 30-35 lbs and turning patients.

2. Prolonged standing and walking. Occasional twisting, bending, reaching, pushing/pulling, sitting, kneeling, and squatting.

3. Exposure to infectious disease and possible carcinogenic chemicals. Exposure of bloodborne pathogens.

4. Manual Dexterity Requires manual dexterity using fine hand manipulations for assisting in endoscopic procedures and computer keyboard.

5. Audible/Visual Demands: Requires ability to see computer screen, reports, and perform assistance in endoscopic procedures with accuracy.

6. Ability to hear instructions from physician and nursing staff.


Skills & Abilities:

1. Demonstrates a detailed knowledge of the different types of scopes and their use.

2. Demonstrates and verbalizes knowledge of aseptic technique.

3. Good interpersonal and organizational skills.

4. Ability to work with detailed and confidential information.


About Lowell General
For more than 125 years, Lowell General has served the Greater Lowell community with pride. We balance the first-rate care of a premier medical center with the warmth of a four-time Magnet®-recognized community hospital. As a member of our team, you’ll join over 3,000 dedicated care providers to offer complete, connected care, when and where patients need it most.

Magnet Designation:
The American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) honored Lowell General Hospital with Magnet Recognition for excellence in nursing care, our fourth designation achieved in March 2025! The Magnet Recognition Program recognizes healthcare organizations dedicated to nursing excellence, professionalism, and patient-focused care. It is the highest level of recognition an organization can receive for providing the very best quality in patient care. Only nine percent of hospitals in the United States have achieved Magnet status and fewer than one percent of hospitals have achieved a fourth consecutive Magnet designation.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

title: Senior Product Manager – Platform & Data
description:
Own the platform underneath safetyOS™: the shared services and data every Securly product runs on.

Securly keeps students safe in 27,000+ schools, and our technology has helped save 2,400+ student lives. Nine products run on one platform. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager – Platform & Data to make it work as one system for every district.

THE ROLE

You'll own strategy and the roadmap across three layers:

  • Core platform services: SSO, SIS and rostering integrations through Sync, and data acquisition, with real availability and SLO accountability.
  • Data platform: you own the product requirements for our layered data pipeline, from raw district data to clean, trusted data every product uses. Our Data team owns how it's built.
  • Customer-facing data products: the data marts, APIs and reporting district leaders act on.

You'll work with our CTO, Engineering in the U.S. and Pune, the Data team, product leads for every product line, and Customer Success.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Set the strategy and roadmap across platform services, the data platform and data products.
  • Define and hold SLOs for SSO, SIS integrations and data acquisition.
  • Own SIS integrations and data acquisition so rostering data arrives reliably from every district.
  • Define what each pipeline layer delivers, from raw ingestion to curated data, and set data quality standards with the Data team.
  • Own shared metrics and data models, so terms like "active student" and "screen time" mean the same thing in every product.
  • Build in student data privacy: FERPA, COPPA and state privacy laws shape every data decision.
  • Ship data products districts use directly, from discovery to adoption.
  • Decide what's built once for the platform and what stays with each product.
  • Make onboarding one step: one setup, every product working together.
  • Stay close to customers: district IT directors and administrators shape your roadmap.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • 90 days: You've mapped our data flows, met key partners, and set SLO targets and a first roadmap.
  • 6 months: You run platform planning, and product teams build on your standards.
  • 12 months: You can show faster onboarding, higher uptime and cross-product reporting districts trust.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

  • 7+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a data platform product
  • Layered data architecture: raw data lands, gets cleaned and standardized, then becomes curated data ready for reporting. Medallion (bronze, silver, gold) is a plus; lakehouse, data warehouse or similar staged pipelines count too.
  • Data modeling and shared metric definitions across multiple products or data sources
  • Customer-facing data products: data marts, APIs or reporting
  • Shared runtime services with SLO accountability
  • Based in the U.S. and authorized to work without visa sponsorship

Strongly preferred

  • Student data privacy: FERPA, COPPA and state privacy laws, or comparable regulated data such as HIPAA
  • K-12 SIS and rostering: PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, Clever, ClassLink or OneRoster
  • Ingestion and sync from many external sources at scale
  • Identity and SSO: SAML, OIDC, Google and Microsoft sign-in

Nice to have

  • K-12 EdTech experience

WHO YOU ARE

  • You think in data flows and catch quality issues before customers do.
  • You lead through influence and make the teams around you better.
  • You're credible in both rooms: deep with data engineers, clear with executives.
  • You use AI daily and know where it helps.

WHY SECURLY

  • Top-tier medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO plus a paid year-end shutdown
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Free 24/7 confidential mental health counseling and wellness tools
  • $1,000 annual learning stipend
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching

Our people-first culture shows in the numbers: 82% employee engagement against a 73% global benchmark, and 94% of employees proud to work here (Securly Qualtrics Employee Survey, 2025; WSA Global Benchmark).

ABOUT SECURLY

Securly launched the first cloud-based K-12 web filter in 2013. Today safetyOS™ covers everything a district needs to keep students safe, secure and ready to learn:

  • Unified Experience: single sign-on, SIS integrations and self-deployment
  • Digital Safety: filtering that handles 20% of U.S. K-12 internet traffic
  • AI Governance: guardrails and visibility as students use AI
  • Student Wellness: 24/7 monitoring with human-verified alerts
  • Classroom Management: classroom, device and flex period management
  • Campus Movement: 2 million digital hall passes created every day
  • Family Engagement: visibility for parents into their child's digital life
  • Digital Insights: reporting on tech and AI use, screen time and circumvention

Every one of these runs on the platform this role owns.

Remote within the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas for this position. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse, inclusive workplace. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, email recruitment.us@securly.com.

description:
Who We Are

BH Management, LLC is a people-first multifamily owner and operator that grew from a small startup

into one of the nation's largest commercial real estate companies. Founded in 1993, BH is celebrated for its simple commitment to doing business the right way and investing in its team. Today, BH manages

over 100,000 units, employs over 2,800 people, owns its processes in-house, and is praised by Fortune

Magazine as the “Best Workplace for Women,” “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplaces

for Diversity.” Powered by innovation and a can-do attitude, BH improves daily, striving to construct a

smarter way to live, invest, manage, and grow.

BH is passionate about setting the standard in the multifamily industry. We are a welcoming band of go-

getters who think big, sweat the details, and take our work (but never ourselves) too seriously. We set

our sights high, own our mistakes, and turn lemons into lemonade. We are incredibly proud of where

we’ve come and are ready to tackle what’s next. Come join us!

Position Summary:
The Leasing Consultant is responsible for responding to inquiries/leads from prospective clients to identify potential renters, market, lease, and renew apartment leases in accordance with Company standards and Fair Housing guidelines and provide excellent customer service. Exhibits strong commitment to the service needs of the internal and external customers. Represents the company in a professional and courteous manner.

Essential Functions:

  • Responsible for ensuring the daily marketing, administrative, and financial operation of the property under the direction of the Community Manager.
  • Maintains a strong understanding of the community and local market competitor's specials and floor plans. Have comprehensive working knowledge of all aspects of leasing units and documents in accordance with Company standards and Fair Housing guidelines.
  • Processes lease application paperwork for the approval of the CM and prepares new lease contracts.
  • Inspects all target and/or show units in advance and in preparation of greeting and touring new prospects. Touring prospects may include, but is not limited to, vacant or model units and common/amenity areas of the property.
  • Inspect pre-leased apartments prior to the move-in date and promptly communicate any concerns to the Service Manager or Community Manager.
  • Understands, utilizes and promotes all third-party online leasing programs appropriately.
  • Ensure timely and accurate logging of all prospect information and notifications into our Property Management software.
  • Responsible for checking, responding to and documenting community and individual emails, voicemails, and text messages.
  • Stays up to date with all promotion/leasing incentives.
  • Assist with completing Move Out Vacant Inspection Checklist (MOVIC) accurately and within the specified deadline per Company standards.

  • Assist with daily community inspections to ensure community policies are being followed and addressing, if applicable.

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing/customer service role
  • Demonstrated sales and closing skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to work with a diverse group of people

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday (work schedule may vary depending on business needs).

Physical Requirements/Environment: The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Full range of motion with upper and lower body. Continual movement including, but not limited to: standing, walking, bending, stooping, crawling, and climbing stairs.
  • Operation of a motor vehicle onsite, if applicable.
  • Exposure to all weather conditions.
  • Lifting at least 20 pounds.



What you can expect from us:

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package - Medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with company match.
  • Generous Time Off

title: RKE Service Specialist Technician
description:
Benefits Start Day 1 for Full-Time Colleagues - No Waiting Period!

For more information about our benefits, see below!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

RK Environmental Services:
Elevate your career with RK Environmental Services (RKE), the industry-leading name in commercial pest management. We dominate the food manufacturing, distribution, and pharmaceutical sectors across 31 states, delivering high-impact consulting and advanced Integrated Pest Management solutions. Forget the mundane—here, you are a vital subject matter expert. You’ll be fully empowered to lead client accounts, own your decision-making, and drive real, tangible results.

The Right Fit:
Do you thrive on mystery and investigation, much like the experts on CSI? Then jump into the high-stakes world of commercial pest management! We set the gold standard in the industry, and we’re looking for driven individuals who are obsessed with getting the job done right the first time. Bring us your curiosity and a hunger to learn, and we’ll provide the comprehensive training and support you need to launch a long, prosperous, and truly rewarding career.

Duties of a Pest Control Technician:

  • Our Pest Control Technicians are highly trained, licensed, and skilled individuals who are compelled to solve pest problems from simple to complex scenarios.
  • Our Pest Control Technicians may work exclusively with food manufacturers, distributors, pharmaceutical and food grade clients
  • The primary duties of RKE Pest Control Technicians include inspection, pest identification, selecting pest control methods/products required, exclusion practices to keep pests out of structures, documentation and recommendation of action taken and required.
  • After an extensive paid training period, our Pest Control Technicians work independently, with support from colleagues, management and the office team

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Pest Control - Conduct inspections to determine the source of pest activity. Select and build a solution of products and services to remedy pest presence. Perform pest treatments and install products to create a pest-free environment. Operate and maintain service vehicles and equipment.
  • Client Experience – Build relationships with our high profile clients through friendly, helpful, and courteous behavior during service visits. Listen to client needs and offer solutions to pest issues and recommend appropriate services to resolve client concerns. Identify and alert clients of additional service offerings that will provide value to the client.
  • Continuous Learning and Development– Become knowledgeable in the array of available products and services. Stay current on the latest developments, trends, technology, and regulations in the pest control industry. Training and development doesn’t stop at pest control, we also coach and train on running a business, managing time and efficiencies and interpersonal skills. Obtain and maintain licenses/certificates required by federal, state, and local regulations.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Client-facing experience preferred

Other Skills, Attributes, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated attention to detail
  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience using technology in a work environment, handheld, apps, Google suite - gmail, calendar and g-drive a plus
  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in the area of pest control
  • Comfortable with self-directed working conditions after a training period

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways
  • Working around animals, insects and termites
  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely
  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear
  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles
  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator
  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)

Why Choose Us?

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

Below you'll find information about some of what we have to offer. All Full-Time Colleagues qualify for the following and Part-Time Colleagues qualify for most benefits after they meet certain criteria.

Key Responsibilities:

Logistics:

  • Assist with event preparation, packing, loading, and unloading.
  • Support event inventory tracking and organization of giveaway items, displays, and materials.
  • Help coordinate logistics for trade shows, pop-ups, company events, and internal activities.
  • Support transportation and movement of event supplies between locations.
  • Ensure event materials are properly packed, labeled, and accounted for before and after events.

  • Maintain accurate tracking sheets, logs, and inventory records.
  • Communicate status updates, shortages, or operational concerns to leadership.
  • Support process improvements and organizational initiatives.
  • Follow company safety guidelines and operational procedures.
  • Provide flexible support across logistics, facilities, and event-related tasks as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in shipping, warehouse, logistics, retail operations, or event support preferred.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable with physical work, including lifting, moving boxes, and event setup activities.
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with Google Workspace or similar tools preferred.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work occasional flexible hours during events or operational needs.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and move throughout the workday.
  • Moving palettes in the staging area, stacking boxes.
  • Comfortable working in warehouse, office, and event environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Positive and collaborative attitude.
  • Willingness to learn and support multiple operational areas.
  • Strong sense of accountability and follow-through.
  • Ability to remain organized under changing priorities.

U.S. Perks & Benefits:

  • Annual Bonus Program
  • Healthcare: 100% premiums covered for medical, dental, and vision for employees (50% for dependents)
  • Basic Life and AD&D with option for additional voluntary coverage
  • Short and long term disability coverage
  • 401k with up to 4% match
  • EAP and Spring Health that gives you and dependents access to free therapy and coaching
  • Free access for you and your family to our digital wellness platform - Wellness Coach
  • FTO (Flex Time Off) in addition to our Week of Zen - the time between Christmas and New Year’s to relax and recuperate
  • Fully Paid Parental Leave - 16 weeks for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Family forming & fertility support and services through Maven
  • Annual Zenni Gift Card - to use towards our products!

Compensation

In addition to other forms of compensation like perks and benefits, the estimated range for this role is $39,200 - $49,000. The final offer will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skill set, experience, geographical location, market conditions, and other organizational needs. The Company reserves the right to change, modify, or revisit the salary range for various reasons including business needs.

At Zenni Optical, people remain the heart of our mission, even as we embrace technology that moves us forward. While we recognize the immense promise of AI, we are equally mindful of its limitations and use these tools strictly to assist our Talent Acquisition team rather than replace human judgment. We utilize AI tools as a collaborative partner to create content–such as job descriptions, interview questions, and outreach messaging–and review resumes, but we maintain a firm commitment to human-led hiring where AI never makes a final decision. Every selection is determined by a member of our team to ensure every candidate is personally valued by a human rather than an algorithm.

We strive to build a diverse team of individuals with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t feel you meet all the qualifications.

Zenni Optical is an equal opportunity workplace and considers applications without regard to race, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. title: Choir Director
description:
Choir Director (Part-Time)

Linfield University | Department of Music

Position Type: Staff
Department: Music
Location: McMinnville, Oregon

About the Position

Linfield University invites applications for a passionate and collaborative part-time Choir Director to lead and inspire our student vocal ensembles. This position offers an exciting opportunity to foster musical excellence, creativity, and community while helping students develop their talents and a lifelong appreciation for choral music.

The Choir Director provides artistic and instructional leadership for Linfield's Concert Choir and Cascara Voce (treble choir). Responsibilities include selecting repertoire, conducting rehearsals and performances, mentoring student musicians, coordinating choir activities, and supporting the continued growth and success of the university's choral program.

Working closely with the Music Department Chair, Music Department Office, and campus partners, the Choir Director will also play an important role in student recruitment, community engagement, and building lasting relationships with high school choral programs throughout the Pacific Northwest.

The ideal candidate will bring strong musical expertise, enthusiasm for teaching, and a commitment to creating an inclusive, supportive environment where students of all backgrounds can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Choral Direction and Student Development

  • Provide artistic direction and instructional leadership for the Concert Choir and Cascara Voce, including repertoire selection, rehearsal planning, conducting, and performance preparation.

  • Lead engaging rehearsals that promote healthy vocal techniques, musical growth, performance excellence, teamwork, and a positive ensemble experience.

  • Conduct regularly scheduled rehearsals totaling at least three hours per week, with additional rehearsals and activities as needed for performances and special events.

  • Foster an inclusive and welcoming choir culture that encourages student participation, camaraderie, and a shared appreciation for music.

  • Plan and coordinate concerts, performances, choir camps, and other special activities in collaboration with the Music Department Chair and Music Department Office.

  • Collaborate with the part-time Director of the Wildcat Glee vocal ensemble to coordinate concerts and other musical events.

  • Encourage student leadership, engagement, and personal development through participation in the university's choral ensembles.

Program Management and Collaboration

  • Partner with the Music Department Chair and Administrative Assistant/Event Coordinator to coordinate choir operations, scheduling, budgeting, and program planning.

  • Oversee the organization and maintenance of the choral music library, equipment, and other program resources with support from the Music Department Office.

  • Provide guidance and supervision to student leaders involved in choir activities.

  • Assess choral activities and identify opportunities to strengthen program quality, student engagement, and long-term sustainability.

  • Support strategic planning initiatives that align the choir program with the goals and priorities of the Music Department and Linfield University.

  • Collaborate with faculty, staff, and departments across campus, including Education, Strategic Communications, Student Affairs, and Admission, to support university events and initiatives.

Student Recruitment and Community Engagement

  • Partner with the Office of Admission to develop and implement recruitment strategies that attract talented and engaged student musicians.

  • Build and maintain strong professional relationships with high school choir directors and music educators throughout the Pacific Northwest.

  • Connect with prospective students through high school visits, regional choral performances, recruitment events, and other outreach opportunities.

  • Promote participation in Linfield's choral ensembles and communicate the value of the university's music programs to prospective students and families.

  • Collaborate with University Advancement and Strategic Communications, as requested, to support university outreach, visibility, and community engagement.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Music, Music Education, or a closely related field.

  • Previous teaching experience at the college or university level.

  • Demonstrated experience directing a choir or serving as the lead instructor of a comparable vocal ensemble.

  • Experience developing vocal warm-ups, exercises, and instructional techniques that support healthy singing and performance preparation.

  • Strong conducting, musicianship, rehearsal planning, and instructional skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively with students, faculty, staff, and community partners.

  • Valid Oregon driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and ability to obtain and maintain certification to operate Linfield University vehicles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Doctoral degree in Music, Music Education, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while developing and sustaining a successful choral program.

  • Experience working with students from diverse backgrounds and fostering an inclusive, welcoming, and supportive learning environment.

  • Experience with student recruitment, community outreach, and building relationships with secondary school music programs.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate rehearsals, performances, and special events effectively.

Work Schedule and Physical Requirements

This is a part-time position requiring a flexible schedule to accommodate rehearsals, concerts, recruitment activities, and special events. Regular choir rehearsals will total at least three hours per week, with additional time required for planning, performances, meetings, and other program responsibilities. Evening and weekend availability is required, and occasional travel may be necessary.

The position involves a combination of standing, walking, sitting, conducting, speaking, hearing, and other physical activities associated with music instruction and performance. Duties may require frequent reaching, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and climbing stairs, as well as lifting or moving materials weighing up to 25 pounds. The position may involve outdoor activities, extended workdays during special events, and travel to recruitment or performance locations.

Linfield University is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position.

Why Join Linfield University?

At Linfield University, music is more than performance—it's an opportunity to connect, collaborate, and inspire. Our Music Department provides a welcoming environment where students can explore their creativity, develop their musical abilities, and build meaningful connections through shared experiences. As Choir Director, you'll have the opportunity to shape the choral experience, mentor talented student musicians, and contribute to a vibrant campus community that values artistic expression, academic excellence, and personal growth.

Located in the heart of Oregon's beautiful Willamette Valley, Linfield offers a close-knit university community where faculty and staff make a lasting impact on students' lives.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit an application through Linfield University's employment website.

Application materials may include:

  • Cover letter describing relevant experience and interest in the position.

  • Current résumé or curriculum vitae.

  • Contact information for professional references.

  • Additional materials demonstrating choral conducting or teaching experience, if requested.

Linfield University is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive campus community. We welcome applications from individuals whose experiences and perspectives will contribute to the university's educational mission.

title: Incident Response Specialist- Onsite, Overland Park, KS
description:
About the Role


As an Incident Response Specialist, you will serve as a critical first line of defense when client systems experience service disruptions or outages. You will monitor Netsmart application environments, respond to alerts, troubleshoot incidents, and help restore service as quickly as possible while keeping clients and internal teams informed throughout the process.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced technical environment, can manage multiple priorities at once, and remains calm and customer-focused when systems are down and timelines are tight.



Work Schedule

This position follows a 12-hour day shift schedule from 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

  • Sunday, Monday and Tuesday
  • Every other Saturday
  • Fully onsite in Overland Park, KS

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage and respond to alerts across multi-site Linux/UNIX and Windows-based Netsmart application environments supporting turnkey and cloud clients.
  • Serve as a first line of response when client systems experience service disruptions, outages or other incidents, working quickly to troubleshoot issues and restore service availability.
  • Simultaneously manage and prioritize multiple incidents while operating within established service level agreements (SLAs) and tight response timelines.
  • Execute established incident response runbooks and troubleshooting procedures to protect or restore service availability.
  • Escalate unresolved or high-impact issues and initiate Major Incident Management procedures when appropriate.
  • Serve as Incident Manager or Scribe during major incidents, coordinating cross-functional response efforts, documenting activity and supporting timely stakeholder communication.
  • Provide direct client support, including rapid response to inquiries, issue resolution, incident updates and Major Incident Management communications.
  • Monitor Netsmart Plexus systems and supporting technology to proactively identify potential service-impacting issues.
  • Collaborate with technical, infrastructure, cloud and application teams to troubleshoot incidents and drive issues toward resolution.
  • Maintain detailed incident documentation to support post-incident reviews and contribute to root cause analysis under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Follow established work instructions, knowledge base articles, technical documentation and client communication standards.
  • Follow system security protocols and departmental procedures in accordance with HIPAA and ISO 27000 series requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Aptitude or experience in technical support, system administration, application support, incident response, IT operations or a related technical environment.
  • Basic understanding of Windows and Linux/UNIX operating systems.
  • Strong customer service experience with the ability to communicate professionally and confidently with clients during high-pressure or service-impacting situations.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving and analytical skills with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively multitask, prioritize and manage multiple active incidents simultaneously.
  • Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain composed and organized during critical incidents or system outages.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow established incident management procedures, escalation paths, runbooks and documentation standards.
  • Familiarity with incident management concepts or frameworks such as ITIL.
  • Ability to work the assigned 6:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. onsite schedule in Overland Park, KS, including Sundays, Mondays, Tuesdays and every other Saturday.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience supporting SaaS applications, enterprise applications or highly available production environments.
  • Exposure to AWS cloud environments or services such as Amazon EC2, Amazon S3 and Amazon CloudWatch.
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification or similar foundational cloud knowledge.
  • Experience using monitoring, alerting or incident management tools such as Splunk, Grafana, ServiceNow, Zabbix, Pingdom or Tines.
  • Experience working with database technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or similar relational database platforms.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements, security best practices or ISO 27000 series standards.
  • Experience participating in Major Incident Management, production support, Network Operations Center (NOC), application support or other 24/7 operational environments.
