title: Senior Director, Head of Digital Strategy
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.

As a Senior Director, Head of Digital Strategy, at Gilead you will lead the next evolution of digital customer engagement across our U.S. Commercial organization.

You will lead a team of Digital Strategy professionals who serve as strategic partners to Brand and therapeutic area leaders. You will establish the vision and standard for Digital Strategy across the portfolio, bringing together customer insights, media, content, data, technology, artificial intelligence (AI), and emerging capabilities to create connected experiences for healthcare professionals (HCPs) and patients.

This highly visible leadership role operates at the intersection of customer experience, media, data, technology, AI, and omnichannel engagement. You will translate these capabilities into strategies that address meaningful customer and business needs while helping Gilead anticipate how technological advances and changing customer behaviors are reshaping healthcare engagement.

Lead the Digital Strategy vision

  • Define and continuously evolve the vision, operating model, and strategic priorities for Digital Strategy across the U.S. Commercial portfolio.
  • Establish clear standards for digital and omnichannel strategy and raise the quality and consistency of customer engagement across therapeutic areas.
  • Ensure digital strategies begin with a clearly defined customer and business need rather than a specific channel or technology.
  • Identify the highest-value opportunities across the portfolio and focus Digital Strategy resources where they can create the greatest customer and business impact.

Partner with Brand and therapeutic area leadership

  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to Brand and therapeutic area leaders on customer behavior, digital disruption, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate Brand priorities into differentiated, connected customer experiences across channels.
  • Bring together customer insights, audience strategy, content, channels, data, and technology to support seamless HCP and patient journeys.
  • Translate sophisticated data and technology capabilities into clear, actionable strategies tied to customer and business needs.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across a complex, highly matrixed organization and build alignment around a common digital vision.

Connect and advance the digital ecosystem

  • Integrate expertise across media, AI, Digital Health, Analytics, customer relationship management (CRM), web, content, data, Digital Operations, and Technology into cohesive strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal capability leaders, Information Technology, Operations, agencies, and external technology partners.
  • Anticipate how AI, search, emerging platforms, new data sources, and changes in HCP and patient behaviors may reshape healthcare engagement.
  • Translate emerging technologies into practical use cases and scalable opportunities for Gilead.
  • Lead the Digital Strategy innovation roadmap, identify opportunities to pilot, learn, optimize, and scale new approaches.
  • Advance more intelligent, personalized, and connected customer experiences across the portfolio.

Build organizational capability and drive measurable impact

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Digital Strategy professionals.
  • Build deep digital expertise while ensuring Digital Strategy remains closely connected to Brand priorities and customer needs.
  • Create mechanisms for sharing insights, practices, and learning across therapeutic areas so successful approaches can benefit the broader portfolio.
  • Establish clear measures of success grounded in customer and business outcomes rather than individual channel metrics.
  • Partner with Analytics and capability teams to develop learning agendas, measurement frameworks, and optimization approaches.
  • Apply insights and performance data to continuously improve customer experiences and inform investment decisions.
  • Scale successful approaches across brands and therapeutic areas where appropriate.

Success in this role will be demonstrated through the business and customer impact of digital strategies; increasingly connected experiences across media, content, CRM, web, data, and emerging channels; the effective testing and scaling of new capabilities; strong strategic partnerships with Brand and senior leaders; enterprise-wide sharing of successful approaches; and the attraction, development, and retention of digital talent.



Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and 14 years of relevant experience, OR Master’s Degree and 12 years of relevant experience, OR PhD and 12 years of relevant experience.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise across omnichannel strategy, customer journey design, audience strategy, personalization, CRM, media, web, content, data, and marketing technology.
  • Experience connecting customer insights, first- and third-party data, and behavioral signals to activation strategies.
  • Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies and their implications for customer engagement and marketing.
  • Experience with enterprise marketing platforms and ecosystems such as Salesforce, Sitecore, LiveRamp, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience translating data and technology capabilities into customer-focused strategies and scalable business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and operate effectively across complex, highly matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication, storytelling, facilitation, and influencing capabilities.
  • Experience balancing strategic direction with pragmatic execution and advancing ideas from concept through adoption and scale.
  • Pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience.
  • Experience working in regulated environments.
  • Agency, consulting, or technology experience, particularly when combined with client-side leadership experience.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.


People Leader Accountabilities

  • Create Inclusion – knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent – understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow and develop.

$25–$38 per hour DOE | Immediate Openings | Full-time

Thorpe Design, Inc. is a fire protection contractor founded in 1986. For more than 40 years, we have built a reputation for safety, quality workmanship, professionalism, and exceptional customer service in the fire protection industry. We provide fire sprinkler, fire alarm, underground fire protection, and monitoring services for residential, multifamily, and commercial projects.

Our culture is built on Character, Professionalism, Excellence, Growth, and Teamwork. We believe our success starts with our people and are committed to creating an environment where employees are supported, respected, and encouraged to develop their skills.

Safety is at the core of everything we do. We provide ongoing safety training, routine field evaluations, and the resources employees need to perform their work safely and successfully.

  • Free Kaiser One Pass fitness membership (eligibility requirements apply)

Position Summary

The Fire Alarm Technician / Fire Sprinkler Installer is primarily responsible for the installation, programming, testing, inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of fire alarm systems per NFPA 72 in commercial and multifamily construction projects. During periods of reduced fire alarm workload, this position will assist with the installation of fire sprinkler systems, including piping, sprinkler heads, valves, and related components in compliance with NFPA 13, NFPA 13R, and NFPA 13D

The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge of fire alarm systems while maintaining the willingness and ability to support fire sprinkler installation operations as needed. This position plays a vital role in ensuring all life safety systems are installed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable codes and company standards.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Fire Alarm Responsibilities (Primary Role)

Installation & System Integration

  • Install fire alarm systems in accordance with approved plans, specifications, NFPA standards, and local codes.
  • Install and terminate fire alarm cabling, including initiating and notification circuits.
  • Install fire alarm control panels, annunciators, power supplies, and network equipment.
  • Install field devices including:
    • Smoke detectors
    • Heat detectors
    • Pull stations
    • Horns
    • Strobes
    • Horn/Strobes
    • Voice evacuation components
  • Perform panel terminations, device addressing, and system startup activities.
  • Verify proper installation prior to testing and commissioning.

Testing, Inspection & Troubleshooting

  • Perform acceptance testing of newly installed systems.
  • Conduct inspections and testing in accordance with NFPA 72 requirements.
  • Troubleshoot wiring faults, communication failures, programming issues, and device malfunctions.
  • Repair or replace defective equipment and components.
  • Support warranty, deficiency, and service work.
  • Assist with AHJ inspections and fire marshal acceptance testing.
  • Verify system functionality and code compliance prior to project turnover.

Programming & Technical Support

  • Program and configure fire alarm control panels and associated devices.
  • Perform system modifications, additions, and upgrades.
  • Maintain software backups and programming records.
  • Assist with integrations involving monitoring systems and other life-safety equipment.
  • Provide technical support and mentorship to junior technicians and apprentices.

Fire Sprinkler Responsibilities (Secondary Role)

When assigned, the employee will support fire sprinkler installation operations, including:

  • Install fire sprinkler systems in accordance with approved plans, specifications, and applicable codes.
  • Assist with layout and installation of sprinkler piping, sprinkler heads, valves, hangers, seismic bracing, and related components.
  • Support installation of wet, dry, and standpipe system components.
  • Read and interpret sprinkler shop drawings and installation details.
  • Assist with system inspections, hydrostatic testing, and project punch list completion.
  • Coordinate work with plumbers, electricians, general contractors, and other trades.
  • Notify supervisors of material requirements and jobsite needs.
  • Assist with code-compliant completion of sprinkler installations.
  • Participate in inspections with AHJs and local fire officials as needed.

Field Leadership & Coordination

  • Lead and direct small crews of technicians assigned.
  • Coordinate daily activities with Project Managers, Supervisors, and Field Operations personnel.
  • Assist with jobsite organization and material management.
  • Attend project coordination meetings when required.
  • Ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and according to project requirements.

Documentation

  • Complete daily reports as needed/required and field documentation.
  • Record installation, testing, inspection, programming, maintenance, and repair activities.
  • Maintain accurate as-built drawings and redline markups.
  • Document deficiencies and corrective actions.
  • Ensure all project paperwork is completed accurately and submitted on time.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all company safety policies and OSHA requirements.
  • Maintain a safe and clean work environment.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • NFPA 72
    • NFPA 13
    • NFPA 14
    • NFPA 20
    • NFPA 24
    • NFPA 70
    • California Fire Code
    • AHJ requirements
  • Use proper PPE and safe work practices at all times.

This position translates corporate procedures, division procedures, program requirements, and project-specific processes into clear, practical, and repeatable operating practices. The role analyzes process performance, identifies gaps and inefficiencies, develops process documentation and training materials, coordinates technical training, and supports organizational readiness as products and programs mature.


The Sr. Process Analyst works cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Safety, Finance, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to ensure that processes are understood, consistently executed, properly documented, and aligned with company objectives, contractual requirements, quality standards, and product lifecycle needs.


Position Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Process Support

  • Support process development and implementation across all phases of the product lifecycle:
    • Proof of concept
    • Prototype development
    • Research and development
    • Design and engineering maturation
    • Low-Rate Initial Production
    • Full-Rate Production
    • Sustaining production and lifecycle support
  • Develop process frameworks that scale appropriately with product maturity, organizational growth, production volume, and program complexity.
  • Capture and incorporate lessons learned from proof-of-concept, prototype, R&D, LRIP, and FRP activities.
  • Ensure processes support repeatability, traceability, quality, safety, cost control, schedule performance, and customer expectations.
  • Support transition planning from development teams to production, operations, service, and sustaining organizations.

Process Analysis and Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct interviews, workshops, observations, data reviews, and stakeholder assessments to understand how work is performed.
  • Evaluate process effectiveness using qualitative and quantitative data.
  • Lead or support root-cause analysis, corrective action, and preventive action activities.
  • Track improvement actions through completion and verify that implemented changes produce the intended results.
  • Promote standardization while allowing appropriate flexibility for program- or project-specific requirements.

Corporate, Division, Program, and Project Processes

  • Support the deployment and consistent application of corporate procedures and business processes.
  • Translate division-level procedures into practical workflows, work instructions, templates, checklists, and training materials.
  • Support the development and maintenance of program- and project-specific procedures, processes, operating plans, and execution guides.
  • Ensure alignment among:
    • Corporate policies and procedures
    • Division procedures and operating practices
    • Program management requirements
    • Project execution plans
    • Engineering and manufacturing processes
    • Quality management system requirements
    • Customer and contractual obligations
  • Identify conflicts, gaps, duplication, or ambiguity between corporate, division, program, and project processes.
  • Facilitate resolution of process ownership, approval, documentation, and implementation issues.
  • Maintain traceability between process requirements, documented procedures, training content, and evidence of execution.
  • Support process tailoring and deviation approval when standard processes are not appropriate for a specific program or project.
  • Assist leaders and process owners in establishing clear accountability for process performance and maintenance.

Process Documentation and Governance

  • Establish documentation standards to improve consistency, usability, readability, and accessibility.
  • Coordinate reviews and approvals with process owners, subject-matter experts, Quality, Legal, Compliance, Security, and other applicable stakeholders.
  • Ensure process documentation reflects the actual work being performed and remains current as systems, products, requirements, and organizational structures change.
  • Support document control and records-management activities in accordance with applicable company and quality-system requirements.
  • Develop process repositories, knowledge libraries, navigation structures, and content-management practices.
  • Establish mechanisms for employees to provide process feedback and recommend improvements.
  • Conduct periodic process and documentation reviews to confirm continued relevance and effectiveness.

Technical Training Coordination

  • Coordinate technical and process training associated with corporate, division, program, project, engineering, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and operational requirements.
  • Conduct training needs analysis based on:
    • New product introductions
    • Process changes
    • Engineering changes
    • New equipment or systems
    • Production rate increases
    • Organizational changes
    • Compliance requirements
    • Audit findings
    • Corrective actions
    • Skills and qualification gaps
  • Develop training plans and curricula for each phase of the product lifecycle.
  • Create and maintain instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and on-the-job training materials.
  • Develop training presentations, facilitator guides, learner guides, assessments, demonstrations, simulations, quick-reference guides, and knowledge checks.
  • Coordinate technical training with subject-matter experts, engineering personnel, manufacturing personnel, quality representatives, and functional leaders.
  • Schedule training sessions, manage attendance, coordinate facilities or virtual platforms, and ensure required resources are available.
  • Support qualification, certification, recertification, and proficiency programs where applicable.
  • Ensure training content is consistent with current procedures, released engineering documentation, system functionality, safety requirements, and product configuration.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, performance observations, and operational metrics.
  • Maintain accurate training records, completion status, qualification records, and retraining requirements.
  • Coordinate timely retraining when procedures, systems, products, or requirements change.
  • Support onboarding and role-specific training for new employees, transfers, contractors, and program personnel.

Product and Production Readiness

  • Verify that personnel have access to the procedures, systems, tools, equipment, and training required to perform their assigned work.
  • Coordinate training and process deployment before key program milestones and production events.
  • Support rate transitions by identifying changes to staffing, roles, work content, process controls, training requirements, and documentation.
  • Identify process and training risks that could affect product quality, schedule, cost, safety, or customer delivery.
  • Develop mitigation plans and track readiness actions to closure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with process owners to define objectives, inputs, outputs, controls, measures, and ownership.
  • Collaborate with Program Management to align processes and training with program schedules, milestones, risks, and customer commitments.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Manufacturing to ensure processes are practical, executable, and scalable.
  • Partner with Quality to support audits, nonconformance investigations, corrective actions, process compliance, and quality-system improvements.
  • Work with Supply Chain and Procurement to support supplier, material, purchasing, and logistics process training.
  • Coordinate with Information Technology on business-system processes, system changes, user access, and system training.
  • Engage functional leaders and subject-matter experts to validate content and promote process adoption.
  • Communicate changes clearly to affected employees and stakeholders.

Change Management and Implementation

  • Develop implementation plans for new or revised processes.
  • Assess organizational impacts, affected roles, required communications, training needs, and implementation risks.
  • Coordinate pilot activities, stakeholder reviews, rollout plans, and post-implementation assessments.
  • Support change adoption by clearly communicating the purpose, benefits, responsibilities, and expected behaviors associated with process changes.
  • Monitor implementation effectiveness and resolve adoption issues.
  • Ensure obsolete procedures and training materials are removed from active use.
  • Support transition from temporary prototype or development processes to controlled production processes.

Reporting and Performance Management

  • Develop reports and dashboards that communicate process health, training status, readiness, compliance, and improvement progress.
  • Track process-related metrics, including:
    • Procedure review and approval status
    • Training completion and overdue training
    • Qualification and certification status
    • Process deviations and exceptions
    • Audit findings
    • Corrective-action closure
    • Process cycle time
    • Rework and error rates
    • Readiness milestone completion
    • Employee feedback and training effectiveness
  • Provide status updates to functional leaders, program managers, project managers, and executive stakeholders.
  • Escalate process, documentation, training, and readiness risks in a timely manner.
  • Maintain action registers and follow up on commitments through closure.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Organizational Development, Education, Technical Communications, or a related field or years of service equivalent.
  • **Must be a US citizen due to the Government contracts this role will be working on**
  • 5-8 or more years of experience in process analysis, business process improvement, technical training, operations, manufacturing, engineering, program support, or a related discipline.
  • Experience documenting and improving processes across multiple organizational levels.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical, operational, or procedural training.
  • Experience supporting new product introduction, product development, manufacturing, engineering, or other lifecycle-based environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with corporate, division, program, and project-level requirements.
  • Strong written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency with process-mapping, documentation, presentation, spreadsheet, collaboration, and learning-management tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Ability to understand complex technical information and convert it into clear and usable documentation and training content.

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience supporting products through proof of concept, prototype, R&D, LRIP, and FRP.
  • Experience with engineering change management, configuration management, product lifecycle management, or enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Experience with quality management systems, internal audits, corrective actions, and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, value-stream mapping, or other process-improvement methodologies.
  • Experience with instructional design, adult learning principles, train-the-trainer programs, or technical writing.
  • Experience with learning management systems and training-record administration.
  • Experience developing role-based competency or qualification programs.
  • Certification in process improvement, instructional design, project management, business analysis, or technical writing.
  • Familiarity with government contracting, customer requirements, export controls, cybersecurity, safety, or other regulated operating environments.

Core Competencies

  • Process analysis and modeling
  • Continuous improvement
  • Technical communication
  • Instructional design and facilitation
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Change management
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Documentation governance
  • Program and project coordination
  • Data analysis and reporting
  • Risk identification and mitigation
  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability and initiative
  • Ownership and accountability

Leadership and Coordination Responsibilities

Although this role may not directly supervise employees, the Process Analyst and Technical Training Coordinator is expected to:

  • Coordinate cross-functional process and training initiatives.
  • Facilitate working sessions, process reviews, and improvement workshops.
  • Influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Establish clear actions, owners, milestones, and completion criteria.
  • Coordinate subject-matter experts and functional contributors.
  • Promote consistent adoption of approved processes and training.
  • Mentor process owners and trainers in documentation and implementation practices.
  • Escalate unresolved issues and risks to the appropriate leadership level.

Physical Demands & Working Environment

  • Work is performed in office, laboratory, manufacturing, warehouse, and other operational environments.
  • Regular interaction with engineering, production, quality, supply chain, program, project, and corporate personnel is expected.
  • May require access to production areas, test facilities, laboratories, and controlled work environments.
  • Occasional travel may be required to support suppliers, manufacturing locations, customer activities, training events, or other company sites.
  • Periodic schedule flexibility may be required to support production events, program milestones, training sessions, audits, and major process implementations.


Clearance Level

No Clearance

The salary range for this role is:

$91,000 - $154,500

title: Protocol Scheduler
description:
The Protocol Scheduler is responsible for all aspects of patient scheduling for patients on clinical trials, in accordance with department and protocol specific scheduling guidelines. Provides superior customer service to all patients, family members, physicians and staff at all times in accordance with the DFCI Customer Service Standards. Assigned to work with a clinical practitioner group consisting of physicians, physician’s assistants, program nurses and nurse practitioners and other care providers, the individuals in this position will play a critical role in facilitating all aspects of patient care and maintaining compliance with protocol requirements.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

  • Work as an integral part of the CCTI phase 1 clinical research team to ensure accurate and effective scheduling of all assessments needed for patients on clinical trial.
  • Coordinates all related clinical trial treatments, tests and procedures, required by each clinical trial while adhering to protocols specific and Dana-Farber scheduling guidelines.
  • As all patients in this job family shall be considered high risk or falling under highly regulated services, this job family is responsible for carrying out specialized tasks to support regulatory requirements and patient safety, requiring an understanding of the sequential processes involved in clinical trials and patient treatment plans that fall under specified regulatory controls.
  • Carries out or supports patient education in person and/or by telephone, involving effective communication of complex appointment schedules.
  • Participates in continuous training and maintains current knowledge of the clinical process, regulatory standards, and requirements that impact the assigned patient population to achieve patient safety, flow and resource utilization goals of the organization and sponsoring agencies.
  • Ensures appropriate order placement per disease specific and Dana-Farber Guidelines of required study assessments, including but not limited to: Labs, Radiology, Echocardiograms, Electrocardiograms, Pulmonary Function Tests, Pharmacokinetics
  • Responsible for ensuring scheduling templates are updated to reflect any changes affecting patient scheduling.
  • May lead or participate in the development of new scheduling systems or processes.
  • Act as primary point of contact to the clinical research team, patients, and caregivers regarding all scheduling manners.
  • Input and maintain patient data relevant to proper appointment scheduling
  • May be responsible for scheduling numerous complex research protocols, involving extensive interaction with those associated with in-house studies, grant-funded studies and industry-sponsored clinical trials.
  • Carries out specific processes in the patient scheduling systems so that correct special billing and revenue processes function properly.
  • Requires clinical, operational and regulatory knowledge of the standard of care or clinical trial protocol for the patient population coordinated.
  • Identify, analyze, and solve problems outside of standard processes.
  • Monitor status of referral request and follow-up as necessary to ensure patient receives service on timely basis.
  • Arranges telehealth visits per protocol, hospital and state guidelines for patients eligible for telehealth visits. Ensuring appropriate communication between provider, admin, and patient.
  • Recognizes emergencies and appropriately responses using standard operating procedures and critical thinking skills.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Time Management: Exceptional organizational skills and ability to organize time and priorities effectively, asking for direction when appropriate. Flexibility to handle multiple tasks and deadline pressures.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively and considerately with diverse groups of patients, staff and providers while handling various tasks simultaneously.
  • Communications skills: Exceptional skills for a varied workforce that includes MD’s RN’s, NP, PA, Fellows, and administrative staff. Requires a high level of empathy, compassion, and confidentiality.
  • Quality Assurance: Skills to work efficiently and effectively and strive to do so in all aspects of position.
  • Critical Thinking/Decision Making: Ability to take initiative and exercise judgment required. Demonstrated ability to solve problems and function as a resource to other members of the team. Ability to resolve complex issues on behalf of the providers and the patients.

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High School Diploma required. Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
  • Customer service, administrative or healthcare experience preferred. Basic knowledge of medical terminology a plus

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

PATIENT CONTACT: Indirect (phone)

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. title: Senior Counsel II – Development Legal Business Partner (PDM)
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.


We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.


Gilead is seeking a development and regulatory counsel to join its Global Development & PDM Legal Business Partner team. The candidate will serve as a primary point of contact for the business, be responsible for advising and collaborating on a range of regulatory and development matters throughout the product lifecycle, liaise with other legal experts, and develop solutions for complex business matters.

The successful candidate will be able to work independently and possess a strong knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical regulatory laws, rules and regulations, industry practices and standards, and have demonstrated experience in analyzing complex issues and developing innovative solutions to business challenges. The candidate will possess a strong business acumen and legal expertise to proactively identify, analyze, and navigate potential legal and compliance considerations and risk within areas of responsibility and formulate and communicate compliant and practical solutions that meet business objectives. The candidate will work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory CMC, Quality, Global Patient Safety, Program Strategy Teams (PSTs), Development Teams, Clinical, and global affiliates. The candidate will work across Gilead’s Corporate and Legal organization to coordinate and communicate legal input on matters in collaboration with other Gilead Legal Business Partners, the Office of Ethics and Compliance, Government Affairs, and Public Affairs, across geographic and therapeutic areas.


While this position is posted as remote, candidates who are based Foster City, CA and able to work onsite are strongly preferred.


Core Job Responsibilities Include

  • Serving as a Legal Business Partner to global Development functions, including Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Policy and Intelligence, R&D Quality, Patient Safety, and cross-functional Gilead Asset Teams (GATs);
  • Providing legal guidance for the portfolio of Gilead products on GXP requirements, adverse-event reporting, data integrity, clinical data management, inspection and audit readiness, quality investigations, product quality and CMC matters, and regulatory submissions and health-authority interactions; Advising the business on a variety of supply chain issues, including drug shortages, product recalls and regional export and import requirements;
  • Keeping up to date and maintain knowledge advising on pertinent regulatory developments relevant to the business in the U.S. and key international markets;
  • Assisting in the drafting and review of agreements related to various business needs, including Quality Agreements;
  • Advising across the product lifecycle, including development strategy, regulatory pathways, established-product considerations, loss of exclusivity, strategic discontinuation or withdrawal of marketing authorizations, and regulatory data protection
  • Providing regulatory and development counsel to the Corporate Legal team for mergers and acquisitions, licenses, collaborations, and other strategic transactions;
  • Providing legal interpretation of complex and evolving regulatory requirements and translating them into risk-based compliance programs, governance structures, policies, controls, and operational processes that enable compliant execution of business objectives;
  • Proactively identifying the need for, draft, and provide legal advice on corporate policies, SOPs, and guidance documents;
  • Supporting and collaborating with a global matrix of teams effectively, including partnering with other members in Legal, Ethics and Compliance, Government Affairs, Public Affairs, in Foster City and international affiliates, including the Intercontinental Region (ICR) and Global Patient Solutions (GPS),to ensure consistency in guidance and approach across areas of the overall business and help the business operate within legal, regulatory, and ethical requirements;
  • Establishing strong partnership relationships with global Research and Development teams, as well as key cross functional teams engaged in development activities, characterized by a high-level of collaboration, responsiveness, strong understanding of scientific and business objectives, and mutual respect;
  • Driving increased efficiency, coordination, and effectiveness of legal advice, processes, and support to meet the needs of the business and other key stakeholders;
  • Defining, direct, and conscientiously manage the work of outside counsel; and
  • Providing senior business stakeholders with training and updates, policy support, and learnings to support effective risk management.
  • U.S. Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree; active law license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction;

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Juris Doctorate (J.D.) degree; active law license in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, 6+ years of legal experience supporting clients in the pharmaceutical industry, preferably at a multinational company and/or a reputable, highly rated law firm, or a combination of both;



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience advising clients on FDA and regulatory matters, preferably with some device expertise;
  • Ability to exercise judgment and independently determine and take appropriate action;
  • Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical recommendations and solutions and clearly communicate requirements and rationale for advice;
  • Ability to manage workload priorities in a matrixed environment;
  • Experience handling multiple projects in fast-paced environment, with a high degree of client service orientation, and performing successfully in cross-functional teams;
  • Able to independently handle complex matters with minimal supervision and an understanding of when to elevate issues to senior management for awareness or decision-making;
  • Proven judgment in working through complex issues, including those with significant strategic risk considerations;
  • Demonstration of excellent interpersonal, strategic thinking, communication, and organizational skills; and
  • Consistent demonstration of Gilead’s core values: Teamwork, Accountability, Inclusion, Excellence and Integrity.


Critical Success Factors


  • Judgment: Demonstrates expertise and sound judgment, understands how assigned responsibilities support Gilead’s business objectives, and is able to provide practical, risk-balanced advice based upon a thorough understanding of the scope of an issue, taking full advantage of internal networks and external intelligence. Ability to work in grey areas and solution oriented.
  • Collaboration: Works in close collaboration with others to gain a firm understanding of available legal, functional, and business resources; integrates information from a number of sources; capably navigates a matrixed environment; and works well in a team in order to achieve optimal business results.
  • Anticipation: Anticipates changes in law, enforcement, and/or business objectives; proactively recognizes challenges; develops contingency plans; and adapts approach as necessary to manage risks effectively and mitigate issues before they arise.
  • Influencing Skills: Builds strong relationships with business partners to tactfully influence and gain their support to drive desired outcomes. Represents Gilead externally to trade associations and government agencies.

People Leader Accountabilities

  • Create Inclusion – knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent – understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams – connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

title: ECC Coordinator
description:
Job Summary:

Emergency and Critical Care Coordinator serves as a primary liaison between the Intensive Care Unit (ICU) and Intermediate Care War (ICW) medical team and clients, supporting both financial accuracy and a high‑quality client experience throughout a patient’s hospitalization. This role is responsible for ensuring all ICU charges and estimates are accurate and communicated clearly, while also providing consistent, compassionate client support from admission through discharge. The Emergency and Critical Care Coordinator works collaboratively with doctors, technicians, and client service representatives to facilitate timely communication, support discharge planning, and maintain trust and transparency with clients during critical and emotionally complex situations.

Responsibilities:

Serve as the primary client liaison throughout ICU/ICW hospitalization, ensuring clear, timely, and compassionate communication.

Participate in daily ICU/ICW communication workflows to anticipate estimate changes for client emotional support and financial needs.

Coordinate with ICU doctors, technicians, and CSRs to support patient flow, client updates, and discharge planning.

Managing client expectations throughout hospitalization.

Supporting difficult conversations alongside doctors, techs, CSRs.

Communicate with client when their patient has been admitted to ICU to introduce themselves and create strong client relationships.

Field incoming phone calls regarding client’s questions and concerns regarding charges.

Ensure all client communications are accurately documented in the medical record per hospital standards.

Follow established escalation pathways for client concerns or complaints.

Audit and post charges on all admits in our Critical Care Unit.

Review hospitalized cases daily for additional charges or corrections.

Review ICU doctors medical record to ensure all charges are captured.

Update clients of charges on a daily basis.

Stay current on all pricing and procedure changes.

Communicate with doctors regarding any financial issues.

Work with doctors on creating estimates.

Escalation pathways for concerns or complaints

Support discharge readiness by confirming client understanding of care plans, estimates, and follow‑up needs.

Preform follow up phone calls after patient is discharged to schedule follow up appointments or inform medical staff of any patient concerns.

Sending and uploading medical records for referral patients that are admitted to ICU.

Perform other duties and assignments as required for organizational success.

Qualifications:

A minimum of 1-2 years previous veterinary experience.

Proficiency with data entry and computers.

Knowledge of medical terminology and medical procedures.

Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, and maintain effective working relationships.

Mathematical ability including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.

Ability to be flexible and multi-focused in order to accomplish goals.

Demonstrated organizational, problem solving and common sense skills. Must be detail-oriented and able to prioritize.

Education:

High school diploma or equivalent

Physical Requirements:

Dependable attendance is required.

Any allergies to animals must be controllable through medication.

Must be able to lift 40 pounds.

Must be willing to work long or irregular hours under pressure conditions.

This position requires the ability to walk, bend, stand and reach constantly during a minimum 8-hour day.

title: Automation Testing
description:
About Axis My India

Axis My India Limited is India’s leading consumer data intelligence company, committed to enabling data-driven decision-making. It has launched the "A" App, a people empowerment platform designed to enhance the lives of a billion citizens by providing access to authentic information and practical solutions for everyday needs. The app follows a PHYGITAL model, leveraging Axis My India’s vast network of 5,000+ locations across 700 districts. Powered by Google Cloud and Google Gen AI, it continuously learns and improves to deliver better user experiences. The company is spearheaded by Mr. Pradeep Gupta who is a leading name in market research and is India’s top psephologist.


Job Description

Automation cum Manual Tester : We are seeking a detail-oriented QA Engineer to validate the functionality and performance of our "A" App (Flutter-based) and Admin/Client Portals (React-based). The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between manual testing and automation, ensuring robust regression testing cycles. You will play a critical role in ensuring seamless data capture, secure client access, and optimal user experience across mobile and web platforms.

  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for both Manual and Automation testing.
  • Develop and execute Selenium/Appium-based automation scripts for regression testing of the Web Portal and facilitate mobile automation for the Flutter App.
  • Develop and execute manual test cases and confirm the quality of the deliverable WRT requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Developers, Product Managers) to identify system requirements.
  • Good with troubleshooting and issue debugging; quickly able to identify root causes in complex workflows involving AI labeling and Media uploads.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hybrid Testing: Perform functional, integration, and regression testing for the "A" App (Mobile) and Admin Portal (Web).
  • Automation Frameworks: Build and maintain Selenium-based automation test scripts for the React-based Admin Portal and implement automation strategies for the Flutter mobile application.
  • Feature Validation: Rigorously test key features including Survey Management, Client Role-Based Access Control, and AI-driven needs categorization.
  • Scenario Testing: Validate application behavior in challenging network conditions (offline/low network mode) and ensure data synchronization once connectivity is restored.
  • API & Backend Testing: Verify APIs for survey responses, media uploads (Image, Audio, Video), and notification workflows (SMS/WhatsApp).
  • Compatibility Testing: Conduct Device Responsive Testing for Android (version 10+) and iOS (version 13+) environments.
  • Defect Management: Identify, record, document thoroughly, and track bugs using JIRA or similar tools.
  • Performance: Assist in API Load Testing and performance validation to ensure scalability


Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (Manual & Automation).
  • Experience in testing Mobile Apps (Flutter/Android/iOS) and familiarity with mobile automation tools (e.g Appium)
  • Proficiency in Selenium for web automation (React-based applications).
  • Hands-on experience with API Testing (Postman, REST Assured) and understanding of Microservices architecture.
  • Understanding of Relational Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL/AlloyDB) to validate data consistency.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD pipelines.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Opportunity to make significant contributions to a dynamic company
  • Walking distance from Chakala metro station, making commuting easy and convenient.

At Axis My India, we value discipline and focus. Our team members wear brand on sleeves, adhere to a no-mobile policy during work hours, and work from our office with alternate Saturdays off. If you thrive in a structured environment and are committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?


The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

title: MDA Test Analyst
description:
Mobius is an award winning, Small Business Administration (SBA) certified Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) company and certified Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) providing engineering, analytical, and programmatic expertise to the Federal Government and commercial customers. Our mission is to provide innovative advanced technology solutions to customers facing issues of national and global significance. We strive to be admired for excellent people, fair and honest partnership, innovative problem solving, and exceptional performance.

Come join our team! Mobius is seeking an entry level Test Analyst. The successful candidate will serve as an Advisory and Assistance Services contractor providing programmatic, technical, analytical and execution support to MDA’s Director of Test (DT). These positions support either the Director of Flight Test (DTF) who has overall responsibility for pre-mission activities, element integration, mission management and execution of all MDA flight tests or the Director of Test Resources (DTR) who has overall responsibility for mobile test instrumentation, range coordination and flight test resource management supporting MDA flight tests. You will collaborate with other missile defense experts – military, government civilians, and contractors from Mobius and other companies. Our team of experts helps the Government manage planning, development, analysis and delivery of state-of-the art sensors, weapons, communications, and command/control systems.

Based on government need at the time of hire, the selected candidate will be placed in one of three contractor support positions within the Directorate of Flight Test (DTF) or Director of Test Resources (DTR). See below for descriptions. Duties and responsibilities for each are below. The required qualifications are the same for both positions.

Duties of a Test Analyst may include:

Flight Test Execution Support Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist in developing and maintaining mission documentation, including checklists, test control structures, and test operation schedules.
  • Develop mission checklists that provide real-time updates to various stakeholders and mission assets.
  • Support all phases of test planning, training, and execution of Tier 1/2/3 test environments in accordance with the current Flight Test Concept of Operations (CONOPS).
  • Perform programmatic analyst review for test activities pre- and post-events, providing lessons learned inputs and supporting panel reviews.
  • Produce test procedures detailing time-critical events supporting the Mission Countdown Events (CDE).
  • Update mission documentation as calendar adjustments are scheduled.
  • Support test integration and planning meetings, Phase Reviews, and data archival meetings, as directed.
  • Build briefing slides and coordinate with multiple stakeholders for weekly or bi-weekly Mission Execution Team Working Groups (METWG).
  • Provide direct on-console support to key Mission Execution Team (MET) leadership, including the Mission (MTD), Associate Operations (AOTD), and Sensors (SNTD) Test Directors during mission execution.

System Mission Manager Support Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist with coordination, integration, and execution across all phases of mission flight test events, prepare decision-quality materials such as executive level briefings and supporting documentation
  • Assist with the development of planning meetings, MDA technical reviews, and provide on-site support to System Mission Managers (SMM) at deployed locations for assigned flight test missions.
  • Assist in product development of mission planning, readiness and execution support documentation.
  • Assist in coordination, consolidation, and preparation of deliverables.
  • Prepare decision-quality materials such as executive level briefings and supporting documentation (white papers, fact sheets, status reports, progress reports, and information papers) for senior level reviews and mission milestone decision meetings.
  • Assist with the development of planning meetings, MDA technical reviews, and other meetings, as directed.
  • Supports DTFI-M by developing, reviewing, and coordinating responses/inputs to numerous MDA and Director of Test (DT) Program Office-generated actions covering a wide range of internal and external topics.
  • Provide on-site support to System Mission Managers (SMM) at deployed locations for assigned flight test missions.
  • Provide input for weekly test community meetings and working groups to include briefing charts and meeting attendance.

Mission Support Test Analyst Duties/Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain deployed personnel accountability reports and emergency rosters
  • Coordinate MDA’s logistical requirements with test range to gather visitor procedures, coordinate housing and office allocation for test personnel
  • Implement missile defense system (MDS) Test Policy and test functional management approach, including preparation and execution of critical test documentation.
  • Collaborate with the host test range to track, maintain, and issue the required access badges during mission events;
  • Ensure deployed flight test personnel understand site-specific safety and security requirements.
  • Distribute information briefings and "survival" brochures outlining safety and security requirements for all deploying personnel
  • Assist in resolution of major morale, welfare and recreational issues to include transportation, lodging conditions, and fuel distribution for MDA mission vehicles
  • Coordinate pre-mission and retrograde logistics support at remotes sites

Requirements

  • 5 years relevant experience may be substituted for the BA/BS degree requirement
  • No direct experience required
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated; possess strong oral and written communication skills, and have the ability to work effectively in a dynamic team environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and assist in solving complex problems involving test planning, integration, execution, and analysis.
  • Ability to utilize, adapt, and develop analytic techniques and processes for both technical and administrative support activities.
  • Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel (~20%) to various CONUS and OCONUS locations

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science in a field pertinent to the position being filled.

Clearance Requirement

  • Active Secret or higher clearance

Job Title:

Facilities Mechanical Plumbing Technician

Department:

University Hospital | Facilities Administration

Under the supervision of a senior technician or supervisor, performs tasks that ensure the uninterrupted operations of threaded, flanged, groove locked, soldered, and pressed plumbing systems and equipment. Inspects, tests, installs, fabricates, modifies, rigs, maintains, troubleshoots, and repairs plumbing systems and equipment. Threaded, flanged, groove locked, soldered, and pressed Plumbing systems and equipment include, but are not limited to compressed gas systems, backflow preventers, sump pumps, drain, waste and vent systems, specialty water systems (e.g., chlorine dioxide, de-ionized water, reverse osmosis), domestic water systems and plumbing fixtures, heating hot water systems, and chilled water systems. Responds to emergency situations and evaluates and corrects defects.

Assists other trades as needed; adheres to all safety practices and procedures; cleans and maintains work areas and equipment; attends meetings; properly completes documentation; provides a high level of customer service; communicates to customers, coworkers and supervision via written, electronic and verbal methods and devices; operates department vehicles; performs other duties as assigned. Actively supports our commitment to the university value of acting with integrity and personal accountability to establish a culture of professionalism in the workplace.

Shift, hours, days, and/or location are subject to change based on operational need in accordance with the collective bargaining agreement; may work overtime; subject to 24-hour emergency call.


Job Duties:

Incumbents may perform some or all of these duties and other job-related duties as required.


Technical Specialties (70%)

Plumbing:

Reviewing blueprints and technical drawings, Installing, repairing and replacing threaded, flanged, groove locked, soldered, and pressed piping and components. Measuring and cutting pipes using hand and power tools. Inspecting and identifying leaks. Installs and repairs domestic water systems. Installs and repairs drain, vent and waste systems. Installs and repairs specialty water systems (e.g., chlorine dioxide, deionized water, reverse osmosis). Installs, certifies, repairs and performs preventative maintenance on backflow preventers. Installs and replaces plumbing equipment and fixtures (e.g., meters, valves, toilets). Assembling and dissembling plumbing fixtures. Repairs compressed gas systems. Troubleshoots and resolves plumbing system issues (e.g., pressure, temperature, leaks). Performs plumbing and pipe fitting PMs. Addressing customer queries. Cleaning the work area after work completion.


General Duties (30%)

Technical Support:

Ensures areas are in compliance with applicable codes. Documents regulatory compliance tests. Becomes knowledgeable of equipment and utilities and transfers that knowledge to other staff. Troubleshoots and resolves field problems. May assist lower-level technicians. Locates, identifies, disables and enables local utility shut-offs. Updates building drawings. Participates on emergency response teams.


Communication / Record Keeping:

Documents labor, materials and work performed on work orders. Requests equipment and materials required to complete tasks. Inform customers when tasks are completed. Communicates and initiates work order escalation, if needed. Updates building drawings.


Other Department Duties:

Participates in professional development/ continuing education activities: obtaining and maintaining required certifications, soft skill development, etc. Participates in meetings, trainings, and orientations. Participates on emergency response teams. Interacts with and assists other areas and staff within the department. May participate on committees. Locates, identifies, disables and enables local utility shut-offs. Performs other duties as assigned.


Major Work Characteristics:

Ability to:

1. Read, understand and update blueprints, schematics and as built drawings.

2. Read, understand and apply safety standards and practices (e.g., hazard communication, infection prevention, lock-out/ tag-out).

3. Read, interpret and apply technical manuals and systems specifications.

4. Follow applicable trade specific codes, standards and regulations.

5. Learn technical skills and apply new knowledge to solve problems.

6. Select and use hand, power and machine tools.

7. Establish and maintain interpersonal relationships.

8. Maintain a clean and safe work environment.

9. Add, subtract, multiply and divide whole numbers; calculate fractions, decimals and percentages; use algebra, geometry and trigonometry.

10. Apply engineering principles, load calculations, accepted techniques and equipment required to lift and move extremely large or heavy objects.

11. Locate, disable and enable electrical and plumbing shut-offs.

12. Instruct others in performing tasks.

13. Provide guidance and expert advice about technical systems or processes

Skills:

1. Brazing and soldering.

2. Cut and thread pipe.

3. Problem solving.

4. time management,

5. Conflict management (e.g. handling complaints, identify issues and negotiate with others).

6. Basic computer (e.g., data entry, data retrieval, electronic communication, internet searches, navigate and retrieve information from websites).

7. Customer service (e.g. demonstrate empathy, meet quality standards, actively look for ways to help others).


Knowledge of:

1. Ohio plumbing code (e.g. fittings, water supply systems, sanitary drainage systems, waste, stacks-vents, traps, piping and storage systems)**.

2. Planning and prioritizing work

3. Resource management


Minimum Classification Requirements:

High school diploma/GED or equivalent combination of education and experience; two years’ experience in the plumbing, trade and related equipment or equivalent combination of education and experience; obtain the following during probationary period: valid OSHA 10-hour General Industry Safety and Health card; EPA Section 608 Technician Certification- Universal. Efficient skills and knowledge in using plumbing tools and equipment. A basic understanding of plumbing code compliance. Knowledge of plumbing fixtures (i.e. faucets, toilets, hot water tanks, etc.). as well as piping components (i.e. types of valves, fittings, types of piping). A valid driver’s license. Successful completion of probationary period.


Desired Qualifications:

Associates/technical degree or certificate in skilled trades/maintenance related field; valid OSHA 10-hour General Industry Safety and Health card

Physical Requirements:

Must be able to push and pull 70 lbs. and distinguish colors. Climb and stand on ladders for extended periods of time.


Unusual Work Conditions:

May work in hot, cold, dusty, or dirty environments for an extended period of time. May work in cramped spaces.

University Hospital - Rhodes Hall (0354)

Position Type:

Regular

Scheduled Hours:

40

title: Commercial Lines CSR
description:
Superior Insurance Partners is a rapidly growing insurance brokerage platform specializing in commercial lines, personal lines, and employee benefits solutions for businesses and individuals across the United States. Through strategic acquisitions and long-term partnerships with leading independent agencies, Superior has built a strong presence throughout the Midwest and Eastern U.S.

At the core of Superior’s approach is its mission: to improve the lives of its Agency Partners by supporting their personal, professional, and financial goals. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all model, Superior develops customized growth strategies tailored to each partner agency’s unique vision and objectives. Agency partners gain access to a robust shared-services platform that includes accounting and finance, recruiting, human resources, AMS/IT support, marketing, and M&A expertise — allowing local agencies to maintain their entrepreneurial culture while benefiting from the scale, resources, and best practices of a larger organization. Long-term economic alignment ensures partners remain invested in the collective success and growth of the platform.

title: Real Estate Photographer - Pagosa Springs, CO
description:
Role Mission

Are you a visual storyteller with an eye for detail and a knack for seamless execution?

Ziprent (a subsidiary of TurboTenant) is looking for a independent contractor (1099) Real Estate Photographer & Field Operations Specialist to be our eyes and ears on the ground. This isn’t just about snapping a few photos; it’s about crafting the digital first impression for our rental properties and ensuring every home is "rent-ready" through meticulous property walkthroughs and technical setups.

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. You’ll work independently to manage everything from 3D tours and high-fidelity photography to smart lockbox installations and condition reporting. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Visual Storytelling: Deliver 15–25+ professionally edited, high-quality interior and exterior photos that make our listings pop.
  • Immersive Tech: Capture Zillow 3D tours and digital floor plans using a 360° camera to provide prospective tenants with a "true-to-life" experience.
  • Property Stewardship: Perform initial property walkthroughs and submit comprehensive condition reports to ensure our high standards are met.
  • Operational Logistics: Take the lead on key management, including the pick-up, installation, and battery maintenance of smart lockboxes.
  • High-Velocity Response: Maintain a "Be Better" mindset by responding promptly to new assignments and ensuring a 24-hour turnaround on all reports and deliverables.
  • Territory Mastery: Serving our local community and surrounding region, with a willingness to travel a 35–50+ mile radius to support our expanding market.

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.
  • Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.
  • Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.
  • Mobile Proficiency: An updated mobile device capable of capturing clear, detailed images for on-site walkthrough reports.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Excellent written communication skills and a professional demeanor when representing the Ziprent/TurboTenant brand.
  • Reliability: A valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and a flexible schedule to handle multiple shoots per month.
  • Location: You must live within 35 miles of the market area to be considered for this role.

Bonus SuperPowers:

  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with FHA and housing compliance (smoke alarms, CO detectors, etc.).
  • Efficient Workflow: You stay ahead of the curve by leveraging modern tools and smart processes to streamline documentation, reporting, and day-to-day tasks—maximizing productivity without sacrificing quality.
  • Tech Comfort: You have a "can-do" attitude when it comes to learning new property management software.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You use modern tools to streamline your editing or reporting process for maximum efficiency.
  • Hyper-Detail Oriented: You notice the small things—from a loose door handle to a flickering light—that others might miss.

Our "Be Better" Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

  1. You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.
  2. You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.
  3. You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it. Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords.

Quantity of Jobs:

Number of job requests varies by market region. This is a contracted 1099 position, and requests are sent out on an as-needed basis. Most markets average 3 –10+ jobs per month.

Candidates should be flexible and comfortable with limited assignments initially while the market and workload grow.

The role requires completion of a background check and signing of an independent contractor agreement.

Compensation

    • $225–$325+ per listing appointment (varies based on property size and scope)
      • Includes: professionally edited photos, Zillow 3D tour, floor plan, initial walkthrough report, and lockbox installation with key management
    • $50/hour for additional as-needed tasks
    • Lockbox Pick-Up:
      • $30–$60 per lockbox (depending on distance)
    • Travel Compensation:
      • Paid for travel exceeding 35 miles each way (70 miles round trip)
      • Reimbursed at $1.20 per mile beyond this threshold

Salary Range
$1—$100,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

description:
