title: RESEARCH ASSISTANT II - Chanda Lab
description:
ABOUT US:

Scripps Research is a nonprofit biomedical institute ranked as one of the most influential in the world for its impact on innovation. We celebrated our 100-year legacy in 2024. This significant milestone marks a century of seminal discoveries in immunology, infectious diseases (such as COVID-19, flu, HIV), neuroscience, heart disease, cancer, and more. Located in La Jolla, California, the institute houses six research departments, multiple Nobel laureates, a top-ranked graduate school and a leading postdoctoral training program. Scripps Research encompasses two elite and highly innovative institutes, the Calibr-Skaggs Institute for Innovative Medicines and Scripps Research Translational Institute, which merge foundational studies in biology, chemistry and computer science with translational science to produce pioneering drugs and advances in digital and precision medicine. Together, we cultivate new scientific leaders and expand the frontiers of knowledge to deliver medical breakthroughs impacting human health around the globe. If you have a passion for making a difference, this could be your opportunity to join our transformative team.

POSITION TITLE: Research Assistant II

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Research Assistant will support the High Throughput Screening Core’s Year 4 antiviral drug discovery efforts. Responsibilities include assisting with ongoing screening campaigns against coronavirus NSP13 helicase and Dengue NS1, and with finalizing DNA-encoded library and fragment-based screens. The Research Assistant will also help implement counter-screens for off-target effects and cytotoxicity, ensuring that only high-quality hits advance. Day-to-day work includes assay setup and execution in microplate formats, compound handling, data collection, and documentation.

RESPOSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

  • Human primary cell and cell line culture, preparation of media and reagents.
  • Compound handling and plate inventory.
  • Develop in vitro assays for BSL2-level viruses to enable drug discovery flowcharts.
  • Execute high-throughput assays against for screening campaigns.
  • The position requires great attention to detail, dexterity of the hands, troubleshooting capability and flexibility to adapt to a fast-paced environment.
  • Provide interpretation and analyses of results. Troubleshoot and modify procedures.
  • Perform general lab duties as required or assigned.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Requires a bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline or an equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience from which comparable knowledge, skill and abilities have been attained.
  • Requires 3-5 years’ experience. Candidates possessing a master’s degree, 2+ years’ experience required.

PHYSICAL REQUIRMENTS:

  • This position works in a laboratory or vivarium environment.
  • Details of established essential functions for this position will be addressed/discussed during the interview process.

COMPENSATION: The expected hiring range for this position is $70,304 to $77,000 per year, commensurate with experience. Consideration will be given to experience that exceeds the listed requirements.

COMPREHENSIVE BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Employer Contributed Retirement Plan – Depending on eligibility, employees receive an employer contributed retirement plan (no employee contribution required) and the option to contribute to a 403(b) (which is similar to a 401(k) using your own pre or post-tax dollars)
  • Full Suite of Health and Welfare plans including three medical plan options (including an HSA available option), dental, vision, life insurance, disability, EAP and more
    Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical/Dependent Care)

A day-in-the-life:

title: Commercial Banking Officer, SVP (47376)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The SVP, Senior Commercial Banking Officer manages the Bank’s most complex and strategically important commercial relationships while leading significant market-growth and business-development efforts. The position serves as a trusted advisor to clients and centers of influence, structures sophisticated credit solutions, and coordinates enterprise resources to expand relationships. The Senior Commercial Banking Officer also strengthens team capability by mentoring Commercial Banking Officers and Client Portfolio Managers and by modeling disciplined relationship management, credit judgment, and market leadership.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Business Development
    • Prospect for and originate new commercial relationships through disciplined calling, referrals, centers of influence, community involvement, and market-development activities.
    • Lead significant new-business development within assigned markets, industries, or strategic segments and maintain a strong, qualified pipeline.
    • Build and leverage relationships with high-impact centers of influence, community leaders, professional advisors, and prospective clients.
    • Represent the Bank in visible community and market activities that support reputation, referrals, and sustainable relationship growth.
  • Portfolio & Relationship Management
    • Manage a select portfolio of commercial banking relationships, with accountability for client retention, relationship growth, and overall portfolio quality.
    • Monitor financial performance and credit risk, proactively addressing emerging issues and partnering with Credit as appropriate.
    • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, identifying banking solutions that support their business and financial objectives.
    • Provide strategic financial guidance and banking solutions based on an understanding of clients’ businesses, financial needs, and long-term objectives.
    • Transitions appropriate relationships and credit opportunities to designated portfolio managers, while maintaining continuity in the client relationship and supporting an effective handoff.
  • Credit Structuring & Profitability
    • Structure and advocate for complex credit solutions with appropriate pricing, terms, collateral, covenants, and risk mitigants consistent with policy and risk appetite.
    • Provide clear, complete, and persuasive credit narratives.
    • Partner effectively with Credit leadership on complex requests.
    • Balance strategic value, client needs, profitability, concentration, credit quality, and long-term relationship potential.
    • Support resolution of complex credit, relationship, or service concerns and ensure commitments are communicated and executed effectively.
  • Mentoring & Leadership
    • Mentor Commercial Banking Officers and Client Portfolio Managers in business development, relationship planning, credit judgment, client communication, and market engagement.
    • Develop bankers and invite them to join appropriate calls and provide practical coaching and feedback that builds readiness for greater relationship ownership.
    • Share market intelligence, relationship opportunities, and effective practices across the commercial banking team.
  • Decision Making & Judgement
    • Exercise a high degree of independent judgment in evaluating, structuring, and negotiating complex commercial banking opportunities within established credit and risk parameters.
    • Balance growth, profitability, client needs, and credit risk when determining relationship strategy, deal structure, pricing, and appropriate solutions.
    • Determine when relationships should be retained or transitioned to portfolio managers, balancing client continuity with the need to maintain capacity for new business development.
    • Recognize when complex or higher-risk matters require additional expertise or escalation and engages Credit, Risk, or Bank leadership as appropriate.

title: IBCLC, Telehealth Lactation Consultant
description:
About SimpliFed

SimpliFed is a virtual maternal health company. We start with feeding support (lactation care, pumping and supply help, and prescribing for breast pumps and related needs) and build from there into care across pregnancy and postpartum, including postpartum mood screening and connection to the right next level of care. Our clinicians see families by video across the U.S., working alongside health plans, health systems, and breast pump suppliers.

We believe the key to every happy, healthy baby is a happy, healthy parent.

How we think about feeding

We help families feed their babies in whatever way works for them: nursing, exclusive pumping, formula, combination feeding, donor milk, supplementing, or weaning. Our job is to give parents accurate information and real support for their goals, not to judge their choices. A confident, supported parent and a fed, growing baby are the outcomes we care about.

We hire clinicians who share this view and show it in how they talk with families.

The role

You'll see new and expecting parents by video for lactation and feeding visits: assessment, care planning, and ongoing support through their feeding journey. This is a lactation role and does not include prescribing. You'll work closely with our nurse practitioners, who handle breast pump orders and medications.

What you'll do

  • Run prenatal and postpartum video visits covering feeding assessment, latch and positioning, milk supply, pumping and flange fit, supplementing, bottle feeding, formula transitions, and weaning.
  • Build practical care plans around each family's own feeding goals.
  • Screen for red flags (infant weight and hydration, parental pain or infection, postpartum mood) and escalate or refer per SimpliFed protocols.
  • Hand off to our NP/APP team when a visit shows a need for a breast pump order or medication.
  • Document every visit clearly and on time in our EHR.
  • Follow families across multiple visits, not just one.

Required

  • Current IBCLC certification (IBLCE), in good standing.
  • Available at least 15 hours a week. 20+ hours preferred.
  • A private, quiet space for video visits, reliable high-speed internet, and a computer with a camera that meets our telehealth platform requirements.

Preferred

  • The same days and times each week (fixed weekly blocks).
  • 20+ hours a week, including evening or weekend blocks. We see families 8am to 10pm ET.
  • Telehealth lactation experience, including prenatal and pump consults.
  • An individual NPI and an active CAQH profile; current enrollment with major health plans.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English (or another language our families speak).
  • Experience working alongside prescribers (NP or MD) in shared care.
  • A Connecticut or Rhode Island lactation consultant license. Both states license lactation consultants; tell us if you hold either.
  • An RN license? See our Registered Nurse, IBCLC role.

Where we're hiring

IBCLC is a national certification, so we hire from every state. Demand is highest for families in:

States

Demand

Florida, New York, California, Texas

Highest

New Jersey, North Carolina, Virginia, Georgia

Strong and steady

Illinois, Maryland, Arizona, Pennsylvania

Solid and growing

Because we cover families across time zones until 10pm ET, clinicians in Central, Mountain, and Pacific time who can take evening Eastern blocks are especially helpful.

Schedule and commitment

We're building a team of fewer, more committed clinicians rather than a large panel of low-hour contractors. It gets families seen faster and gives you a steadier caseload. We look for at least 15 hours a week of availability. Clinicians who can offer the same days and times each week, and more hours, get priority scheduling and more volume.

Getting started

After you accept an offer, you'll start an onboarding period: credentialing, systems setup, and training. Our aim is to have you seeing families as soon as possible, though please note that credentialing can take between 30 and 90 days.

Credentialing with licensing boards and health plans can take 30 to 90 days from your hire date to delivering care, depending on your licenses and which health plans you'll see patients under. We'll tell you up front what to expect for your situation and start the paperwork the day you accept.

Pay

Hourly rates for 1099 contract roles, by regional market tier (based on where you live):

  • Tier 1 (CA, NY, MA, NJ, HI, MD): $48–$53/hr
  • Tier 2 (IL, CO, OR, VA, PA, AZ, MN): $42–$46/hr
  • Tier 3 (NC, GA, FL, TX, TN, OH, MI, IN, SC, WI, MO, and states not listed): $38–$42/hr
  • Tier 4 (MS, AR, WV, KY, OK, AL, LA): $34–$38/hr

Part-time and full-time W2 roles are also available for clinicians who commit to more hours.

  • Own the reporting that lenders, investors, fund leadership and the investment teams rely on.

Operating partners and property management

  • Guide the regional teams on partner and manager performance, and help get results where assets are behind plan.
  • Set what partners and managers deliver — reporting, meeting rhythm and the information Bridge needs to exercise its approval rights.
  • Own the third-party property manager relationships — scorecards, benchmarking, agreement standards, and selection and transitions with the regional Directors.
  • Manage outsourced and offshore support — scope, service levels and quality control.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point on operating issues, and bring operating insight to underwriting, reforecasts and valuations.

What you should bring

Required

  • 10+ years of institutional commercial real estate experience, including significant senior-level multifamily asset management.
  • Hands-on lease-up experience on newly delivered ground-up multifamily.
  • A record of improving net operating income across a portfolio, backed by strong command of operating financials, revenue management and capital planning.
  • Experience building or materially improving asset management processes, reporting standards and performance frameworks.
  • Portfolio-level oversight of third-party property managers, including manager transitions.
  • A history of getting results through teams you don't manage, including joint venture partners where influence runs through consent and approval rights.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in real estate, finance, accounting, business or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of Yardi, Entrata or RealPage.
  • Experience integrating an asset management function across regions or platforms.
  • Closed-end fund reporting and valuation experience.
  • Mixed-use or ground-floor retail exposure.

What Success Looks Like

  • New deliveries lease up on plan, with the regional teams working from clear lease-up standards.
  • Every region runs on the same business plan format, review cadence and reporting templates.
  • Operating partners and property managers are measured against clear scorecards, and underperformance is caught early and fixed.
  • Portfolio-wide initiatives in revenue management, insurance, property taxes and vendor contracts show up in net operating income.

What you can be part of

You'll define how a national multifamily portfolio is managed, at the center of value creation for our funds. You'll have direct visibility to senior leadership and work closely with investment, portfolio management, debt capital markets and property management teams across the firm.

Are you ready to make your mark?

If you are an Aerospace Development Assembly and Test Technician with hands-on experience in aerospace systems, testing, and troubleshooting, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team. In this role, you will build and test development hardware, support data acquisition and analysis, and work with hydraulic, pneumatic, and mechanical systems in a fast-paced engineering environment.


** This is a 1st shift position, Monday to Friday, starting at 5am.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assembly: Assemble components and systems with increasing complexity. Modify and/or repair components under minimal supervision. Assist in troubleshooting issues.
  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: Identify and propose solutions for moderately complex issues with components or systems. Collaborate with stakeholders and implement solution.
  • Testing and Analysis: Conduct moderately complex tests on components and systems with some independence. Record and analyze test results and provide preliminary findings to engineering teams
  • Process Improvement: Suggest improvements to existing processes or tools based on hands-on experience. Participate in creating or updating process documentation.
  • Team Leadership: Act as a resource for entry-level technicians by guiding them on basic tasks and safety procedures.

Key Skills:

  • Schematics and Drawings: Capable of independently reading and interpreting moderately complex schematics and drawings. Begin modifying drawings and schematics with guidance. Growing knowledge of assembly and testing processes and geometric tolerancing.
  • Application and Field Use Knowledge: Solid understanding of deployed systems and component operation. Independently applies standard assembly and testing methodologies. Familiar with relevant industry standards.
  • Communication: Develops clear written and verbal communication skills. Able to present findings to internal teams and contribute to discussions about test results. Occasional exposure to customer interactions.
  • Team Leadership: Provides guidance to entry-level technicians on basic tasks. Assists with organizing smaller projects.
  • Process Improvement: Participates in efforts to improve processes or tools. Suggest ideas to enhance efficiency and quality within established systems.
  • Problem Solving: Independently solves moderately complex problems using basic troubleshooting techniques. Begins applying structured methods such as Root Cause Analysis with guidance.
  • Assembly: Independently assembles and modifies moderately complex components and systems. Assists with improving assembly methods.
  • Devices and Tools Used: Proficient in using a range of standard measurement devices for data acquisition and analysis. Begins designing basic fixture or rigging equipment for assembly and testing.
  • Principles & Data Review: Solid understanding of mechanical principles and their application in moderately complex systems. Independently conducts basic testing and data collection.
  • Testing: Plans and execute moderately complex test strategies with minimal supervision, providing preliminary analysis and feedback on results.

Successful Candidates Typically Have:

  • Experience performing assembly and testing of fuel system components in the aerospace industry
  • Proficiency in fabrication techniques
  • Working knowledge of hydraulic, pneumatic, mechanical, and electrical systems
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving abilities
  • A&P license preferred, but not required

Additional Requirements:

  • Moderate physical activity requires agility and dexterity, including walking, standing, or bending; and lifting or moving objects up to 20 pounds. Note: Some product lines have heavier lifting requirements due to product type. Ability to stand for entire shift. Work is performed in an area with moderate risk or discomfort that may require special safety precautions, such as wearing protective clothing or gear. May be required to pass Near vision and/or Color vision examinations

title: Real Estate Photographer - Grovetown, GA
description:
Role Mission

Are you a visual storyteller with an eye for detail and a knack for seamless execution?

Ziprent (a subsidiary of TurboTenant) is looking for a independent contractor (1099) Real Estate Photographer & Field Operations Specialist to be our eyes and ears on the ground. This isn’t just about snapping a few photos; it’s about crafting the digital first impression for our rental properties and ensuring every home is "rent-ready" through meticulous property walkthroughs and technical setups.

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. You’ll work independently to manage everything from 3D tours and high-fidelity photography to smart lockbox installations and condition reporting. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Visual Storytelling: Deliver 15–25+ professionally edited, high-quality interior and exterior photos that make our listings pop.
  • Immersive Tech: Capture Zillow 3D tours and digital floor plans using a 360° camera to provide prospective tenants with a "true-to-life" experience.
  • Property Stewardship: Perform initial property walkthroughs and submit comprehensive condition reports to ensure our high standards are met.
  • Operational Logistics: Take the lead on key management, including the pick-up, installation, and battery maintenance of smart lockboxes.
  • High-Velocity Response: Maintain a "Be Better" mindset by responding promptly to new assignments and ensuring a 24-hour turnaround on all reports and deliverables.
  • Territory Mastery: Serving our local community and surrounding region, with a willingness to travel a 35–50+ mile radius to support our expanding market.

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.
  • Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.
  • Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.
  • Mobile Proficiency: An updated mobile device capable of capturing clear, detailed images for on-site walkthrough reports.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Excellent written communication skills and a professional demeanor when representing the Ziprent/TurboTenant brand.
  • Reliability: A valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and a flexible schedule to handle multiple shoots per month.
  • Location: You must live within 35 miles of the market area to be considered for this role.

Bonus SuperPowers:

  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with FHA and housing compliance (smoke alarms, CO detectors, etc.).
  • Efficient Workflow: You stay ahead of the curve by leveraging modern tools and smart processes to streamline documentation, reporting, and day-to-day tasks—maximizing productivity without sacrificing quality.

Our "Be Better" Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

  1. You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it. Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords.

Number of job requests varies by market region. This is a contracted 1099 position, and requests are sent out on an as-needed basis. Most markets average 3 –10+ jobs per month.

Candidates should be flexible and comfortable with limited assignments initially while the market and workload grow.

The role requires completion of a background check and signing of an independent contractor agreement.

Compensation

    • $225–$325+ per listing appointment (varies based on property size and scope)
      • Includes: professionally edited photos, Zillow 3D tour, floor plan, initial walkthrough report, and lockbox installation with key management
    • $50/hour for additional as-needed tasks
    • Lockbox Pick-Up:
      • $30–$60 per lockbox (depending on distance)
    • Travel Compensation:
      • Paid for travel exceeding 35 miles each way (70 miles round trip)
      • Reimbursed at $1.20 per mile beyond this threshold

Salary Range
$1—$100,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

POSITION

We are currently seeking a strong Systems Analyst to play a key role, deliver solutions to our business partners, solve complex problems, and strive to advance and sustain world-class technology platforms. This position requires strong analytical skills, with a high attention to detail, and a desire to analyze and solve complex problems. This individual must be a self-starter with the ability to multi-task and work on a variety of assignments with people across the organization. Excellent organization, communication, and delivery skills are required. This individual must be a team player with a desire and willingness to learn.

The Portfolio Accounting Technology team is responsible for delivering technology solutions to support various functions within the firm, including investment teams, client servicing, portfolio operations etc . The team plays a critical role in our firm’s success by providing technical solutions which improve the efficiency, speed and quality of the highly complex investment decision-making process.

JOB OVERVIEW

At Wellington Management you will continually learn, develop, and expand your skills. As part of an inclusive culture, you will meet smart, progressive individuals who will challenge you to solve problems, anticipate our clients’ needs, and enhance our proprietary systems and platforms. This is a great opportunity for an experienced Lead Analyst to join a strong, collaborative team in a role focusing on analysis with leadership and advancement opportunities. The individual will be responsible for requirements, systems analysis, testing, and project management. This position requires a high level of direct interaction with business users and excellent communication and delivery skills. This individual must be a self-starter with the ability to multi-task and work on a variety of assignments with people at all levels of the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interact directly with business partners at all levels of the organization to define, analyze and document requirements, as well as set priorities
  • Act as a champion for the needs of the business partners and a trusted advisor
  • Develop a strong partnership with the delivery team
  • Ensure on time, scalable and high-quality business solutions
  • Provide input into system design to help the programming teams define effort and implementation schedules
  • Ensure quality of product by enforcing high standards in testing and building audit/validation controls
  • Act as an escalation point person for support issues that require detailed analysis and management
  • Provide regular status reporting and issue tracking

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Business, Economics, Finance, or other related subjects
  • 3+ years of systems analysis experience in investment management or financial services industry
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal requirements for functional specifications, use cases, and test plans
  • Strong client relationship skills and proven ability to build consensus
  • Experience working directly with business partners to understand their needs and deliver solutions that meet those needs
  • Change agent, creative, innovative, and focused on continuous improvements
  • Self-motivated and willing to work in an energetic, fast paced team environment
  • Strategic mindset and intellectual curiosity
  • Hands-on knowledge of SQL and relational database technology

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

As an equal opportunity employer, Wellington Management ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, religion, creed, national origin, age, ancestry, disability (physical or mental), medical condition, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at GMWTalentOperations@wellington.com.

At Wellington Management, our approach to compensation is designed to help us attract, inspire and retain the best talent in our industry. We strive to pay employees fairly and competitively across all levels and roles. Our approach to compensation considers all aspects of total compensation; all employees are eligible to receive salary, variable compensation, and benefits. The base salary range for this position is:

USD 80,000 - 150,000

This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; role; skills and experience; certifications; and education. This range is an estimate, and further details on salary and total compensation aspects will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process.

Base salary is only one component of Wellington’s total compensation approach. Other rewards may include a discretionary Corporate Bonus and/ or Incentives, if eligible. In addition, we offer a comprehensive and high value benefit package to meet the unique needs of our employees and their families, and we are committed to fostering a flexible work environment that enables employees to thrive personally and professionally. Examples of our benefits include retirement plan, health and wellbeing, dental, vision, and pharmacy coverage, health savings account, flexible spending accounts and commuter program, employee assistance program, life and disability insurance, adoption assistance, back-up childcare, tuition/CFA reimbursement and paid time off (leave of absence, paid holidays, volunteer, sick and vacation time)

We believe that in person interactions inspire and energize our community and are essential to our culture. In support of this commitment, our employees work from our offices 4 days a week with flexibility to work remotely 1 day a week. We believe that this approach ultimately supports our mission to deliver investment excellence to our clients and their beneficiaries over the long term.

title: Design Consultant
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

As a member of the Hunter Douglas family of brands, SPF Screens & Awnings is the unrivaled leader in the realm of retractable awnings and motorized sunscreens throughout Florida, Georgia, North Carolina and Texas. Over the past 14 years we have been transforming our customers' outdoor space into a place they can enjoy with their family and friends without the inconvenience of bugs, sun and wind.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Design Consultant – In-home Sales Pro

SPF Screens & Awnings is the unrivaled leader in retractable awnings and motorized sun shades across several states in the US. As part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands, we’ve spent over 15 years transforming outdoor living spaces with premium, custom solutions. . As part of the Hunter Douglas family of brands, we’ve spent over 15 years transforming outdoor living spaces with premium, custom solutions.

Here at SPF, we are a solution-based company, with a team that genuinely has each other’s backs. This role gives you a steady stream of pre-set, high-quality appointments, strong marketing support, and the freedom to own your territory like it’s your own business. We are selectively expanding our sales team and are seeking proven sales professionals who thrive in a performance-driven, high-ticket environment.

This is not a training role. This is a closer’s seat.

The Opportunity

As a Design Consultant (DC), you will run pre-set appointments per day, generated by aggressive company marketing. Your role is to deliver confident, consultative presentations and drive decisive buying outcomes for homeowners investing in premium outdoor living solutions.

Top performers in this role consistently:

  • Surpass the average close rate of 25% of their issued appointments
  • Generate $125,000–$150,000+ in monthly sales
  • Operate a strong one-call-close process with disciplined follow-up

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver professional, consultative presentations focused on value - not price
  • Confidently ask for the sale and drive one-call closes whenever possible
  • Own your pipeline from first appointment through installation, following up strategically with issued quotes to maximize close rate
  • Be in control of your own compensation by generating additional revenue through referrals, repeat business, and local partnerships
  • Step in and support nearby territories when needed - because there’s truly no ‘I’ in team, but there is an ‘us’ in success, as long as you look at it the right way
  • Maintain expert-level CRM pipeline management and communication standards

Who This Role Is For:

  • Have 2-5+ years of high-ticket, consultative sales experience (move to the front of the line with in-home sales background)
  • Have consistently overachieved revenue goals set by company, ideally in a commission-based role
  • Thrive in a performance-driven environment with clear metrics, taking full ownership of your results, both wins and losses
  • Are confident, polished, and highly persuasive in the home, presenting premium pricing
  • Manage your time, territory, and follow-up like the pro you are

This Role Is Not For You If You:

  • Are unable to overcome objections and have to rely on heavy discounts to close
  • Need scripting, micromanagement, or lack the ability to motivate yourself
  • Are uncomfortable being measured by close rate and revenue

Compensation & Support

  • Uncapped commission structure – which for our top consultants is $150,000- $250,000+ annually. DCs not yet maximizing their territory typically see an average annual income of $80-$90k
  • Salaried training (2 weeks) & salary + commission during ramp-up period (10 weeks)
  • Company-generated, qualified appointments (no cold prospecting required)
  • $500 monthly car allowance + toll reimbursement
  • Sales iPad, product samples, and professional measuring equipment provided
  • Full benefits package:
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-term disability, Accident
  • 401(k) with 6% match

You focus on closing deals, we handle marketing, production, and installation!

Schedule & Requirements

  • Full-time, 5 days per week. Must be available to conduct weekend and evening sales appointments.
  • Reliable personal vehicle, valid driver’s license, and a willingness to travel within assigned territory
  • Ability to lift up to 40lbs

Why Top Performers Choose SPF

  • Premium product with strong market differentiation
  • High average ticket and strong close potential
  • Consistent appointment flow backed by marketing
  • Long-term territory ownership
  • Leadership that recognizes and rewards performance

If you are a proven closer looking for a platform that rewards excellence, we want to talk to you.

All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a background check and pre-employment drug screening. Because driving a vehicle is an essential function of this role, candidates must also meet our insurance carrier's minimum age requirement of 21 years.

description:
Be Part of Building the Future

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost. Learn more at

About the role

Dremio's Query Planner & Reflections (QPR) team owns the SQL planner and optimizer — built on Apache Calcite — and the reflections substitution engine that transparently rewrites queries to hit pre-computed materializations instead of raw source data. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll set technical direction for this system: driving ambiguous, cross-team initiatives, raising the bar through design and code review, and helping other engineers.

What you'll be doing

  • Set architecture and technical direction for the Query Planner and Reflections team spanning next-generation features across OSS, Enterprise, and Cloud editions.
  • Own design, implementation, and delivery of complex initiatives that cross team boundaries (Query Execution, Catalog, Datalake).
  • Work deeply with Apache Calcite and Apache Iceberg, including driving contributions upstream where it benefits Dremio.
  • Diagnose the hardest correctness and performance issues in query planning and reflection matching using query profiles, telemetry, and production data.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools for code comprehension, debugging, test generation, documentation, and incident analysis, and apply engineering judgment to validate AI-generated code through review, testing, and benchmarking.
  • Design architectures that run correctly across deployment models and public clouds.
  • Participate in design and code reviews and set technical standards for the team.
  • Partner with Product on multi-quarter roadmap decisions and with Support and field teams on the highest-impact customer issues.

What we're looking for

  • B.S./M.S/Equivalent in Computer Science or a related technical field or equivalent experience
  • 8-10+ years of experience developing production-level software.
  • Fluency in Java/C++ is a plus.
  • Deep understanding of query planning and optimization: cost-based optimizers, rule-based rewriting, ideally hands-on with Apache Calcite or a similar framework.
  • Strong database fundamentals: SQL, performance, schema design.
  • Track record of driving system-level architecture decisions and leading complex, cross-team initiatives.
  • Setting technical direction for the team or major component.
  • Ability to evaluate tradeoffs and make sound decisions when working with unfamiliar or AI-assisted implementations.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous, cross-org problems independently; strong communication skills.
  • Understanding of distributed file systems such as S3, ADLS, or HDFS; AWS, Azure, or GCP experience is a plus.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience with distributed query engines.
  • Hands-on experience in query processing or optimization, materialized view matching, distributed systems, concurrency control, code generation, Apache Arrow, caching, or disk spilling.
  • Contributions to Apache Calcite, Apache Iceberg, or similar open-source planner projects.

What we value

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here.

title: Lead Product Architect
description:
You’ve discovered something special. A company that cares. Cares about leading the way in construction, engineering, manufacturing and renewable energy. Cares about redefining how energy is designed, applied and consumed. Cares about thoughtfully growing to meet market demands. And ─ as “one of the Healthiest 100 Workplaces in America” ─ is focused on the mind/body/soul of team members through our Culture of Care.

The Lead Product Architect owns a specific product platform, ensuring technical architecture, requirements, standards, lessons learned, and reusable solutions continuously evolve throughout the complete product lifecycle. This individual leads the transformation of ambiguous concepts, customer needs, market requirements, manufacturing feedback, procurement opportunities, and site execution experience into standardized product architectures and clearly documented technical requirements.

The Lead Product Architect owns creation and maintenance of Product Requirements Documents (PRDs), Component Definition Documents (CDDs), specifications, scope documents and matrices, Illustrated Basis of Design (iBODs), client submittals, vendor and site specific permit submittals, and ETO submittal packages. This also includes development and maintenance of master Revit models, reusable BIM content, configuration standards, early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs), and design intent documentation that establish the engineering baseline for Detailed Design, including Engineering Bills of Material (EBOMs), fabrication and manufacturing documentation, while supporting strategic procurement activities.

This role directs Product Developers and collaborates closely with Preconstruction, Program Design Managers, Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, Virtual Design Construction (VDC), Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product architecture, requirements, and design intent remain aligned throughout the product lifecycle.

The Lead Product Architect ensures product decisions made during concept development optimize the entire value stream including detailed design, supply chain, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, site installation, commissioning, and long-term product evolution.

Ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in leading ETO product development and lifecycle improvement, developing Modular Product Platforms or other complex integrated systems, product platform ownership and technical decision making, leading concept development and product standardization, and creating scalable product architectures and reusable design components. Will have experience developing, owning, and maintaining PRDs, CDDs, specifications, iBODs, scope documents/matrices, and product requirements as well as managing programmatic, site specific, vendor specific, and permit product submittal strategies. Experience reviewing and interpreting construction design documents and technical specifications, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams, as well as understanding concept development, engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, construction integration, commissioning, and lifecycle support. Will have demonstrated experience in driving Design for Manufacturing & Assembly (DFMA), cost optimization, quality improvement, and product scalability and leading cross-functional technical decisions and resolving complex product challenges. Will have an expert proficiency in Microsoft Office, Revit (BIM), Autodesk Forma, Navisworks, and Bluebeam as well as working knowledge of AutoCAD Electrical, Inventor (CAD), Vault (PDM), Fusion Manage (PLM), Acumatica (ERP), or related tools.


Success in this role requires the ability to think beyond individual projects and continuously strengthen the product platform through standardization, innovation, lessons learned, and lifecycle ownership.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or related technical discipline.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in engineering, product development, modular construction, manufacturing, or mission critical environments.

Travel: 10-50%

Work Schedule: This position works between the hours of 7 AM and 5 PM, Monday- Friday. However, work may be performed at any time on any day of the week to meet business needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads, coaches, and mentors direct reports.
  • Performs all responsibilities of Associate Product Architect while serving as technical owner for an assigned product platform across all clients and throughout the entire lifecycle.
  • Owns product architecture, standard designs, reusable components, configurations, and technical direction.
  • Maintains complete understanding of product capabilities, constraints, applications, and offerings.
  • Develops, owns, and maintains PRDs, CDDs, specifications, scope documents/matrices, iBODs, standards, and product documentation.
  • Develops and maintains master Revit models, reusable BIM content, product configuration standards, and digital product definition documentation.
  • Translates evolving concepts, customer needs, and business strategies into clear technical standards and requirements.
  • Leads creation of product definition packages for engineering execution.
  • Develops early Long Lead Equipment (LLE) Bills of Material (BOMs) supporting strategic procurement activities.
  • Directs Product Developers and coordinates engineering resources to ensure deliverables align with product requirements, architecture, and design intent.
  • Establishes the engineering baseline transitioned to Detailed Design for Inventor modeling, Engineering Bills of Material (E-BOMs), fabrication and manufacturing documentation, and engineering release.
  • Ensures alignment between product architecture, Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, VDC coordination, procurement strategy, manufacturing capability, constructability, installation, operations, and customer requirements.
  • Collaborates with Program Design Managers and Preconstruction to deliver optimized client solutions leveraging standard product platforms.
  • Collaborates with Detailed Design, Construction Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Operations, and other cross-functional stakeholders to establish the engineering baseline and support successful downstream execution.
  • Leads technical decision-making for assigned product platforms.
  • Champions product consistency and defend standards across implementations.
  • Captures and integrates lifecycle feedback from downstream execution teams.
  • Drives product evolution based on detailed design, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, deployment, and operational lessons learned.
  • Identifies innovation opportunities that improve cost, schedule, quality, safety, scalability, and lifecycle value.
  • Performs other related duties as required and assigned.

It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills, and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

This position will serve as a key representative of the VSN, building relationships with military-connected organizations, community partners, and military and veteran spouses and families to increase awareness of VSN programs, services, and resources.

Coordinate meetings and relationship-building activities, support collaborative initiatives and programs, and track and maintain partnership records and activities.

Bachelor's Degree in related field with at least 5 years of experience in program administration or program coordination. Excellent interpersonal, networking, and relationship-building skills. Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and represent an organization professionally within the community. Ability to travel regularly throughout the Fort Hood, Texas region and occasionally outside the region to support outreach and organizational activities. Experience working with military-connected, veteran, or caregiver populations. Familiarity with military culture and the Fort Hood, Texas military community. Experience developing and maintaining community partnerships. Experience conducting presentations, facilitating outreach activities, or representing an organization at public events. Experience supporting participant recruitment, engagement, or community-based programs. Knowledge of military and veteran family resources and challenges. Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) systems, data tracking systems, or outreach databases.

  • Repetitive use of a keyboard at a workstation

title: Senior Director, Head of Digital Strategy
description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world's most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.

As a Senior Director, Head of Digital Strategy, at Gilead you will lead the next evolution of digital customer engagement across our U.S. Commercial organization.

You will lead a team of Digital Strategy professionals who serve as strategic partners to Brand and therapeutic area leaders. You will establish the vision and standard for Digital Strategy across the portfolio, bringing together customer insights, media, content, data, technology, artificial intelligence (AI), and emerging capabilities to create connected experiences for healthcare professionals (HCPs) and patients.

This highly visible leadership role operates at the intersection of customer experience, media, data, technology, AI, and omnichannel engagement. You will translate these capabilities into strategies that address meaningful customer and business needs while helping Gilead anticipate how technological advances and changing customer behaviors are reshaping healthcare engagement.

Lead the Digital Strategy vision

  • Define and continuously evolve the vision, operating model, and strategic priorities for Digital Strategy across the U.S. Commercial portfolio.
  • Establish clear standards for digital and omnichannel strategy and raise the quality and consistency of customer engagement across therapeutic areas.
  • Ensure digital strategies begin with a clearly defined customer and business need rather than a specific channel or technology.
  • Identify the highest-value opportunities across the portfolio and focus Digital Strategy resources where they can create the greatest customer and business impact.

Partner with Brand and therapeutic area leadership

  • Serve as a senior strategic advisor to Brand and therapeutic area leaders on customer behavior, digital disruption, and emerging opportunities.
  • Translate Brand priorities into differentiated, connected customer experiences across channels.
  • Bring together customer insights, audience strategy, content, channels, data, and technology to support seamless HCP and patient journeys.
  • Translate sophisticated data and technology capabilities into clear, actionable strategies tied to customer and business needs.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across a complex, highly matrixed organization and build alignment around a common digital vision.

Connect and advance the digital ecosystem

  • Integrate expertise across media, AI, Digital Health, Analytics, customer relationship management (CRM), web, content, data, Digital Operations, and Technology into cohesive strategic recommendations.
  • Build strong partnerships with internal capability leaders, Information Technology, Operations, agencies, and external technology partners.
  • Anticipate how AI, search, emerging platforms, new data sources, and changes in HCP and patient behaviors may reshape healthcare engagement.
  • Translate emerging technologies into practical use cases and scalable opportunities for Gilead.
  • Lead the Digital Strategy innovation roadmap, identify opportunities to pilot, learn, optimize, and scale new approaches.
  • Advance more intelligent, personalized, and connected customer experiences across the portfolio.

Build organizational capability and drive measurable impact

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Digital Strategy professionals.
  • Build deep digital expertise while ensuring Digital Strategy remains closely connected to Brand priorities and customer needs.
  • Create mechanisms for sharing insights, practices, and learning across therapeutic areas so successful approaches can benefit the broader portfolio.
  • Establish clear measures of success grounded in customer and business outcomes rather than individual channel metrics.
  • Partner with Analytics and capability teams to develop learning agendas, measurement frameworks, and optimization approaches.
  • Apply insights and performance data to continuously improve customer experiences and inform investment decisions.
  • Scale successful approaches across brands and therapeutic areas where appropriate.

Success in this role will be demonstrated through the business and customer impact of digital strategies; increasingly connected experiences across media, content, CRM, web, data, and emerging channels; the effective testing and scaling of new capabilities; strong strategic partnerships with Brand and senior leaders; enterprise-wide sharing of successful approaches; and the attraction, development, and retention of digital talent.



Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and 14 years of relevant experience, OR Master’s Degree and 12 years of relevant experience, OR PhD and 12 years of relevant experience.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep expertise across omnichannel strategy, customer journey design, audience strategy, personalization, CRM, media, web, content, data, and marketing technology.
  • Experience connecting customer insights, first- and third-party data, and behavioral signals to activation strategies.
  • Strong understanding of AI and emerging technologies and their implications for customer engagement and marketing.
  • Experience with enterprise marketing platforms and ecosystems such as Salesforce, Sitecore, LiveRamp, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience translating data and technology capabilities into customer-focused strategies and scalable business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and operate effectively across complex, highly matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication, storytelling, facilitation, and influencing capabilities.
  • Experience balancing strategic direction with pragmatic execution and advancing ideas from concept through adoption and scale.
  • Pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience.
  • Experience working in regulated environments.
  • Agency, consulting, or technology experience, particularly when combined with client-side leadership experience.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.


People Leader Accountabilities

  • Create Inclusion – knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent – understand the skills, experience, aspirations, and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow and develop.

Consistent with our values, we welcome people from all backgrounds, cultures and experiences into our company because we believe it’s the right thing to do and the right way to run our business.

title: Director, Growth Strategy and Operations
description:
The Opportunity

The Director, Growth works alongside an assigned Team Principal/Growth Partner. This is an opportunity to partner directly with senior Flagship leadership, across Flagship functions, and GrowthCo teams to drive strategic and financial value creation across a portfolio of GrowthCo companies. This role is the central node for drawing on Flagship capabilities and serves as the primary coordinator among Flagship resources.

You will serve as the primary analytical, operational, and strategic business partner to their assigned Team Principal/Growth Partner(s) and will be a trusted number two in a fast-paced, analytic, execution-focused environment who helps extend the Principal's reach across multiple assigned GrowthCos. You will work with the Team Principal to ensure execution of each company’s Value Maximization Strategy, follow Flagship governance, and ensure collaboration across and among the appropriate Flagship teams.

This role offers rare, full-spectrum exposure across the strategic, operational, scientific, financial, and commercial imperatives that define company-building in life sciences; making it an exceptional opportunity for an emerging executive who wants to see and shape what it takes to build breakthrough companies from the inside.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Management and Governance Alignment

  • Serve as the Team Principal's right hand on day-to-day execution by keeping workstreams on track, flagging risks and issues early, anticipating what's next, and driving items to closure.
  • Support the Team Principal in ensuring alignment and coordination with Flagship governance processes, including elevating decision points in a timely manner, preparing high-quality materials and ensuring proper follow up at key decision-making forums.
  • Attend key meetings such as Growth Executive Sessions, Portfolio Decision Forums, Strategy Sessions, and Board Meetings to track and help advance key deliverables and ensure proper follow-up.
  • Maintain a clear, current view of each GrowthCo's priorities and open items so the Team Principal is never caught flat-footed; serving as the connective tissue between Flagship and company teams between formal touchpoints
  • Own the meeting-to-action loop: ensure that decisions made in governance forums translate into concrete next steps with clear owners and timelines, and that nothing falls through the cracks across a complex portfolio.

GrowthCo Partnership and Strategic Leadership

  • Ensure that GrowthCos are working in alignment with their Value Maximization Plans, encompassing platform strategy, pipeline prioritization, partnership opportunities, financing strategy, and organizational development.
  • Embed within GrowthCo leadership teams to build trusted relationships, understand evolving needs, and translate high-level strategies into concrete execution plans.
  • Alongside the Team Principal, and relevant senior FSP/portfolio company executives, to co-lead analyses that inform critical strategic recommendations, including (in concert with relevant FSP functional team):
  • Scientific development strategy and indication selection
  • Competitive intelligence and market opportunity assessment
  • Product development and pipeline strategy
  • Financial modeling, valuation, and capital allocation analysis
  • Partnership and business development strategy
  • Serve as an early warning system for the Team Principal; identifying when a GrowthCo is drifting from its Value Maximization Strategy absorbing early signals from company teams before they become escalation-worthy issues.
  • Help GrowthCo leadership teams think through the "Flagship angle" on key decisions (i.e. where sister company capabilities, portfolio relationships, or FSP resources could accelerate execution in ways the company might not see on its own).

Cross-Functional Coordination and Stakeholder Management

  • Lead coordination across Flagship internal functions including Capital Solutions, Strategic Business Operations, Business Development, Finance, HR, Legal/IP, Real Estate, Communications, Digital, Pioneering Medicines, and the Office of the CEO
  • Know when to convene versus when to inform. Develop sharp instincts for which cross-functional situations require active orchestration, and which just need a well-timed heads up, so the right people are engaged without creating unnecessary overhead.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships across functions proactively, not just when a GrowthCo need arises; so that when speed matters, the Crew Leader can move fast on behalf of the Team Principal without starting from scratch.

Team Integration and Portfolio Contribution

  • Remain tightly connected to the Growth Team, particularly fellow crew leaders, to stay aligned with portfolio-wide standards, frameworks, and innovations.
  • Contribute to shared knowledge bases, common operating models, benchmarking frameworks, and growth analytics that benefit the full GrowthCo portfolio.
  • Participate selectively in cross-portfolio initiatives, informing and learning from ecosystem-wide best practices.
  • Drive adoption of enterprise AI tools and best practices for operational scale, both within the Growth Team and across GrowthCos.
  • Actively bring patterns and insights from their own GrowthCo portfolio back to the broader Growth Team so individual company learnings compound into portfolio-wide intelligence rather than staying siloed.
  • Help newer or less-resourced GrowthCos benefit from the playbooks and relationships that more mature companies have developed, acting as a multiplier across the portfolio not just within their assigned companies.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in life sciences disciplines preferred, with related or equivalent work experience considered.
  • 5+ years of experience at the intersection of life sciences and business
  • Exposure to healthcare or life sciences — through prior roles, client work, or academic background — with interest in deepening operational and strategic experience in the sector.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand financial models, interpret complex datasets, and translate quantitative analysis into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Trusted, collaborative team player with high emotional intelligence, low ego, and a seasoned sense of curiosity.
  • Experience working closely with senior company leadership, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information for senior audiences and present financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high stakes workstreams with competing deadlines. High-level financial and scientific literacy sufficient to engage credibly across scientific, financing, and partnership discussions.
  • Experience operating under pressure, figuring things out without a playbook, and recognizing moments where they can make challenging things happen.
  • Confidence in knowing knowledge limitations, comfortable leaning on domain experts, asking the "obvious" question in the room, and building credibility through intellectual honesty.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Fluency across finance, science, and strategy
  • Effective time management, prioritization, and leadership skill
  • Trusted right hand— operates with their authority and extends their reach across multiple companies
  • Collaborative spirit and cross-functional effectiveness across Flagship and GrowthCo teams
  • Demonstrated ownership and accountability; ability to see gaps and fill them without being asked, and who holds themselves accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.
  • Comfortable being a smart generalist in a room full of specialists and able to engage credibly across disciplines without needing to be the domain expert, and confident enough to drive decisions forward even in areas of uncertainty.
  • Deep intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action and continuous improvement.
  • Roll-up-your-sleeves; entrepreneurial attitude and comfort operating with minimal direction in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Strategic mindset with strong critical thinking and problem-solving ability

LOCATION: Cambridge, MA. This position is full-time, on-site.

About Flagship Pioneering:

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond.

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.
Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

title: Case Manager (53341)
description:
OUR MISSION

The Family Place empowers survivors of family violence by providing safe housing, counseling, and skills that create independence while building community engagement and advocating for social change to stop family violence.

Position Summary:

As a Case Manager, you provide comprehensive case management and crisis intervention for adult and child survivors of domestic violence who are experiencing homelessness. This role requires a strong understanding of the dynamics and effects of domestic violence, trauma, and housing instability. It uses evidence-based interventions to help families develop healthy coping skills and move toward long-term stability. The Case Manager delivers holistic support through individualized service planning, referrals, advocacy, safety planning, group facilitation, and ongoing assessment to help clients rebuild safety and independence.

When you step into this role, you will be a lifeline for families transitioning from crisis to stability. Your work will directly support our mission to empower survivors of family violence by helping them access safe housing, secure essential resources, and rebuild their lives with dignity. Through trauma-informed care, consistent advocacy, and compassionate guidance, you will strengthen each family’s ability to heal, plan for the future, and thrive beyond violence. Your support ensures that clients receive the structure, safety, and connection they need to break cycles of abuse and create lasting change.

The shift for this position is Monday, Wednesday, and Friday (9:00 am-5:00 pm) Tuesday and Thursday 12:00 pm-8:00 pm

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides families with case management services, including but not limited to housing, employment, legal, and medical referrals.
  • Coordinates family case management meetings twice a month, as well as weekly case management meetings with the head of household.
  • Completes intake and orientation of services and discusses safety planning with clients.
  • Observes and documents weekly observations of each child within the family unit.
  • Assures Client First data entry is accurate and current, and assists in providing information for reports or statistical information when requested.
  • Facilitates weekly process groups and/or events using a variety of psychotherapy approaches (e.g., cognitive-behavioral, psycho-educational, client-centered) and based on systems theory and domestic violence research.
  • Responds appropriately to emergency situations utilizing de-escalation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Assists clients in obtaining community services and establishes referral relationships with other agencies to facilitate services.
  • Provides court advocacy and court testimony as needed.
  • Provides training, supervision, and support to volunteers and interns as assigned.
  • Represents the agency in special groups and community education activities.
  • Participates in in-service training programs and workshops to update professional knowledge; maintains current professional knowledge of domestic violence, crisis theory, and community resources, including assessments of danger, and resources of direct solution.
  • Attends and participates in case staffing on a weekly basis.
  • Works assigned schedule with adequate flexibility, may be required to provide support during other hours.

Performs other job-related duties as assigned

description:
Babel Street is the trusted technology partner for the world’s most advanced identity intelligence and risk operations. We deliver advanced AI and data analytics solutions providing unmatched, analysis-ready data regardless of language, proactive risk identification, 360-degree insights, high-speed automation, and seamless integration into existing systems. Babel Street empowers government and commercial organizations to transform high-stakes identity and risk operations into a strategic advantage. The actionable insights we deliver safeguard lives and protect critical assets around the world. Babel Street is headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with regional offices in Boston, MA and Cleveland, OH, and international offices in Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, and the U.K. For more information, visit .

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer to build and evolve the data systems that power Babel Street’s enterprise applications.

In this hands-on role, you will design, build, and operate backend services that ingest, process, index, store, and serve large volumes of data. You will collaborate with other engineers to plan feature enhancements, make architectural decisions, and deliver reliable, scalable solutions from design through production.

You will also use AI-assisted and agentic development tools to improve engineering productivity and help strengthen our practices for incorporating these tools into everyday development.

This position is ideally near our Somerville, MA office but remote candidates will be considered. Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

Why This Role Matters

You will help Babel Street transform vast, fast-moving streams of data into intelligence that customers use to make critical decisions. The backend systems you build will power this transformation by ingesting, processing, indexing, and serving data at the speed and scale those decisions demand.

You will help shape how Babel Street applies agentic development across the software lifecycle. You will work with engineers across the organization to make coding agents effective, secure, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Backend Engineering: Design, implement, test, and maintain backend services and data-processing pipelines using C# and .NET.
  • Data Processing and Search: Build and optimize systems for ingesting, indexing, storing, querying, and serving large datasets using Elasticsearch and SQL Server.
  • Performance and Scalability: Identify bottlenecks and improve service performance, query efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
  • Production Ownership: Own services throughout their lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through deployment and ongoing operation.
  • On-Call Support: Participate in an on-call rotation supporting systems that operate 24/7. Use metrics, logs, and alerts to investigate incidents, resolve issues, and implement improvements that reduce recurrence.
  • Technical Collaboration: Contribute to architectural discussions, lead design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers.
  • Development Practices: Evaluate and recommend improvements to our technology, tooling, and engineering workflows.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI-assisted tools for implementation, testing, and refactoring while maintaining accountability for code quality, security, and correctness.
  • Security and Compliance: Develop and maintain software in accordance with FedRAMP security and compliance requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience building and supporting enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, including designing, building, and troubleshooting production backend services.
  • Hands-on experience designing, operating, and optimizing Lucene-based search platforms, preferably Elasticsearch, including index design, mappings, query tuning, and cluster maintenance.
  • Strong SQL Server and T-SQL skills, including relational schema design, stored procedures, indexing, and query performance tuning.
  • Experience building, maintaining, and scaling data-intensive backend services.
  • Experience deploying and supporting production workloads on AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience troubleshooting production systems using metrics, logs, and alerting.
  • Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively on a distributed team, and communicate technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience delivering software in an agile development environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing and maintaining FedRAMP security controls for production software and cloud infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, operating, and scaling backend services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools for implementation, testing, and refactoring.
  • Experience with distributed systems and high-volume data-processing pipelines.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical improvements.

Benefits at Babel Street (just to name a few...)

  • Health Benefits: Babel Street covers 85-100% monthly premium costs for Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability insurances – for you and your family!
  • Retirement Plans: Babel Street offers both a Traditional and Roth 401(K) with a very competitive match.
  • Unlimited Flexible Leave: We trust our employees to manage their own time and balance their personal and work lives.
  • Holidays: Babel Street provides employees with 12 paid Federal Holidays
  • Tuition Reimbursement: We are committed to investing in our employees. One way we do that is with our Tuition Reimbursement Program for continuing education.
