The role is accountable for setting and governing data and analytics standards, reusable architecture patterns, delivery methods, and production-readiness expectations across a multi-OpCo, multi-brewery, multi-use-case ecosystem. Connected Brewery should be treated as a scalable data product landscape, not as a single delivery stream. The Tech Lead partners with the Product Owner and leads alignment across squad leads, technical leads, platform teams, breweries, OpCos, and global analytics stakeholders to ensure that delivery decisions support both immediate programme outcomes and reusable enterprise capability. The role is accountable for defining, managing, and executing the short-, medium-, and long-term technical roadmap of the chapter. This includes capability planning, technical risk management, architecture pattern approval, dependency resolution, and the creation of reusable data product patterns that can scale beyond individual use cases or sites. The role ensures that data pipelines, BI outputs, semantic-layer inputs, analytical solutions, and machine-learning-ready datasets are scalable, reusable, reliable, observable, secure, supportable, and designed for adoption across multiple breweries and OpCos. The Tech Lead enables squads to operate effectively within their delivery structures while owning cross-squad standards, architecture patterns, data product governance, production-readiness criteria, and downstream consumption requirements. The role is centred on building durable data foundations and reusable analytics capabilities across extraction, transformation, storage, quality assurance, integration, deployment, operational support, stakeholder engagement, and capability building across data professionals.

Your responsibilities would include:

Chapter Leadership and People Management:

  • leading and line-managing approximately 4–10 Data Engineers, BI Developers, and Data Scientists, including work allocation, coaching, performance management, development planning, and capacity planning
  • ownership of the chapter operating model, capability plan, skill matrix, succession risks, and hiring needs for the Connected Brewery data and analytics capability
  • setting technical expectations for chapter members and ensure consistent engineering, BI, analytics, documentation, and production-support practices
  • developing the technical career growth of chapter members through mentoring, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability building
  • governing vendor and contractor contribution where applicable, ensuring external delivery capacity follows chapter standards and contributes to reusable assets
  • definition and governance of the reusable data product patterns, architecture principles, semantic-layer inputs, BI delivery standards, and analytical delivery methods across breweries, OpCos, and use cases
  • approving key architecture patterns and manage technical trade-offs between tactical squad delivery, long-term scalability, operational supportability, and platform direction
  • leading cross-squad dependency management, delivery prioritisation, technical risk resolution, and alignment across squads, platform teams, breweries, and OpCos
  • ensuring that Connected Brewery evolves as a scalable data product ecosystem with reusable methods, components, templates, and standards that can be adopted beyond individual sites. Scalable Data and Analytics Delivery
  • driving the delivery of scalable data pipelines, curated datasets, semantic-layer inputs, BI outputs, advanced analytics outputs, and machine-learning-ready data assets
  • setting standards for reusable, trusted, observable, supportable, secure, and cost-conscious data products and pipelines
  • ensuring data and analytics delivery is designed for repeated adoption across multiple use cases, breweries, countries, and OpCos
  • owning alignment between AWS-based data engineering patterns and Azure-based semantic-layer, BI, and downstream analytics consumption requirements
  • reducing duplication across reports, datasets, metric definitions, transformation logic, and squad-specific implementations by enforcing common reusable patterns
  • accountability for data quality, lineage, observability, testing, monitoring, documentation, and production-readiness standards across data products and pipelines
  • ensuring technical decisions, dependencies, transformation logic, design assumptions, support models, and downstream impacts are documented and governed
  • accountability for planning and influencing the chapter’s technical resource envelope, vendor and contractor contribution, tooling decisions, cloud consumption, and run-cost optimisation within agreed programme and platform budgets. Contributes to annual and quarterly planning for delivery capacity, platform consumption, support needs, and scale/run investment required to productise Connected Brewery capabilities across breweries and OpCos.

You are a good candidate if you have:

Qualifications:

  • minimum 10 years of experience across Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, Data Science Enablement, or similar data and analytics roles
  • at least 3 years of technical leadership experience in a complex data, analytics, BI, AI/ML, or platform delivery environment
  • proven experience leading, line-managing, or formally coordinating mixed technical teams, including performance management, coaching, capability planning, and work allocation
  • experience defining standards, reusable methods, architecture patterns, governance practices, and production-readiness expectations across multiple teams, sites, markets, or business units
  • experience managing delivery across multiple stakeholders, squads, technical disciplines, and enterprise platforms.

Experience / Skills:

  • working across multiple environments such as development, test, staging, and production
  • designing pipelines that support multiple consumers and use cases
  • understanding how to build scalable and reusable data processing patterns
  • understanding how curated datasets are consumed by BI and analytics teams
  • supporting BI Developers in building reliable reporting and semantic-layer outputs
  • supporting the creation of trusted datasets for BI, dashboarding, and advanced analytics
  • helping reduce duplication across reports, datasets, and squad-specific logic
  • ensuring that reporting and analytics requirements are considered when designing upstream data pipelines
  • supporting alignment between operational reporting, historical reporting, and advanced analytics use cases
  • unit and integration testing for data pipeline, with data lineage and traceability
  • pipeline observability and operational monitoring
  • reconciliation between source and target datasets
  • handling pipeline failures, retries, and support processes
  • ensuring transformation logic and data dependencies are documented
  • supporting production readiness and handover of data products
  • ensuring reporting and analytical outputs are based on trusted and well-understood data.

You are a perfect match if you also have:

  • AWS Step Functions
  • EventBridge or event-driven data processing
  • Lambda-based orchestration or lightweight integration patterns
  • Iceberg, Delta, or similar table formats
  • CI/CD deployment of AWS data engineering workloads
  • Terraform-based AWS infrastructure deployment
  • understanding of Azure data platform concepts

  • preparing data for semantic-layer or reporting consumption
  • supporting BI and analytics teams with curated, trusted, and model-ready datasets
  • understanding how data needs to be structured for Power BI or advanced analytics use cases

  • Power BI exposure
  • Semantic model / semantic layer experience
  • experience supporting advanced analytics teams
  • experience with operational dashboards or Grafana
  • experience with KPI and metric standardisation across multiple sites or OpCos.

title: Director of Flavor Development & Sensory Innovation
description:
Our purpose is unlocking the potential of people, nature, and science to nourish the world. We consistently incorporate social and environmental impact into decision making given its importance to the success and profitability to our business.

At Kalsec, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment by embracing the wisdom and strengths that diversity brings.

Job Summary:

This role serves as Kalsec’s champion for Taste Innovation, both internally and externally, by advancing savory flavor development capabilities and translating market needs into differentiated natural taste solutions. The individual leads the development of innovative savory flavor systems utilizing reaction flavors, top notes, spice extracts, natural products, seasoning concepts, prototypes, and sensory-driven solutions that support business growth. Success in the role is measured through the impact of innovation efforts, including the growth of new products, the strength and quality of the customer project pipeline, increased project conversion rates, and the delivery of maximum return on investment.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Champion Taste Innovation across Kalsec and with customers by shaping a clear point of view on savory flavor trends, natural products, technologies, applications, and market opportunities.
  • Lead the creation of savory flavor systems and customer-ready solutions using reaction flavors, top notes, spice extracts, natural products, seasoning concepts, and prototypes that address food application needs and generate new business.
  • Apply technical expertise in flavor chemistry, savory taste modulation, seasoning design, ingredient interactions, sensory science, natural extracts, and food applications to solve customer challenges.
  • Develop compelling customer demonstrations, presentations, prototypes, and technical tools that showcase Kalsec’s taste innovation capabilities.
  • Partner with Sales, Product Management, Applications, Sensory, and R&D to prioritize and execute high-value customer and innovation projects.
  • Lead, coach, and develop technical talent supporting savory flavor development, sensory innovation, and customer project execution.
  • Advance innovation success by growing new products, strengthening the customer project pipeline, improving conversion rate, and maximizing return on investment from Taste Innovation efforts.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years related experience as an individual contributor and 5+ years of managerial experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Required

  • Degree in Food Science, Flavor Chemistry, Chemistry, Culinary Science, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of ten years of food industry R&D experience with demonstrated expertise in:
    • Savory flavor development
    • Seasoning systems
    • Sensory and application work
    • Customer collaboration
    • Technical leadership
  • Experience in a flavor house and/or seasoning company strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on expertise working with:
    • Reaction flavors
    • Top notes
    • Spice extracts
    • Natural products
  • Proven ability to develop and commercialize innovative savory food solutions that meet customer and market needs.

Desired

  • Experience with savory food categories, including: Snacks, Meat and poultry, Plant-based foods, Sauces and soups, prepared meals and related savory applications
  • Strong ability to translate: Culinary insights, Sensory insights, Natural product expertise, Market trends and customer needs
  • Demonstrated success in developing commercially relevant taste solutions that drive customer value and business growth.

This job description is not intended to cover every detail or every aspect of the job identified. Other duties may and will be assigned based upon the workload and needs of the department.

Kalsec® is committed to providing safe food to its customers. This position requires completing annual food safety training. Food safety training is conducted through Kalsec® electronic training program and on-the-job training in each department. The organizational chart identifies personnel responsible for covering food safety responsibilities in the absence of this position.

title: Health Services Manager
description:
Department: Program Services: Health Services

Grade Range/Job Status: Full Time/Exempt-Salaried

Reporting Relationship: Senior Director of Program Services

Supervisory Responsibilities: Lead Nurse Coordinator

Typical Schedule: Primarily M-F Days. Must be willing and able to work flexible hours/days, (can work a hybrid schedule –remote and in-person) but is required to be 4 days per week in person/on-site, with supervisor approval. Responsible for supporting program director who is on call with medical triage questions after hours and weekends.

Position Summary

The Health Services Manager oversees the Health Services Department to ensure quality medical practices and care for the individuals served by Hammer & NER. The Health Services Manager provides direct supervision to the nursing team in addition to completing regular nursing duties. They work to support the nursing team function optimally and will step in to complete assessments of health status and provision of direct nursing care when needed. Supports staff in maintaining 245D state and federal compliance by providing training and guidance on medical procedures, proper use of medical devices, documentation requirements, and incident reporting, while serving as an ongoing resource for health-related concerns. All employees are expected to center, model, and champion Hammer’s core values: Person-Centered, Relational, Opportunistic and Stewardship.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

1. Patient Care

· Provide nursing and health care support to people served within the scope of nursing practice.

· Responsible for a caseload of supported individuals and supports the nursing team with caseload coverage.

· Ensure that nursing standards are maintained and that all applicable rules and regulations are followed.

· Work as part of the inter-disciplinary team to ensure best practice for the individuals we support.

· Provide clinical supervision and consultation as needed, including for hospital and TCU stays, and hospice care.

· Assesses staff competency in carrying out delegated health-related tasks and provides guidance or retraining as needed.

· Documents all assessments, observations, and interventions according to regulatory and organizational standards.

2. Leadership and Supervision

· Provide direction and supervision to health services team including the provision of timely and effective feedback related to organizational policies and procedures and medical regulations.

· Provide guidance in absence of Senior Director of Program Services.

· Complete weekly check-ins and ongoing communication with direct reports.

· Actively participate in team building, fostering a work environment that reflects the organizations stated core values.

· Participate in the hiring of staff members to ensure quality work reflective of Hammer’s mission, vision and values.

· Teach and counsel the individuals we serve, family members and staff in the areas of health and disease and promoting self-responsibility and independence whenever possible.

· Facilitate training for the direct care workforce to help meet the needs of the people we support.

· Collaborate with contracted nurses, and serve as a point person for contracted agency

· Run department meetings.

  1. Administration

· Assists with special projects and completes other duties as assigned by the Senior Director of Program Services

· Act as liaison with outside vendors including developing and maintaining contracts, as well as working with outside agencies to improve services in our field.

· Develop and facilitate trainings for the direct care workforce to help meet the needs of the people we support.

· Act as Infection Control Officer for the organization and consult with a physician regarding these issues.

· Participate in the Director’s team meetings as requested.

· Participate in the development of nursing and medical projects, procedures and policies, and the communication and implementation of these projects,

· Participate in the development of medical training content for orientation, medication administration and continuing education for staff.

· Participate in the instruction of the staff in medical related orientation classes and annual continuing education needs

· Frequently organizes multiple responsibilities at once, requiring time management, organizational and reporting skills, and proven ability to achieve assigned deadlines.

Essential Knowledge and Qualifications

· Licensed as a Registered Nurse in good standing with the State of Minnesota.

· Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) preferred.

· Experience and competence in managing health services for people who have disabilities and other related conditions.

· Experience supervising, coaching, and mentoring a team of employees to provide effective health services.

· Experience working with the aging population, particularly aging in the individuals with disabilities

· Communicate effectively and work cooperatively with co-workers and administrative staff members.

· Demonstrated thorough knowledge and understanding of current health related practices, issues, and regulations relative to people with disabilities and related conditions.

· Demonstrate the ability to effectively teach, train and mentor staff to provide effective healthcare services to people.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills including fluency in English and proficiency with Microsoft Office (especially Outlook and Excel) and SharePoint.

· Available to work a flexible full-time schedule including some evenings, weekends, and overnights.

· Requires a valid driver's license, personal auto and driving record that meets Hammer & NER’s insurance requirements.

· Must receive a MN DHS Background study clearance and show freedom from Tuberculosis.

· Experience, ability, and commitment to working with individuals and teams that are mixed across lines of difference such as race, gender-identity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, age, class, and immigrant status.

· Adhere to a strong ethical code in compliance with organizational mission and values.

· Ability to remain positive and foster a positive work environment while facing pressure or demands from multiple directions.

· Demonstrate proficient and effective verbal and written skills, and recordkeeping skills.

· Requires strong organizational skills including projects, time management, close attention to detail, and proven ability to achieve assigned deadlines.

Physical demands include:

· Frequent use of a telephone, frequent use of repetitive motion activities including typing on a computer keyboard and monitor, laptop or scanner, and the ability to work for several hours at a time at a desk and computer.

· Ability to bend and move to perform nursing head to toe assessments, evaluations, lifting, and are able to complete other skilled nursing tasks.

· Ability to lift 40lbs (such as lifting a wheelchair into a van), pushing, or pulling an individual in a wheelchair or while assisting with personal cares.

· Physical cares may include twisting/turning, kneeling/squatting, reaching, and assisting with pivot transfers.

· Operating specialized medical or adaptive equipment, including use of lifting equipment.

· Must demonstrate the ability to work diplomatically with a wide variety of people, including people served, families, legal representatives, and other medical professionals.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
About You

You're not just good at your job—you own it. You don’t wait to be told what to do next; you see what needs to be done and jump in. You love solving complex problems, thrive when juggling multiple tasks, and have the technical chops to make systems work in harmony. You're energized by a challenge, even when the path forward isn’t entirely clear.

You’re also someone who:

  • Loves Jesus and aligns with LifeWise's mission
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Has a knack for taking technical language and explaining it in plain English
  • Enjoys collaborating with a team but can work independently without missing a beat

About the Job

We’re looking for a gospel-centered, technically skilled Systems Engineer / Developer to join our IT team in a hybrid role based out of our Hilliard, OH office. You’ll work primarily in Salesforce and help integrate, automate, and maintain the various systems that keep LifeWise running efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Systems and Automation

  • Design, build and optimize automations within Salesforce (Flows, Apex, Lightning Web Components, validation rules, etc.)
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes and increase operational efficiency
  • Support data integrity through validation, deduplication and governance practices
  • Contribute to system architecture decisions with scalability and sustainability in mind
  • Ensure automations are scalable, maintainable and well-documented

Development and Integrations

  • Develop and maintain custom code to support integrations between Salesforce and external systems (APIs, middleware, etc.)
  • Build and enhance web-based solutions (Web tech stack, forms, custom tools)
  • Manage data flows between systems, ensuring accuracy and reliability
  • Write and optimize SQL queries for reporting, auditing and data correction

Troubleshooting and Collaboration

  • Serve as primary contact for daily inquiries, as an escalation point for Solutions Specialists and support senior/executive leadership requests
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system issues across multiple platforms
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term fixes, not just quick patches
  • Monitor system performance and proactively address risks
  • Partner with internal teams to understand needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • Clearly communicate timelines, trade-offs and technical constraints
  • Document systems, processes, and solutions for long-term maintainability

Qualifications

  • A mature personal Christian faith consistent with the LifeWise Academy Statement of Faith
  • 3+ years of Salesforce experience, including admin-level capabilities and Apex development
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following: PHP, JavaScript, ASP.NET, jQuery, or similar
  • Experience building and maintaining integrations using APIs or middleware tools
  • Strong troubleshooting instincts and experience solving technical problems quickly
  • Solid SQL query skills
  • Excellent communication abilities, including translating tech-speak into plain English
  • Experience managing multiple projects with competing priorities
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data architecture and governance best practices
  • Working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs and common integration patterns
  • Experience with web server solutions such as Astro, Cloudflare, Supabase and other CMS tools
  • Understanding of DevOps practices (version control, deployment processes, sandbox management)
  • Proven success operating in a high-growth or startup-like environment

Salary and Benefits

  • From $75,000 per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for qualified employees
  • Retirement plan, including employer match
  • Unlimited PTO for qualified employees

LifeWise Academy's hiring practices and EEO Statement are fully in compliance with both federal and state law. Federal law creates an exception to the "religion" section of employment discrimination laws for religious organizations and permits them to give employment preference to members of their own religion. LifeWise Academy is in that category.

title: Real Estate Photographer - Pooler, GA
description:

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.
  • Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.
  • Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. title: Web Application Security Engineers APAC
description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer Group Ltd. acts in the sector Private Banking and is present in over 25 countries and around 60 locations. With the Headquartered in Zurich, we have offices in key locations including Bangkok, Dubai, Dublin, Frankfurt, Geneva, Hong Kong, London, Luxembourg, Madrid, Mexico City, Milan, Monaco, Mumbai, Santiago de Chile, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, Tel Aviv and Tokyo.

Join our global team and play a critical role in safeguarding our digital landscape as a Web Application Security Engineer. We're seeking a skilled expert to maintain and enhance the protection of our online platforms, ensuring the highest level of security for our clients worldwide.

YOUR CHALLENGE

KEY FEATURES OF THE POSITION

Main Job Responsibilities

  • Work closely with our global team of engineers to ensure the smooth operation and maintenance of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) infrastructure
  • Enhance the security of web applications and APIs by implementing advanced protective measures on the WAF and configuring custom application-specific security policies
  • Onboard new web applications and APIs onto the WAF infrastructure, ensuring seamless integration and optimal security
  • Evaluate new or changed business requirements and assess their feasibility, as well as their impact on surrounding systems, standards, and guidelines
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to WAF, identifying root causes and developing effective solutions
  • Participate in the 2nd and 3rd level support organization, providing on-duty support and collaborating with other teams to resolve incidents
  • Continuously improve the service reliability, security, performance, monitoring, and automation of the WAF infrastructure, with a focus on enhancing overall system availability and efficiency

Client Management (internal & external)

  • Various IT functions, both regionally and globally
  • Local Legal and Compliance functions

Business Management

  • Key local stakeholders include IT Service Owners, IT Infrastructure, IT Application Managers, IT Architecture and Project Managers
  • CRO functions – including Business Operational Risk, Information Security and Compliance functions
  • Global functions – IT Security Solutions, Security Architecture
  • Establish strong relationship with key stakeholders and across the internal IT

Regulatory Responsibilities &/OR Risk Management

  • Ensure appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour within the area of responsibility by clear demonstration of appropriate values and behaviours including but not limited to standards on honesty and integrity, due care and diligence, fair dealing (treating customers fairly), management of conflicts of interest, competence and continuous development, adequate risk management, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations
YOUR PROFILE

SKILLS REQUIREMENTS OF THE POSITION

Professional and Technical

  • Profound understanding of security best practices of web applications and APIs
  • Solid understanding of web communication protocols such as HTTP, TLS, Websocket, etc.
  • Hands-on operational experience with highly available and scalable web infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with operating WAF or reverse-proxy solutions such as F5, Imperva, Nevis, Cloudflare, or open-source alternatives like ModSecurity
  • Experience in software engineering (Java, Spring Boot, React, Typescript) and operational experience with Kubernetes-based environments
  • Strong troubleshooting and structured problem-solving skills
  • Skilled in log analytics and correlation, with hands-on experience in Splunk, Elastic or similar toolings, to investigate incidents and identify root causes
  • Familiarity with the implementation of authentication and federation mechanisms such as SAML, OAuth and OIDC and FIDO
  • Good technical foundation of Linux operating systems and its command line tools
  • Relevant academic background (e.g., Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field) or industry-recognized certifications (e.g. CISSP) with relevant practical knowledge is desired

Personal and Social

  • Team player, strong collaborator with the willingness to take ownership
  • Excellent communication skills in spoken and written form
  • Strong desire to learn and develop new skills
  • Methodical and results-driven approach to new challenges and tasks
  • Independent and self-driven
  • Ability to thrive in a globally distributed team environment

Regulatory

  • Good understanding of the technology regulatory framework in Singapore and Hong Kong

title: Research Program Coordinator – Clark Lab
description:

Job Summary:

The Lindsay Clark Lab, located within the Department of Medicine at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health, offers a unique opportunity for a Research Program Coordinator to join our program.


Research in the Clark Lab has an overarching aim to improve early detection and prognosis of Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD), with specific focus on developing and studying best practices for communication of AD biomarker results, understanding psychological and behavioral outcomes of AD biomarker testing, and investigating the feasibility, reliability, and validity of digital cognitive tools.


This position will support Dr. Clark by providing critical administrative and managerial leadership in areas including regulatory support, development of standard operating procedures and operational workflows, budgetary monitoring and communication with study teams and collaborators to ensure the success of funded research projects. This will also include providing direct supervision to staff and student employees and assisting in the oversight of postdoctoral, graduate student and undergraduate trainees in the lab.

title: LVN
description:
Benefits:

Statement of Purpose - Per Diem Position

Under the direct supervision of the Nursing Supervisor/Program Director, the Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) Lead assesses clients and provides nursing care (including but not limited to client care coordination, medication services, patient education, etc.) in accordance with physicians’ orders and treatment objectives and as instructed by supervisor.

Major Tasks, Duties and Responsibilities

  • Report and record any changes observed in client condition or behavior, including unusual incidents. Identify, report, and assist with the management of emergencies.

  • Complete nursing assessment, and/or other intake/assessment tools and documentation as indicated (e.g., withdrawal screeners, C-SSRS, etc.)

  • Take and record accurate vital signs and perform toxicology testing. Chart routine information (e.g., vital signs, client progress, daily activities, etc.). Support clients with health and hygiene needs as indicated per individual plan of care.

  • Make rounds every 30 minutes for 72 hours on withdrawal management clients, document and record withdrawal symptoms.

  • Monitor and document client self-administration of medications. Facilitate doctor’s orders including injectables (e.g., Vivitrol, etc.). For nurses assigned to CDRH unit, administer and document medication orders to medication administration records.

  • Monitor and document client self-administration of PRN and other medications as ordered by physician. For nurses assigned to CDRH unit, administer and document medication orders to medication administration records.

  • Interact with clients to support their participation in the program. Facilitate and document services including but not limited to educational sessions or other groups, care coordination services, daily activity notes, and discharge services for clients.

  • Administer anti-overdose medications as needed and support client access to/and education regarding anti-overdose medications, and document accordingly.

  • Carry out appropriate interventions, including responding to emergencies and performing CPR and/or first aid, and document accordingly. Assist in event of client crisis, and document accordingly.

  • Conduct medication audits and log and destroy outdated medications per policy.

  • Assist with screening, orientation, admission, transfer, and discharge of clients. Handle clients’ personal belongings as directed.

  • Provide clerical support as directed by nursing staff and/or supervisors. Keep charts in order with all forms properly identified, uploaded, input, etc.

  • Follow directions of supervisors, physicians, mid-level practitioners, and registered nurses.

  • Observe universal precautions, including correct handling of bloodborne pathogens, storage of lab specimens, and disposal of infectious wastes.

  • Work as a member of the treatment team, especially in carrying out the client's plan of care.

  • Maintain professional boundaries and standards. Treat clients with respect, care, and concern. Comply with confidentiality requirements at all times. Maintain health and safety standards of facility.

  • Recognize personal biases working within diverse populations. Maintain cultural sensitivity at all times.

  • Maintain familiarity with BHS policies and procedures and other applicable regulations; perform job duties accordingly. Represent BHS well in all contacts.

  • May order inventory, and/or stock supplies in the unit.

  • Implementation on Infection control and accurately record infections and interventions.

  • Update and create daily assignments, reconciliation of Medication Destruction Logs, and other record keeping for Nurses.

  • Conduct Daily Chart audits report to RN. Recommend and participate in Interventions as needed.

  • Other duties as assigned.

LVN Lead Competencies and Performance Expectations

All LVN’s (Lead) are expected to hold the below competencies:

  • Serves as a clinical mentor and role model by coaching staff, sharing knowledge and expertise, providing constructive feedback, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development.

  • Assists with the onboarding, orientation, and training of new LVN staff to ensure a successful transition into their roles.

  • Encourages a culture of continuous learning, accountability, teamwork, and professional excellence.

  • Ability to complete the above major tasks, duties and responsibilities.

  • Ability to demonstrate and model professional judgment and decision-making, including ability to recognize and seek out supervision and/or consultation when required

  • Ability to demonstrate professional judgment and decision-making.

  • Ability to complete PPD screening, perform skin checks, etc.

  • Ability to effectively document and train to required note structures (e.g., SOAP, GIRP, etc.).

  • Ability to demonstrate familiarity of medication common for persons with substance use disorder.

  • Ability to recognize the symptoms and demonstrate knowledge of appropriate treatment associated with substance use disorder and detoxification.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with all involved parties, both verbally and written.

  • Ability to recognize the symptoms and impact of co-occurring conditions, including mental and medical health conditions and train to when indicated.

  • Ability to recognize personal biases when working with diverse populations and maintain cultural sensitivity at all times.

  • Ability to complete appropriately identify, respond to and train to a crisis. Demonstrate appropriate techniques for interventions, including but not limited to medical emergencies, overdose, AMA, behavioral challenges, suicide threats, safety codes, contraband protocol, etc.

  • Ability to Adhere to Professional Standards.

Job Description


Summary
Responsible for the efficient and effective management of data assets as well as designing and implementing data management strategy and processes related to acquiring, organizing, storing, integrating, and maintaining data within an organization. Establishes data management strategy, data governance policies, procedures, and practices to ensure the effective and efficient use of data throughout its lifecycle. Job Duties
  • Install, configure, and maintain database systems while applying patches and updates to ensure optimal performance.
  • Monitor database health, performance, and capacity, implementing strategies for efficient storage and resource utilization.
  • Develop and execute backup and restore procedures to maintain data integrity and support disaster recovery.
  • Ensure database security, user access controls, and compliance with regulatory requirements and standards.
  • Analyze queries, optimize performance, and maintain indexes and statistics for efficiency.

  • Implement robust backup and recovery solutions, disaster recovery planning, and ensure high availability through clustering, replication, and AlwaysOn Availability Groups.
  • Maintain strong security practices with role-based access control, encryption, auditing, and compliance knowledge of GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX standards.
  • Utilize scripting languages such as T-SQL, PL/SQL, PowerShell, and Bash, while managing documentation and staying current on database technologies and networking concepts.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s Degree Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 7 lbs., continuous sitting >67%, frequent keyboard use/repetitive motion, frequent fine motor activity/wrist position deviation.

title: Sanitation & Microbiology Manager
description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

The Sanitation & Microbiology Program Manager is the senior site subject matter expert accountable for the strategy, governance, technical rigor, and sustained effectiveness of the site's sanitation and contamination-control systems. The role integrates deep cleaning and sanitation expertise with applied industrial microbiology to protect product quality, consumer safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing operations.

This is an advanced individual-contributor leadership role. The position does not have direct reports; however, it provides functional direction, technical oversight, coaching, qualification, and ongoing support to Process Operators and other personnel who execute cleaning and sanitation activities under the Master Sanitation Schedule (MSS). The role establishes expectations, verifies capability and execution, and influences Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Logistics, Learning, and Technical Services through a dotted-line operating model.

The role is expected to independently assess complex contamination risks, translate microbiological and sanitation data into practical controls, make technically sound recommendations, escalate significant risk, and lead cross-functional resolution of systemic or recurring issues. The position serves as a primary site authority for sanitation, hygienic design, environmental monitoring, water monitoring, sanitation verification and validation, pest control, housekeeping, and contamination-control readiness.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the site Sanitation Program and Master Sanitation Schedule (MSS), ensuring cleaning frequencies, methods, responsibilities, documentation, and standards are risk-based, executable, and aligned with cGMP and corporate requirements.
  • Lead the site's microbiological and contamination-control programs, including environmental monitoring, water-system monitoring, sanitation verification, microbiological risk assessments, and contamination-prevention strategies.
  • Analyze and trend environmental, water, sanitation, product, and microbiological data to identify emerging risks, repeat failures, contamination pathways, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Provide technical leadership during microbiological excursions, contamination events, sanitation failures, and atypical results, including containment, root cause analysis, CAPA development, effectiveness checks, and closure.
  • Develop and approve cleaning validation and verification strategies, including acceptance criteria, sampling locations, chemical concentrations, contact times, temperatures, equipment disassembly, inspection, and ongoing verification.
  • Provide functional leadership and training to Process Operators and other employees performing cleaning and sanitation activities, including qualification standards, coaching, job aids, direct observation, and proficiency assessments.
  • Serve as the site's technical authority for hygienic and sanitary design, evaluating new equipment, capital projects, facility modifications, utilities, repairs, and process changes for cleanability and contamination risk.
  • Lead cross-functional investigations and continuous improvement efforts using tools such as 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, risk ranking, statistical trending, and CAPA effectiveness verification.
  • Maintain audit and regulatory readiness by ensuring sanitation, microbiology, pest control, water systems, documentation, training, and contamination-control programs meet applicable cGMP, regulatory, corporate, and industry requirements.
  • Exercise technical authority to escalate contamination risks and influence operational decisions, including intensified cleaning, resampling, equipment release, temporary controls, production planning, maintenance priorities, capital needs, and training requirements.

What we look for:

  • 3+ years of progressive experience in sanitation, microbiology, quality, or contamination control within Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), cosmetics, food and beverage, household products, pharmaceutical, medical device, or a similarly regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in both plant sanitation program development and execution and applied microbiology or contamination-control program management, with experience extending beyond routine coordination, scheduling, or recordkeeping.
  • Proven experience leading or playing a significant role in Master Sanitation Schedules (MSS), environmental monitoring, water monitoring, cleaning validation/verification, microbiological trending, and response to adverse or out-of-specification results.
  • Strong technical knowledge of cGMP requirements, sanitation chemistry and application, hygienic design, microbial control, sampling and testing fundamentals, documentation practices, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex investigations and CAPAs related to microbiological contamination, sanitation failures, environmental or water results, equipment design concerns, or recurring process deviations.
  • Proven ability to provide technical leadership, training, qualification, and coaching to manufacturing and operations personnel, including influencing teams without direct reporting authority.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, and approving technical procedures, sanitation standards, risk assessments, validation/verification protocols, investigation reports, and technical communications.
  • Ability to support operations across shifts and respond outside normal business hours, when necessary, to address significant sanitation, microbiological, or contamination-control events.

title: Real Estate Photographer - Seattle, WA
description:
Role Mission

Are you a visual storyteller with an eye for detail and a knack for seamless execution?

Ziprent (a subsidiary of TurboTenant) is looking for a independent contractor (1099) Real Estate Photographer & Field Operations Specialist to be our eyes and ears on the ground. This isn’t just about snapping a few photos; it’s about crafting the digital first impression for our rental properties and ensuring every home is "rent-ready" through meticulous property walkthroughs and technical setups.

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. You’ll work independently to manage everything from 3D tours and high-fidelity photography to smart lockbox installations and condition reporting. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Visual Storytelling: Deliver 15–25+ professionally edited, high-quality interior and exterior photos that make our listings pop.
  • Immersive Tech: Capture Zillow 3D tours and digital floor plans using a 360° camera to provide prospective tenants with a "true-to-life" experience.
  • Property Stewardship: Perform initial property walkthroughs and submit comprehensive condition reports to ensure our high standards are met.
  • Operational Logistics: Take the lead on key management, including the pick-up, installation, and battery maintenance of smart lockboxes.
  • High-Velocity Response: Maintain a "Be Better" mindset by responding promptly to new assignments and ensuring a 24-hour turnaround on all reports and deliverables.
  • Territory Mastery: Serving our local community and surrounding region, with a willingness to travel a 35–50+ mile radius to support our expanding market.

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.
  • Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.
  • Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.
  • Mobile Proficiency: An updated mobile device capable of capturing clear, detailed images for on-site walkthrough reports.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Excellent written communication skills and a professional demeanor when representing the Ziprent/TurboTenant brand.
  • Reliability: A valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and a flexible schedule to handle multiple shoots per month.
  • Location: You must live within 35 miles of the market area to be considered for this role.

The role requires completion of a background check and signing of an independent contractor agreement.

Bonus SuperPowers:

  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with FHA and housing compliance (smoke alarms, CO detectors, etc.).
  • Efficient Workflow: You stay ahead of the curve by leveraging modern tools and smart processes to streamline documentation, reporting, and day-to-day tasks—maximizing productivity without sacrificing quality.
  • Tech Comfort: You have a "can-do" attitude when it comes to learning new property management software.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You use modern tools to streamline your editing or reporting process for maximum efficiency.
  • Hyper-Detail Oriented: You notice the small things—from a loose door handle to a flickering light—that others might miss.

Our "Be Better" Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

  1. You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.
  2. You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.
  3. You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it. Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords.

Quantity of Jobs:

Number of job requests varies by market region. This is a contracted 1099 position, and requests are sent out on an as-needed basis. Most markets average 3 –10+ jobs per month.

Candidates should be flexible and comfortable with limited assignments initially while the market and workload grow.

Compensation

    • $225–$325+ per listing appointment (varies based on property size and scope)
      • Includes: professionally edited photos, Zillow 3D tour, floor plan, initial walkthrough report, and lockbox installation with key management
    • $50/hour for additional as-needed tasks
    • Lockbox Pick-Up:
      • $30–$60 per lockbox (depending on distance)
    • Travel Compensation:
      • Paid for travel exceeding 35 miles each way (70 miles round trip)
      • Reimbursed at $1.20 per mile beyond this threshold

Salary Range
$1—$100,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

title: Forensic Data Specialist
description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.


The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.


The Legal & Policy Team is Snap’s dedicated in-house law firm, policy consultant, lobbyist, thought partner, and all-around advisor. We help Snap do the right thing the right way, make better decisions, understand and manage risks, and creatively navigate challenges, both external and internal. We value the power of diversity, as we continually strive to build an innovative and inclusive leadership culture centered on Snap's values of Kind, Smart, and Creative.

We’re looking for a highly organized and tech-savvy Forensic Data Specialist to join our eDiscovery Team!

What you’ll do:

  • eDiscovery Management: Oversee all technical aspects of the eDiscovery process, including forensically sound data collection, preservation, processing, review, and production.
  • Technology Expertise: Maintain proficiency in eDiscovery software and tools, staying abreast of industry best practices and emerging technologies.
  • Data Processing: Utilize eDiscovery tools to process and analyze large volumes of data, ensuring data integrity and accuracy, while ensuring efficiency and cost containment.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with attorneys, paralegals, and other stakeholders to understand case requirements and develop tailored eDiscovery strategies. Work cross-functionally with engineering and IT teams to improve and optimize data collection processes, focusing on enhancing both corporate and Snapchat user data points.
  • Quality Control: Implement quality control measures to ensure the accuracy and completeness of eDiscovery deliverables.
  • Testimony re Data: Provide testimony regarding our data environment and data collection methods, when required for legal proceedings.
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external eDiscovery vendors, ensuring cost-effectiveness and service quality.
  • Training and Support: Provide training and support to legal team members on eDiscovery tools and processes.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple eDiscovery projects simultaneously, ensuring timely and efficient completion.
  • Problem Solving: Troubleshoot technical issues and provide solutions to complex eDiscovery challenges including investigating and resolving data extraction issues from internally built solutions.
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain documentation of existing eDiscovery workflows. Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement, document those for review with teams.
  • Reporting: Develop and track key metrics to measure litigation data activity internally and externally. Present on findings and identify potential areas for improvement.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle complex data sets and technical challenges.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in all aspects of eDiscovery work.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Project Management: Proven project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.
  • Team Player: A collaborative and team-oriented approach to work, with the ability to build strong relationships with colleagues.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as computer science, information technology, or legal studies.
  • 3+ years of experience in eDiscovery, preferably in a law firm or corporate legal department.
  • Strong technical skills and experience with eDiscovery software and tools.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.


At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

title: Systems Analyst
description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

POSITION

We are currently seeking a strong Systems Analyst to play a key role, deliver solutions to our business partners, solve complex problems, and strive to advance and sustain world-class technology platforms. This position requires strong analytical skills, with a high attention to detail, and a desire to analyze and solve complex problems. This individual must be a self-starter with the ability to multi-task and work on a variety of assignments with people across the organization. Excellent organization, communication, and delivery skills are required. This individual must be a team player with a desire and willingness to learn.

The Portfolio Accounting Technology team is responsible for delivering technology solutions to support various functions within the firm, including investment teams, client servicing, portfolio operations etc . The team plays a critical role in our firm’s success by providing technical solutions which improve the efficiency, speed and quality of the highly complex investment decision-making process.

JOB OVERVIEW

At Wellington Management you will continually learn, develop, and expand your skills. As part of an inclusive culture, you will meet smart, progressive individuals who will challenge you to solve problems, anticipate our clients’ needs, and enhance our proprietary systems and platforms. This is a great opportunity for an experienced Lead Analyst to join a strong, collaborative team in a role focusing on analysis with leadership and advancement opportunities. The individual will be responsible for requirements, systems analysis, testing, and project management. This position requires a high level of direct interaction with business users and excellent communication and delivery skills. This individual must be a self-starter with the ability to multi-task and work on a variety of assignments with people at all levels of the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interact directly with business partners at all levels of the organization to define, analyze and document requirements, as well as set priorities

  • Provide input into system design to help the programming teams define effort and implementation schedules
  • Ensure quality of product by enforcing high standards in testing and building audit/validation controls
  • Act as an escalation point person for support issues that require detailed analysis and management
  • Provide regular status reporting and issue tracking

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Business, Economics, Finance, or other related subjects

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal requirements for functional specifications, use cases, and test plans
  • Strong client relationship skills and proven ability to build consensus
  • Experience working directly with business partners to understand their needs and deliver solutions that meet those needs
  • Change agent, creative, innovative, and focused on continuous improvements
  • Self-motivated and willing to work in an energetic, fast paced team environment
  • Strategic mindset and intellectual curiosity

Systems Analyst

Systems Analysis

Needham

title: Senior Manager, Global Account Partners

title: Wheel and Brake Technician
description:
Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and founded in 1993, Precision Aviation Group (PAG) is a leading provider of maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) and value-added supply chain services to the aerospace and defense industries. With 25 FAA-approved repair stations, 27 locations worldwide, 1,100+ employees, and over 1.2 million square feet of production/distribution facilities, PAG offers comprehensive MRO services on over 200,000 product lines. PAG supports operators in the Airline, Business and General Aviation (BGA), Military and Rotary Wing markets through its Inventory Supported Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (ISMRO®) business model.

JOB PURPOSE

To perform inspection, maintenance, repair, and overhaul of aircraft wheel and brake assemblies in accordance with FAA Part 145 regulations, manufacturer specifications, and company quality standards. This role ensures all components meet airworthiness requirements, supports safe and reliable aircraft operations, and contributes to the repair station’s compliance, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential Job Functions:

  • Inspection and Evaluation

    • Perform detailed visual and dimensional inspections of aircraft wheels, brakes and related components.
    • Identify wear, corrosion, cracks or other defects using approved inspection methods and tools

    Maintenance & Repair

    • Disassemble, clean, and repair wheel and brake assemblies in accordance with manufacturer manuals and FAA regulation.
    • Replace defective parts, seals, and hardware using approved parts, materials and methods.
    • Balance and reassemble components to meet operational specifications

    Overhaul & Testing

    • Conduct complete overhauls of wheel and brake units, including bead seating, bearing replacement, and torque checks
    • Perform functional and pressure testing to verify serviceability.

    Documentation & Compliance

    • Accurately complete maintenance records, work orders and FAA required documentation.
    • Ensure all work complies with Part 145 Repair Station Manual (RSM) and Quality Control Manual (QCM) requirements.

    Tooling & Equipment Care

    • Maintain calibration and cleanliness of tools, test stands, and work areas
    • Report and tag unserviceable tools and equipment

    Safety & Quality Assurance

    • Follow all safety protocols, PPE requirements, and hazardous material handling procedures.
    • Participate in internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives.

    Teamwork & Communication

    • Coordinate with inspectors, supervisors, and other technicians to ensure workflow efficiency.
    • Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Physical Demands: Requires sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Requires occasional squatting, lifting, carrying, pushing or pulling weight up to 70 pounds. Requires repetitive hand movement. Requires hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity. Requires corrected vision and hearing to normal range.

Equipment Operated: Work with hydraulic presses & pumps, media blasters, dill press, bead breaker, rivet machine, various types of hand tools and torque wrenches.

Work Location: PAG Office on Lake Mirror Road building in Atlanta, GA.

Experience: One year of aviation-related training or work experience preferred.

This role is posted continuously to identify qualified candidates for future openings. Applying does not guarantee an immediate opening, but applications will be considered as positions become available.

description:

Secondary Responsibilities

title: Advancement Officer
description:
About Us

LifeWise Academy is a released time religious instruction program that exists to reach public school students with the gospel during school hours. Under released time law, students may be released from public school during the day to receive religious instruction, provided the program is off school property, privately funded and parent-permitted. We believe released time is the greatest missed opportunity of the American church to reach the next generation with the gospel.

About You

You love Jesus. You love kids. You have the ability to take advantage of each interaction and turn it into an opportunity for Kingdom advancement. You recognize that your sphere of influence is a mission field and are able to articulate how God is moving through and around you. You can connect people with ideas through conversation and influence them toward action. You can create excitement in people and then help them find ways to get involved in making a difference. Most importantly, you know this isn't just a job. It's a chance to do something meaningful, a chance to serve others and a chance to make a life-changing impact on students with the gospel.

About the Job

We are looking for a gospel-centered, results-driven and detail-oriented Advancement Officer to join our team. This is a position responsible for cultivating advancement opportunities and managing a pipeline of donors. Our ideal candidate is a spiritually mature active church participant with excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills. This is a part-time position.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as a LifeWise ambassador, introducing the concept of LifeWise Academy and cultivating interest
  • Effectively communicate the vision, mission and priorities of LifeWise to prospective donors
  • Oversee a portfolio of donors and prospects, meeting with prospects, ambassadors and donors regularly
  • Participate in each step of the donor pipeline and maintain an organized system for donor stewardship by updating constituent records in the LifeWise customer relationship management system
  • Provide regular reporting of major gift progress to the program director and leadership board
  • Develop strategies to renew and upgrade donor gifts
  • Participate in the planning and execution of the fundraising events and follow up with donors in a timely manner

Qualifications and Experience

  • A mature personal Christian faith in agreement with the "What We Believe" section of the LifeWise Academy Statement of Faith
  • Active participation in and commitment to a local church whose doctrine aligns with the "What We Believe" section of the LifeWise Academy Statement of Faith
  • Leadership experience in either a professional or volunteer capacity
  • Experience in a fundraising position or other related field (preferred)

Benefits

  • Retirement plan, including employer match

LifeWise Academy's hiring practices and EEO Statement are fully in compliance with both federal and state law. Federal law creates an exception to the "religion" section of employment discrimination laws for religious organizations and permits them to give employment preference to members of their own religion. LifeWise Academy is in that category.

title: Resident Director
description:
Saint Anselm College, a private, liberal arts college in the Benedictine tradition, is seeking a Resident Director. Reporting to an Area Coordinator and/or the Director of Residential Life and Education, the Resident Director is a live-in, 10-month professional staff position, with duties coordinated by the Director of Residential Life and Education. This person will be responsible for the overall operation of a residence hall/area of up to 300 undergraduate residents including supervision of 8-10 undergraduate resident assistants, Resident Hall Council, and front desk staff. Subscribing to the professional standards and philosophy of the student affairs division and representing the Office of the Dean of Students and the Department of Residential Life and Education, this person will serve as a behavior model, offering supervision to resident assistants, and assistance and direction to students of the assigned hall(s). Typical duties include: opening/closing halls; hall program management; facilities management; disciplinary interventions; counseling and referrals; staff training, selection, and supervision; and interpretation and enforcement of college rules, policies and procedures in conjunction with the college’s judicial system. Serves in an on-call rotation of professional staff responding to emergency and crisis situations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:


Residential Operations & Building Management

  • Managing the physical integrity of assigned area, responsive to address and resolve facility issues, such as needed repairs, maintenance, or renovations; identify and resolve recurrent student issues including but not limited to trash, security, damage/vandalism)
  • Demonstrate active communication with supervisor and main office regarding building management.
  • Assure accurate recordkeeping and responsiveness to expedite resolution of student/building issues
  • Supervises in-hall assignments and room changes
  • Conduct regular walk-throughs of area to forge positive relations with custodians, students, and do first-hand checks on building integrity and needed repairs
  • Assist to manage/resolve student concerns, including but not limited to roommates, facilities/work orders, campus resource needs, etc.

Residential Education & Community Development

  • Knowledgeable as to the requirements and application of the programming model and the educational philosophy and goals of the department
  • Acts as liaison between the student affairs professional staff, the resident assistants, and resident students
  • Supervises residence hall activities and programs and is responsible for the organization and co-leadership of the student development programming for the Residential First Year Experience program
  • Assists in the management of the Honors Housing and Substance Free Housing programs
  • Serve as a Conduct Hearing Officer for Community Standards and Student Conduct
  • Attends major hall sponsored events
  • Demonstrate a holistic and working knowledge of campus resources and effectively promote them through programming efforts, student interactions, and marketing

On Call Support

Understand in practice the College’s Emergency Management Plan, specifically related to this role, the RLE response and report structure

· Participation in the Professional Staff Member (PSM) on-call rotation


Projects and Committees

  • Coordinate at least two departmental projects per semester. These projects include but are not limited to operational housing projects such as room assignments/selection, RA training/selection, and faculty-engaged cocurricular collaborations
  • Serve as a Residential Life representative on at least one division of Student Development and Mission committee
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned, based on the needs of the division of Student Development and Mission, the Office of Residential Life and Education, and the professional interests of the RD

Supervisory Responsibilities: The Resident Director will supervise 8-10 undergraduate Resident Assistants, Resident Hall Council, and front desk staff.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Prior experience in a residence life position
  • Demonstrates an understanding of and commitment to student development, safety, diversity and social justice
  • Familiarity and respect of the traditions of a Catholic higher education.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, organization, and interpersonal skills
  • Capable of working in a high-energy, high-traffic area
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, web design and management, and other database applications
  • Ability to work days, with nightly on-call duty as scheduled in all types of weather conditions.
  • Basic knowledge of counseling, conflict management, and crisis intervention strategies

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in student personnel or a related field is preferred.
  • Higher-Level leadership experience in residence life
  • Familiarity with facilities maintenance and custodial processes on a college campus
  • Basic knowledge of Saint Anselm College policies and community standard expectations

Successful candidates will be able to assist the college to

further its strategic goals for institution-wide diversity and inclusiveness.

title: Wise Elders Families Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Wise Elders Families Coordinator

Reports to: Adult & Aging Programs Administrator

Salary: $24.00 per hour

Starting Date: Open until filled


Organizational Profile

Centro Tyrone Guzman advances the well-being of Latine communities through an intergenerational approach that nurtures lifelong learning, holistic health, and prosperity. We envision vibrant, inclusive, and thriving Latine communities that proudly co-create and shape Minnesota’s cultural, social, and economic vitality.


Position Summary

The Wise Elders Families Coordinator supports the well-being of Latine older adults, caregivers, and families through culturally responsive community education, resource navigation, and outreach.

Working collaboratively with the Wise Elders Families team and other Adult & Aging staff, this position helps plan, develop, and facilitate educational workshops, presentations, and community learning opportunities focused on caregiving, healthy aging, and family well-being. This position contributes to the development of new educational initiatives and the adaptation of existing programs and materials to meet community needs.


The coordinator also provides direct resource navigation, individualized assistance, referrals, and follow-up services to assigned participants, helping expand the department's capacity to respond to the needs of older adults, caregivers, and their families.


Job Responsibilities

  • Plan, prepare, and facilitate culturally and linguistically responsive educational workshops, trainings, and learning activities for caregivers, older adults, and families.
  • Assist in developing and updating educational activities, presentations, and learning materials for caregivers.
  • Support the coordination and implementation of caregiver education programs and other health and wellness learning initiatives.
  • Facilitate community presentations and educational activities related to caregiver well-being, healthy aging, brain health, dementia awareness, and other relevant health and wellness topics.
  • Assist with participant recruitment, community engagement, and coordination of educational events and presentations through outreach to community members, organizations, and service providers.
  • Provide culturally and linguistically responsive information, resource navigation, and individualized assistance to older adults, caregivers, and families.
  • Assist participants with understanding and accessing public benefits and community resources, including Medicare, Medical Assistance (Medicaid), Social Security, SNAP, transportation, and other supportive services.
  • Help participants with applications, correspondence, communication with service providers, and related follow-up activities within the scope of the position.
  • Coordinate with Wise Elders Families staff to respond to assigned participant requests, provide appropriate referrals, and support continuity of services.
  • Collaborate with Adult & Aging staff to coordinate educational activities, participant services, and community engagement efforts.
  • Provide occasional support for Wise Elders, Respite, and other departmental activities as needed.
  • Share observations and participant feedback to help identify opportunities for new educational activities and improvements to existing services.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of participant services, educational activities, attendance, referrals, and follow-up interactions using designated program systems.
  • Collect participant feedback and assist with documentation, program evaluation, and information needed for internal and grant reporting.

Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain participant confidentiality and follow organizational policies and applicable program requirements.
  • Participate in required trainings, staff meetings, and professional development activities.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.
