title: AI Frameworks Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Do Something Wonderful!

Intel put the Silicon in Silicon Valley. No one else is this obsessed with engineering a brighter future. Every day, we create world changing technology that enriches the lives of every person on earth. So, if you have a big idea, let’s do something wonderful together. Join us, because at Intel, we are building a better tomorrow. Want to learn more? Visit our YouTube Channel or the links below!


Life at Intel


The Role and Impact
As an AI Frameworks Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting-edge AI software to optimize AI frameworks. On a practical day-to-day level, you will contribute to the development and optimization of advanced AI frameworks, implement distributed algorithms, and collaborate with researchers to deliver high-performance solutions. Your work will directly enhance Intel's AI capabilities and drive innovation in machine learning and deep learning technologies.

Business Group
At Intel Corporation, our teams are dedicated to pushing the boundaries of technology to create world-changing innovations. This role sits within a group focused on advancing AI solutions, with work spanning the development of optimized frameworks and libraries to accelerate artificial intelligence applications. Together, we enable breakthroughs in AI performance, supporting Intel's mission to shape the future of computing and empower our customers globally.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize AI frameworks such as OpenVINO, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
  • Implement and enhance distributed algorithms, including model/data parallel frameworks, parameter servers, and asynchronous data communication.
  • Transform computational graph representations of neural network models to achieve performance improvements.
  • Develop high-performance machine learning and deep learning primitives within mathematical libraries.
  • Profile distributed deep learning models to identify bottlenecks and propose effective solutions.
  • Optimize code across a variety of computing hardware backends to maximize performance.
  • Collaborate closely with researchers to integrate advancements in machine learning and deep learning into frameworks.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate the following behavioral traits:

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a highly matrixed structure.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your school work/classes/research and/or relevant previous job and/or internship experiences.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with 1+ years of experience in AI frameworks development and optimization OR Master's degree in relevant field.
  • 6+ months experience in:
    - Programming languages such as Python, C++, or similar.
    - AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenVINO).
    - Algorithmic and mathematical skills applicable to machine learning and deep learning.




Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in relevant field with 2+ years of related experience OR Ph.D.
  • Optimizing code for hardware backends like CPUs, GPUs, or accelerators.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing techniques and tools for AI applications.
  • Experience working with graph-based computation models and performance profiling tools.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional teams.
  • A passion for driving innovation and solving complex technical challenges in the AI domain.



We are looking for innovative minds eager to shape the future of AI development and contribute to groundbreaking advancements. Join us to make an impact and grow your career in a supportive environment where you can thrive both technically and personally.

title: Director of Warranty, Operations & Maintenance-EPC
description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

WHY ROSENDIN?

Committed. Innovative. Engaged.

If you're looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. Since our founding over 100+ years ago, Rosendin has been driven to positively impact the communities where we live and work. We are an organization built on integrity and we have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity, and inspires everyone to do their best. As one of the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractors in the United States, you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success. When our people succeed and fuel our success, we reward them. We'd love to have you as a shareholder!


YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY

The Director of Warranty, Operations & Maintenance – EPC provides strategic leadership and enterprise-wide oversight for the Energy (EPC) group of Rosendin's warranty, field service, and maintenance functions. This role is responsible for developing strategy and executing programs, policies, and standards that ensure the reliability, performance, and long-term lifecycle value of installed electrical systems and infrastructure. The Director leads strategy for warranty, service operations, maintenance, as well as administration and issue resolution while driving continuous improvement, financial stewardship, risk mitigation, and customer satisfaction. Working collaboratively with Operations, Engineering, Construction, Quality, Procurement, Legal, Finance, manufacturers, vendors, and customers, this position safeguards Rosendin's operational and financial interests and advances service excellence across the organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Establish and direct for the Energy (EPC) group the enterprise-wide warranty, operations, and maintenance strategy as well as drive management policies, standards, governance processes, and performance metrics across all projects and operating regions.
  • Oversee and lead the administration and resolution of highly complex warranty claims, investigations, root-cause analyses, corrective actions, and recovery efforts to minimize financial exposure and customer impact.
  • Oversee and lead warranty obligations, service agreements, contractual commitments, manufacturer warranties, and subcontractor responsibilities to ensure compliance and maximize cost recovery.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain systems, reporting, and analytics to track warranty performance, service delivery, claim trends, asset reliability, financial exposure, and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Engineering, Quality, and Project Operations to mitigate risk, resolve escalated claims, and maximize cost recovery.
  • Provide strategic leadership for operations and maintenance programs supporting installed electrical infrastructure, equipment, and assets throughout their lifecycle.
  • Establish preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies that improve reliability, availability, performance, and asset longevity.
  • Establish and direct maintenance standards, operating procedures, performance expectations, and long-term asset management plans aligned with company objectives.
  • Partner with Engineering, Construction, Quality, Commissioning, and Project Operations teams to identify systemic issues, improve product quality, and prevent recurring failures.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives through trend analysis, root-cause investigations, lessons learned, and implementation of corrective and preventive measures.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for resolution and mitigation of highly complex warranty, service, and operational issues, collaborating with customers, vendors, legal counsel, finance, and executive leadership to drive resolution.
  • Build, drive, influence, and maintain strategic relationships with customers, manufacturers, suppliers, subcontractors, and service providers to support successful project outcomes and service performance.
  • Oversee and direct departmental budgeting, forecasting, resource planning, warranty reserves, maintenance expenditures, and financial reporting to ensure fiscal responsibility and operational efficiency.
  • Oversee vendor performance, procurement support, contract administration, and service agreement negotiations to optimize cost, quality, and service delivery.
  • Champion a culture of safety, compliance, risk management, and operational excellence, ensuring adherence to company standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Lead and develop managers, technical professionals, and field service teams by establishing performance expectations, driving accountability, supporting talent development, and building organizational capability.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic plans for warranty management and operations & maintenance in a large-scale electrical construction environment.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with a track record of managing and mentoring high-performing technical and administrative teams.
  • In-depth understanding of electrical systems, construction processes, equipment reliability, and post-construction service lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis, risk assessment, and data-driven decision making.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively liaise with customers, vendors, legal counsel, and internal cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency with Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) or Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and other relevant project management software.
  • Demonstrated commitment to safety leadership, ensuring all field activities adhere to Rosendin's safety protocols and regulatory standards.
  • Financial acumen to manage budgets, track costs, and optimize resource utilization for warranty claims and O&M programs.

WHAT YOU BRING TO US

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in operations, maintenance, or service management within the electrical construction or heavy industrial sector.
  • At least 10 years of experience in a leadership role, managing teams responsible for warranty claims, field service, or asset maintenance.
  • Strong background in developing and implementing comprehensive warranty programs and preventive maintenance strategies.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CMRP, LEED AP) are a plus.

TRAVEL

  • Up to 50%

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Primarily office-based with frequent visits to active construction sites, client facilities, or operational assets as required.
  • Ability to navigate diverse construction environments, including multi-story buildings, uneven terrain, and varying weather conditions.
  • May require climbing ladders or stairs, standing for extended periods, and occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds.
  • Adherence to all Rosendin and client safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, and safety vests when on job sites.
  • Works a standard schedule, but may require flexibility to respond to urgent issues or attend meetings outside of normal business hours.
  • The Rosendin workplace is drug-free. The company requires all employees to participate in drug and alcohol screenings consistent with company policy and applicable law.
  • This position requires the ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and effectively manage multiple priorities.
  • Rosendin Electric, Inc. is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

YOU MATTER — OUR BENEFITS

title: Real Estate Photographer - Pasco, WA
description:
Role Mission

Are you a visual storyteller with an eye for detail and a knack for seamless execution?

Ziprent (a subsidiary of TurboTenant) is looking for a independent contractor (1099) Real Estate Photographer & Field Operations Specialist to be our eyes and ears on the ground. This isn’t just about snapping a few photos; it’s about crafting the digital first impression for our rental properties and ensuring every home is "rent-ready" through meticulous property walkthroughs and technical setups.

In this role, you’ll serve as a vital link in our growth engine, transforming empty spaces into high-performing listings. You’ll work independently to manage everything from 3D tours and high-fidelity photography to smart lockbox installations and condition reporting. If you love the freedom of the road and have a "tech-forward" approach, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Visual Storytelling: Deliver 15–25+ professionally edited, high-quality interior and exterior photos that make our listings pop.
  • Immersive Tech: Capture Zillow 3D tours and digital floor plans using a 360° camera to provide prospective tenants with a "true-to-life" experience.
  • Property Stewardship: Perform initial property walkthroughs and submit comprehensive condition reports to ensure our high standards are met.
  • Operational Logistics: Take the lead on key management, including the pick-up, installation, and battery maintenance of smart lockboxes.
  • High-Velocity Response: Maintain a "Be Better" mindset by responding promptly to new assignments and ensuring a 24-hour turnaround on all reports and deliverables.
  • Territory Mastery: Serving our local community and surrounding region, with a willingness to travel a 35–50+ mile radius to support our expanding market.

Qualifications:

  • Proven Experience: A strong real estate photography portfolio showcasing your ability to capture spaces effectively.
  • Tech-Savvy Toolkit: Professional gear including a high-quality wide-angle lens and a 360° camera compatible with Zillow.
  • Editing Expertise: Advanced photo editing skills to ensure every shot is polished and professional.
  • Mobile Proficiency: An updated mobile device capable of capturing clear, detailed images for on-site walkthrough reports.
  • Collaborative Spirit: Excellent written communication skills and a professional demeanor when representing the Ziprent/TurboTenant brand.
  • Reliability: A valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and a flexible schedule to handle multiple shoots per month.
  • Location: You must live within 35 miles of the market area to be considered for this role.

Bonus SuperPowers:

  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with FHA and housing compliance (smoke alarms, CO detectors, etc.).
  • Efficient Workflow: You stay ahead of the curve by leveraging modern tools and smart processes to streamline documentation, reporting, and day-to-day tasks—maximizing productivity without sacrificing quality.
  • Tech Comfort: You have a "can-do" attitude when it comes to learning new property management software.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You use modern tools to streamline your editing or reporting process for maximum efficiency.
  • Hyper-Detail Oriented: You notice the small things—from a loose door handle to a flickering light—that others might miss.

Our "Be Better" Culture:

At TurboTenant, we live by the Be Better mantra. Our high-performance culture makes us relentless in our efforts to Be Better at serving our landlords and renters, and in unlocking the potential in one another.

What does our Be Better culture mean to you?

  1. You’ll be in an environment that pushes you to reach your potential.
  2. You’ll make a massive impact on our landlords, renters, company, and the proptech industry.
  3. You’ll be on the highest performing team of your career.

About Us:

At TurboTenant, we simplify the complex and intimidating process of managing your own rental property. And we do it through an elegant software platform for small, “do-it-yourself” landlords and their tenants. But don’t take our word for it. Read reviews from some of our 1 million landlords.

Quantity of Jobs:

Number of job requests varies by market region. This is a contracted 1099 position, and requests are sent out on an as-needed basis. Most markets average 3 –10+ jobs per month.

Candidates should be flexible and comfortable with limited assignments initially while the market and workload grow.

The role requires completion of a background check and signing of an independent contractor agreement.

Compensation

    • $225–$325+ per listing appointment (varies based on property size and scope)
      • Includes: professionally edited photos, Zillow 3D tour, floor plan, initial walkthrough report, and lockbox installation with key management
    • $50/hour for additional as-needed tasks
    • Lockbox Pick-Up:
      • $30–$60 per lockbox (depending on distance)
    • Travel Compensation:
      • Paid for travel exceeding 35 miles each way (70 miles round trip)
      • Reimbursed at $1.20 per mile beyond this threshold

Salary Range
$1—$100,000 USD

Additional Information

TurboTenant is proud to serve a diverse group of landlords and renters. We strive to reflect that diversity within our team. Employment at TurboTenant is based on merit, competence, performance, and business need. TurboTenant celebrates being an equal opportunity employer and never discriminates based on race, color, genetic information, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), age, or any other basis protected by law.

At this time, employer-based visa sponsorship is not available. All candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Next Steps

Ready to work on the highest performing team of your career at TurboTenant? Submit your resume and we’ll be in touch soon.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Us

Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

About the Role

JOB OVERVIEW

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Private Technology team, you will design, build, and support high-quality systems that enable investment decisions and advance Wellington Management’s Private Investments platform, one of the firm’s fastest growing and most strategic areas.

Working across the private investment’s ecosystem, you will collaborate with Investment teams, Fund Control & Operations, Valuation, Legal, Compliance, Reporting, and technology partners to deliver integrated, end-to-end solutions. You will provide hands-on technical expertise and architectural guidance across the investment lifecycle, from deal sourcing and execution through portfolio management and operations. You will also help advance scalable, data-driven infrastructure and apply AI to improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and decision-making.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack software solutions, including web, mobile, desktop, and platform services.
  • Influence architecture and guide technical decisions, balancing near-term delivery priorities with long-term platform scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Partner with business teams, project managers, and systems analysts to translate business needs into clear requirements, technical specifications, and test plans.
  • Contribute throughout the delivery lifecycle, including solution design, prototyping, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Support vendor integrations for products such as Dynamo, IVP, and Affinity, partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to design interfaces, coordinate implementations, troubleshooting issues, and ensure reliable data flows.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of software development experience, including the design and delivery of backend systems using Python, Java, TypeScript, or comparable enterprise technologies.
  • Experience with modern software development tools and platforms, including issue tracking (JIRA or Linear), source control (Git), CI/CD (Jenkins or GitHub Actions), IDEs (VS Code, IntelliJ, or Eclipse), cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, to accelerate development and improve software quality.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • A strong sense of ownership and a commitment to serving as a dependable steward of a business-critical platform while pursuing continuous improvement.
  • Ability to balance project delivery, production support, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement in a highly regulated environment where system reliability and reporting accuracy are essential.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in financial services or investment management; exposure to private or alternative investments is a plus.
  • Knowledge of event-driven architecture and messaging platforms.

JOB TITLE

Senior Software Engineer

JOB FAMILY

Software Engineering

LOCATION

Needham

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

As an equal opportunity employer, Wellington Management considers all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, religion, creed, national origin, age, ancestry, disability (physical or mental), medical condition, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at GMWTalentOperations@wellington.com.

At Wellington Management, our approach to compensation is designed to help us attract, inspire and retain the best talent in our industry. We strive to pay employees fairly and competitively across all levels and roles. Our approach to compensation considers all aspects of total compensation; all employees are eligible to receive salary, variable compensation, and benefits. The base salary range for this position is:

USD 90,000 - 180,000

This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered when making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; role; skills and experience; certifications; and education. This range is an estimate, and further details on salary and total compensation aspects will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process.

Base salary is only one component of Wellington’s total compensation approach. Other rewards may include a discretionary Corporate Bonus and/ or Incentives, if eligible. In addition, we offer a comprehensive and high value benefit package to meet the unique needs of our employees and their families, and we are committed to fostering a flexible work environment that enables employees to thrive personally and professionally. Examples of our benefits include retirement plan, health and wellbeing, dental, vision, and pharmacy coverage, health savings account, flexible spending accounts and commuter program, employee assistance program, life and disability insurance, adoption assistance, back-up childcare, tuition/CFA reimbursement and paid time off (leave of absence, paid holidays, volunteer, sick and vacation time).

We believe that in person interactions inspire and energize our community and are essential to our culture. title: Michigan Program Planning Coach
description:
About You

You love Jesus. You love kids. You enjoy helping others succeed. Whether encouraging someone through a challenge, celebrating a milestone, or helping a leader develop a plan to overcome obstacles, you find joy in seeing people grow in confidence and effectiveness. You are organized, proactive, and able to keep multiple projects moving at the same time. You naturally follow through on commitments, communicate clearly, and aren't afraid to have honest conversations that help people stay on track.

You notice when something doesn't seem right and ask good questions before small issues become big problems. You balance encouragement with accountability and are energized by helping teams achieve ambitious goals. At the end of the day, you do what it takes to get things done. Above all, you know this isn’t just your career. It’s a chance to do something meaningful. A chance to serve others. And a chance to make a life-changing impact on students with the gospel.

The Planning Program Coach is a full-time, remote position that works with local LifeWise launch teams to successfully pray, promote and plan their local LifeWise program.

This role serves as a trusted guide throughout the planning process by equipping, training, inspiring and coming alongside the local launch team as they develop a plan, consult with local administrators, begin local fund raising, recruit and hire a local program director.

  • Build and strengthen high-performing Launch Teams by equipping members with the tools, resources, and support needed for long-term success.
  • Recruit, identify, and retain qualified leaders who align with the mission, vision, and values of LifeWise Academy.
  • Train, coach, equip, and provide ongoing feedback to Launch Teams, fostering accountability, leadership development, and organizational excellence.
  • Support the healthy growth and expansion of LifeWise programs by identifying opportunities, removing barriers, and implementing strategic solutions.
  • Evaluate program health and progress using established metrics, document findings within the LifeWise customer relationship management (CRM) platform, and develop action plans to move communities forward.
  • Partner with Planning Team leadership to translate strategic initiatives into practical processes, implement scalable systems, and continuously improve the effectiveness and efficiency of Planning Team operations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal departments to ensure a consistent, high-quality experience for local communities throughout the planning process.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications and Experience

  • A mature personal Christian faith consistent with the LifeWise Academy Statement of Faith
  • Bachelor's degree (preferred)
  • Experience working with ministry personnel, school administration and community leaders
  • Experience working in an organization using Salesforce (preferred)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3+ years in a ministry or other leadership position
  • Proficient using Google Workspace suite of tools and programs
  • Located in Michigan

Salary and Benefits

  • From $50,000 per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for qualified employees
  • Retirement plan, including employer match
  • Unlimited PTO for qualified employees

LifeWise Academy's hiring practices and EEO Statement are fully in compliance with both federal and state law. LifeWise Academy is in that category.

title: Lead TS&D Specialist
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.

Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.

Dow has an opportunity for a Technical Service and Development for Industrial and Chemical Processing located in Jundiaí (SP) - BRA


Are you passionate about using science and technology to solve real customer challenges? In this role, you will combine technical expertise, close interaction with laboratory work, and direct customer engagement to develop innovative solutions for the Industrial and Chemical Process market for customers across South America.

Industrial and Chemical Process market involves silicone applications for some markets, such as Agro, Textiles, Surfactants for Polyurethanes, and others, applying the silicones solutions available in Dow’s portfolio.

You will work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to understand technical needs, develop and validate new applications, troubleshoot performance challenges, and identify opportunities where Dow technologies can create value.

This is a highly collaborative and customer-facing role. You will have the opportunity to develop customized solutions in the laboratory, visit customers, deliver technical training, present Dow technologies, and represent the company at industry events and conferences.

You will use your technical knowledge and understanding of business drivers to turn customer needs into practical solutions and business opportunities. You will also contribute to multidisciplinary global projects, share your expertise with local and global colleagues, and help strengthen the technical capabilities of the broader team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop innovative, value-creating technical solutions that address customer needs and create new business opportunities.
  • Apply your understanding of Dow technologies and their use across multiple applications to connect product benefits with customer and market needs.
  • Work close with our laboratory team to develop, test, and optimize customized solutions for customers in South America.
  • Apply the scientific method to solve technical challenges, troubleshoot performance issues, eliminate defects, and improve product and application performance.
  • Engage directly with customers, including technical visits, troubleshooting, product demonstrations, application discussions, and training.
  • Deliver technical presentations to customers, distributors, and other industry audiences, including participation in conferences and technical events when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, contributing technical expertise and delivering results aligned with project and business objectives.

  • Document technical work through reports, presentations, technical records, publications, and patent disclosures, as appropriate.
  • Partner with Product Stewardship and other functions to understand regulatory requirements and ensure that solutions and product strategies can be successfully implemented.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline, or at least 8 years of relevant professional experience in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
  • Experience working in a laboratory or technical application development environment.
  • Ability to translate technical knowledge and experimental results into practical solutions for customers.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish.
  • Availability to travel approximately 30% of the time, primarily to support customers, distributors, technical events, and business activities.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in technical service, application development, R&D, or customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience delivering technical training or presenting at customer meetings, conferences, or industry events.

title: Pricing & Business Coordinator
description:

title: EMEA Enablement Program Manager
description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

About the Role

As the EMEA Enablement Program Manager at Endor Labs, you'll be the go-to enablement partner for our EMEA sales team while we scale it. You'll partner directly with our EMEA Sales leader to run onboarding, training, and field readiness programs locally, so new and existing sellers in the region get the same quality of enablement as the US, in their time zone. This is a hands-on, cover-the-ground role: if it helps EMEA sellers ramp faster and win more, it's yours to run.

About You

You've run enablement or sales programs for a B2B SaaS sales team in EMEA, ideally in security or developer tools, and you know what it takes to keep a growing, multi-country team aligned. You're a program manager at heart: organized, reliable, and comfortable owning many moving parts at once. You'd rather be in the room with reps and managers than build decks in isolation, and you're energized by helping a team scale from the ground up.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Be the EMEA enablement partner: Work side by side with EMEA Sales leadership to understand team priorities, skill gaps, and hiring plans, and turn them into an enablement calendar for the region.
  • Run onboarding in-region: Deliver and localize our global onboarding program for EMEA hires, coordinate their attendance at our in-person bootcamp, and track each new hire's progress through ramp.
  • Own the program calendar: Plan and run recurring enablement reinforcing Value Selling frameworks & Sales Methodologies to drive us toward our business objectives. Product and feature training, sales play rollouts, certifications, deal reviews, and team workshops.
  • Bring global programs to EMEA: Partner with our Sales Enablement Leader and the US enablement team to adapt content and programs for EMEA markets, languages, and buying cycles.
  • Run regional events: Lead logistics and agendas for EMEA kickoffs, offsites, and in-person trainings.
  • Measure what works: Track completion, certification, and ramp data for the region, gather feedback from reps and managers, and report on what's working and what needs to change.
  • Fill the gaps: Act as the flexible enablement resource EMEA needs as the team grows, from manager support to content updates to tool training.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 4+ years in sales enablement, sales or revenue operations, or a program management role supporting a B2B SaaS sales team
  • Experience supporting sales teams across multiple EMEA countries; security, DevOps, or developer tools experience is a strong plus
  • Strong program and project management skills: you keep stakeholders informed and programs on schedule
  • Confident presenter and facilitator, in person and virtually
  • Comfortable with sales tools such as Salesforce, Gong, and an LMS or enablement platform
  • Willing to travel within EMEA and occasionally to the US
  • Additional European languages are a plus

Why Endor Labs

We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security, one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our developer-loved platform delivers measurable ROI, strong market momentum, and a customer base that deeply values our mission.

At Endor Labs, we think big, start small, and learn fast. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with customer success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way, because when our customers win, we all win.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

description:
Role Responsibilities

Join Western Union's Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) within the Global Compliance organization, where you will help protect the business and its customers from money laundering, terrorist financing, and other financial crime risks. As a people leader within the Office of Consumer Monitoring and Investigations (OCMI), you will lead a team of investigators responsible for reviewing and investigating unusual consumer transaction activity. You will support operational performance, ensure quality and consistency in investigative outcomes, and help foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for monitoring, reviewing, and investigating consumer transaction activity for potential financial crime risks and Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and oversight to investigators, including case reviews, escalation support, workload prioritization, and performance management.
  • Oversee case inventory, workload distribution, and investigator productivity to support timely and effective completion of investigative activities.
  • Ensure investigations are completed accurately, consistently, and in accordance with established quality, productivity, and regulatory standards.
  • Drive accountability for team performance, quality outcomes, and adherence to compliance and operational procedures.
  • Support the identification and escalation of suspicious activity, emerging risks, and financial crime trends to leadership, as appropriate.
  • Serve as a resource to team members on investigative procedures, compliance requirements, SAR filings, and case management processes.
  • Develop team capabilities through coaching, performance feedback, training, and employee development activities.
  • Facilitate team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions that reinforce operational priorities, process consistency, and team engagement.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Quality Assurance, Operations, and other business partners to address issues, support process improvements, and achieve organizational objectives.
  • Prepare and deliver operational updates, performance insights, and risk-related information to leadership.
  • Support projects, process enhancements, and operational initiatives that improve investigative workflows, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
  • Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of policies, procedures, training materials, and operational controls to support regulatory and business requirements.
  • Partner with Quality Assurance teams to address findings, support corrective actions, and identify opportunities to strengthen investigative quality and consistency.

Role Requirements

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in anti-money laundering compliance, financial crime investigations, transaction monitoring, risk management, financial services compliance, or related compliance functions.
  • 1+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing employee performance.
  • Experience reviewing, monitoring, investigating, or analyzing customer transactions, alerts, or financial activity within a regulated environment.
  • Experience working within financial services, payments, banking, remittance, fintech, compliance, risk management, or another regulated industry.
  • *Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Western Union will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience within the global money remittance, payments, banking, fintech, or broader financial services industry.
  • Experience supporting anti-money laundering, counter-terrorist financing, sanctions, fraud, or other financial crime compliance programs.
  • Experience leading teams within a high-volume operational, investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or customer monitoring environment.
  • Experience identifying opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, or quality enhancement.
  • Working knowledge of money laundering typologies, suspicious activity indicators, and financial crime risks.
  • Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, controls, and regulatory requirements within an operational setting.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience using case management, investigative, reporting, or workflow management systems.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated operational services environment.
  • Additional language proficiency beyond English.
  • Professional certification such as CAMS, CFCS, CFE, or a similar financial crime or compliance designation.

title: Manager, Service Desk
description:
Worker Type

Regular


Job Description

Summary

The primary role of the Manager, Service Desk is to oversee daily Service Desk operations and frontline staff, ensuring end users receive timely, high-quality technical assistance. This role manages all procedures related to the identification, prioritization, assignment, and resolution of incidents and requests, including queue monitoring, SLA tracking, and operational coordination. The Manager, Service Desk executes established ITIL processes, asset management workflows, and service metrics across the organization. This individual implements standard operating procedures, conducts capacity planning, performs trend analysis, and coaches staff to achieve consistent service levels. The Manager, Service Desk also actively contributes to escalated problem resolution by providing direct, hands-on technical support when necessary.


Position Responsibilities

  • Aligns daily Service Desk operations with IT leadership’s strategy, communicating operational updates, service metrics, and team performance to leadership.
  • Enforces Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to maintain expected problem resolution timeframes and customer satisfaction standards.
  • Implements and maintains standard operating procedures outlining how incidents and service requests are logged, triaged, escalated, and resolved.
  • Analyzes daily and weekly Service Desk activity, identifies recurring bottlenecks or incident trends, and implements operational fixes.
  • Conducts regular performance evaluations, 1-on-1 coaching, and goal setting for Service Desk technicians and support staff.
  • Monitors team operational expenditures and provides input into annual hardware, software, and staffing budget forecasts.
  • Administers and optimizes ticketing system workflows, request catalogs, and asset tracking configurations based on operational needs.
  • Evaluates Service Desk software, endpoint utilities, and hardware peripherals in coordination with IT procurement and vendor contacts.
  • Coordinates purchasing, provisioning, and deployment tasks for end-user computing hardware and peripherals.
  • Supervises a distributed/multi-site technical support team, managing shift schedules, ticket routing, and escalation coverage.
  • Ensures prompt, professional, and effective resolution of Tier 1–Tier 3 tickets across enterprise applications and hardware.
  • Develops and maintains end-user knowledge bases, self-service portals, FAQs, and internal technical runbooks.
  • Onboards, trains, and mentors junior technicians to enhance technical competency and service delivery quality.
  • Provides hands-on, in-person, and remote troubleshooting support for executive and high-priority technical escalations.
  • Represents the Service Desk team in Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings to review upcoming changes and assess operational impact.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills & Experience)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience).
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in IT Service Desk / Technical Support environments.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of direct supervisory or team lead experience managing IT support personnel.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience supporting enterprise desktop and mobile platforms (Windows, macOS, iOS, Linux).
  • Demonstrated experience administering and configuring enterprise ticketing platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Ivanti).
  • Working knowledge of enterprise endpoint management and software deployment tools (e.g., VMware Workspace ONE, Microsoft Intune/MECM, Ivanti EPM).
  • Proven track record of monitoring, meeting, and reporting on ITIL-aligned SLAs and operational KPIs.
  • 40-hour on-site work week with flexibility for on-call escalations when required.

Other Qualifications & Desired Competencies

  • ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) required; Intermediate ITIL/ITSM knowledge preferred.
  • Experience managing distributed, remote, or multi-site support teams preferred.
  • Strong customer-service mindset with solid verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proven analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize, delegate, and execute operational tasks in a dynamic environment.
  • Solid relationship management skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into user-friendly guidance.
  • Occasional domestic travel may be required.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in an office environment (Constant).
  • Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone equipment (Frequent).
  • Must be able to lift and move up to 30 pounds of IT hardware and peripherals (computers, monitors, docking stations).

No Clearance

title: Nutrition Care Asst-31
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

This position provides direct patient meal service, either obtaining meal selections in person or via the hospitality center ordering system, delivering meals and retrieving meal trays. Must be knowledgeable in special diets and allergies. Also maintain cleanliness of nutrition centers in patient care areas. Excellent customer service skills and concern for all aspects of patient safety crucial.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Must have a valid Food Service Worker Permit (FSWP) from Monongalia County Health Department (MCHD) prior to starting OR obtain a MCHD Temporary FSWP no later than the first Wednesday of employment* and a permanent MCHD FSWP within 1 month of start date (next available class). Must have a valid MCHD FSWP throughout employment. *Until a Temporary FSWP is obtained: May not handle exposed food or any food contact surface, equipment or utensil; May be trained on tray delivery and complete general department orientation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. High School Diploma or Equivalent preferred.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Answers phone calls from patients following customer service standards

2. Appropriately follows diet restrictions, including allergies and fluid restrictions

3. Utilizes EPIC and VST for necessary patient information and to correctly process menu requests

4. Processes between meal nourishment orders and prints for kitchen staff

5. Follows department procedure for the missed meal reports including alerting nursing.

6. May be asked to deliver or retrieve meal trays as needed.

7. Visits patients designated “needs assistance” for menu selections and properly enters according to diet restrictions.

8. Delivers meal trays to patients within service guidelines for timeliness.

9. Follows delivery standards including hand sanitization, infection control requirements, two patient identifiers, AIDET and key phrases. Alerts nursing if patient is not properly positioned to begin eating or otherwise appears to need assistance.

10. Checks trays for missing items and intervenes to correct immediately. Maintains supply of condiments on cart.

11. Documents information required for ordered calorie counts

12. Monitors new patients for knowledge of room service, gives menu and explains as needed.

13. Rapport is established and maintained with nursing staff as evidenced by positive feedback and comments regarding communication with NCA.

14. Functions as a team with Clinical Dietitians. Respects Dietitian’s prime responsibility for patient nutritional care and responds appropriately.

15. Communicates clearly with tray line and production personnel regarding patient special requests (follow-ups on any unusual requests) to meet patient needs.

16. Meets sanitation, safety and quality control guidelines set forth by departmental policies, health department regulations and HAACP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) in maintaining cleanliness of nutrition centers on the units.

17. Patient trays are collected and returned to the kitchen within a reasonable timeframe.

18. While waiting for trays, assists the room service assembly line as needed, wrap silverware or help in dishroom.

19. Follows procedures for phone and iPad use.

20. Other duties may be assigned. May include duties normally done by a dietetic assistant.

21. Daily deadlines – must have menus completed by certain times and deliver meals on time.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Can push fully loaded tray cart (approx. 250 lbs)

2. Ability to stand for most of the working day

WORKING ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. This positions requires patient interaction, some conditions/appearance may be distressing.

2. Enter isolation precaution patient rooms with proper protective equipment.

3. Kitchen environment often noisy.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

1. Ability to understand written and oral communication.

Additional Job Description:

Shift will be 1pm to 930 pm

rotating weekends

rotating holiday

title: Product Analyst
description:
Who You Are

You have prior data analytics experience and desire the opportunity to guide product development through data-driven insights. You have ambitions to learn and grow alongside Quantifind’s exceptional software engineers and data scientists in a fast-paced development environment. You understand the concepts of storytelling with data to support our customers with recommendations backed by quantitative rationale. You have a high attention to detail and are looking for an opportunity that will challenge your technical skills and stretch your critical thinking abilities as you solve complex problems. You are customer-centric and have a passion for providing strategic solutions that improve product experience. You are comfortable engaging directly with customers to understand their pain points, collecting their feedback, and translating it into actionable insights that inform product decisions. Your ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, including customers, ensures that they feel heard, understood, and supported. You thrive in an environment where you can influence product direction based on customer needs, helping to shape the future of the product. Above all else, you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things, continuously seeking to improve both your technical and customer-facing skills.

Who We Are

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world’s biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind’s Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind’s solution uniquely combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes. Today these compliance processes are burdened by ever-increasing regulatory responsibilities and an expectation of frictionless transactions. Legacy technologies demand increasingly more human resources as the operations expand; Quantifind’s solution offers a way to cut through the inefficiency and enhance effectiveness simultaneously.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family friendly work-life balance.

What a Great Candidate Looks Like:

  • You hold a BS or MS in computer science, mathematics, or engineering and have 2+ years of data analytics experience
  • You have familiarity with relevant data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Excel, R/Python) to track metrics, measure success, and analyze product performance.
  • You are experienced in interacting directly with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and are familiar with common API protocols
  • You are conversant in the agile software development process and relevant tools such as Atlassian Jira® and GitHub
  • You have strong problem-solving skills with a knack for identifying product-related issues and recommending solutions that improve customer satisfaction and product usability.
  • You are able to effectively translate customer requirements, both written and verbal, between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have a keen eye for detail in product testing, customer interactions, and data analysis to ensure accuracy and quality across all responsibilities.
  • You have an ownership mentality and thrive in situations where you are responsible for delivering an outcome
  • You are eager to evolve and face new challenges

The Opportunity We Offer

In this role, you will become a key member of a close-knit team with the responsibility to provide findings and recommendations to product managers and designers. You will collaborate with data science and engineering teams by working with cutting-edge yet practical AI technology in production, transforming the status quo through ad hoc analytics and model performance validation. Additionally, you will be asked to serve in a customer-facing capacity to ensure optimal product usage, actively engaging with clients to understand their needs and challenges. This will include joining regular customer check-ins, offering data-backed insights to improve product usage, and guiding them on best practices to maximize the value of the product. You will have the opportunity to shape customer integrations and create product documentation that helps users optimize their experience.

This role will give you direct contact with the executive leaders of Product, Design, Customer Success, and Engineering as you help us innovate new solutions. A successful candidate will play an integral role in keeping our customers satisfied and our engineers focused on the highest-value activities. You will be instrumental in gathering customer feedback and translating it into actionable insights that will directly influence product development. The Product Analyst is the data-driven storyteller that we rely on to tell us, “How are customers using our product and how can we make it better?”

This role is intended to allow a successful candidate to grow into the Technical Product Manager position, offering a unique blend of technical analysis and customer-facing opportunities. You will be seen as the bridge between our customers and the Product team, helping to ensure that the customer voice is heard in every stage of the product lifecycle. By driving customer success initiatives alongside your analytical responsibilities, you will help deliver value at every touchpoint, fostering long-term relationships and ensuring that the product evolves to meet the needs of its users.

Quantifind operates an informal hybrid schedule around hubs in Palo Alto, California, Washington D.C., New York City, New York, and Boston, Massachusetts with the balance of engineers in the Palo Alto area. Quantifind is currently using a hybrid mix of working from home and in the office, with regular in-person touch points and shared office space. Our preference is New York City, NY, but open to other East Coast based cities such as Boston, MA, Washington D.C., and Charlotte, NC.

A highlight of our benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • Company Equity
  • Exceptional benefits package
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Time Off
  • Employer-matched 401(k) plan
  • A fun environment where work-life balance is valued

Your exact offer will depend on your experience, skills, and location.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $95,000-125,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location, role-related knowledge and skills, depth of experience, relevant education or training, and additional role-related considerations.

We are an equal opportunity employer; we have a fun place to work and a devotion to succeeding together.

Will you join us? Apply now!

title: Client OEM Investment Manager
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone. Want to learn more? Visit our YouTube Channel or the link below.

Life at Intel


The Role and Impact
As an OEM Investment Pricing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Intel's pricing strategies to ensure our products are competitively positioned within the market, specifically supporting customer(s) pricing strategy. You will analyze industry and customer data to develop, implement, and refine pricing models, collaborate across teams to create impactful programs that drive revenue and customer satisfaction. Your work will directly influence how Intel navigates dynamic market conditions, ensuring our pricing aligns with business goals and customer expectations.

Business Group
The Pricing team within Intel Corporation is responsible for crafting and executing global pricing strategies that support Intel's business objectives and customer success. By partnering with Sales, Marketing, Business Development, and Finance, the team works to ensure pricing practices align with Intel's reputation for innovation and customer-centricity, contributing to the company's broader mission of driving world-class technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and evaluate pricing strategies based on industry dynamics, competitive positioning, and Intel's value proposition.
  • Monitor market trends and shifts in competitive landscape to ensure pricing practices remain aligned with customer satisfaction and business goals.
  • Analyze customer insights, data, and sentiment to inform global pricing strategies and decision-making processes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to coordinate pricing programs that meet revenue recognition requirements.
  • Implement pricing changes, individual promotions, and rebate programs, ensuring alignment with revenue objectives.
  • Manage pricing databases and collaborate with relevant stakeholders for seamless execution of pricing proposals.
  • Track and summarize third-party research and vendor market trends to identify actionable insights for pricing strategies.
  • Maintain internal policies and processes related to pricing models, ensuring consistency and compliance.



Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your school work/classes/research and/or relevant previous job and/or internship experiences.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business, Economics, Finance, or a closely related discipline.
  • 9+ years of professional experience in pricing analysis, strategy development, or a similar domain in technology or semiconductor industry.
  • 9+ years in data analysis tools and software, such as Excel or Tableau, with proven ability to interpret and present complex data.
  • 5+ years' experience in developing pricing models and executing pricing programs in a business environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as a Master's or PhD in a relevant field with 6+ years of professional experience in pricing or related roles.
  • Familiarity with Intel product roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics and competitive analysis methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams, including Sales, Marketing, and Finance.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing large-scale pricing databases or ERP systems for pricing implementation.
  • Familiarity with revenue recognition principles and financial planning processes.

Your expertise will contribute to Intel's ability to deliver innovative solutions at competitive pricing, helping shape the future of technology. Join us to make a difference and grow your career with a global leader committed to excellence, innovation, and impact.


Benefits at Intel

Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you're looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Go to Intel Benefits | Intel Careers for details of benefits available to you. Intel reserves the right to modify, change or discontinue benefit plans at any time in its sole discretion.

description:
Benefits Start Day 1 for Full-Time Colleagues - No Waiting Period!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Aquatic Technicians do?

The primary purposes for this role is preserving the natural ecological balance of our aquatic ecosystems while providing our clients with superior value and expertise in the field. Aquatic Technicians play a key role in preserving our environment. When these technicians service aquatics it helps to ensure the health of the water and the safety of those who use it.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Operate a motorboat multiple times throughout the day and attach to assigned vehicle

  • Treat water for algae, submersed weeds, shoreline weeds, non-desirable buffer vegetation and any other unwanted vegetation

  • At times obtain water samples to send to the lab for water quality analysis

  • Provide superior service and fulfil all company contracts, service orders, and related customer needs

  • Remove nuisance, invasive vegetation through manual removal efforts (occasionally)

  • Work with experienced Aquatic Specialists in the field to gain knowledge on servicing aspects of water body management

  • Great communication skills to discuss the service effectively with customers

Essential Job Functions:

  • Ability to follow established procedures and practices

  • Commitment to all health and safety guidelines

  • Effective verbal and listening communication skills

  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy

  • Mechanically inclined (preferred)

  • Knowledge of aquatic vegetation (preferred)

title: Assistant Director of the Muhlenberg Residence
company: Lutheran Social Services of New York
description:
POSITION: Assistant Director of the Muhlenberg Residence

REPORTS TO: Assistant Executive Director for Residential Services

CLASSIFICATION: Full Time/Management

EXEMPT/NONEXEMPT: Exempt

GENERAL DESCRIPTION: The Muhlenberg Residence serves extremely vulnerable individuals, including people with histories of homelessness and/or mental illness. The Assistant Director of the Muhlenberg Residence provides leadership, supervision and training to the onsite social service staff. The Assistant Director also serves as the liaison between participants and the Assistant Executive Director. The Assistant Director supports the Assistant Executive Director in managing the day-to-day operations of the facility and the program at the Muhlenberg Residence. The Assistant Director works alongside the Assistant Executive Director to create and execute work plans/goals to meet the ever-changing needs of the participants and the facility at Muhlenberg.

This is a 24-hour program. The Assistant Director is classified as an essential worker, and as such accepts responsibility for the completion of their critical services to participants, on site, even during times of emergency. These include, but are not limited to, emergencies caused by weather, nationwide pandemics, civil unrest, and domestic threat.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES:

  • Provides leadership, guidance and administrative supervision to social service staff and oversees the Job Development/Vocational component of the Muhlenberg program.

  • Oversees the rental and maintenance department and security contractor in the event of Director’s extended absence.

  • Provides weekly one-on-one supervision for social services staff.

  • Conducts case conferences; resolves participant issues.

  • Reviews service plans, program notes, and other participant documentation to ensure comprehensiveness and compliance with funder, regulatory and LSSNY requirements. Signs off on final documents prior to filing in participant charts.

  • Audits participant records to ensure compliance with funder, regulatory and LSSNY requirements.

  • Conducts regular staff meetings.

  • Provides training to social services staff.

  • Provides ongoing feedback and annual job performance evaluations to case managers.

  • Supervises incident reporting; strategizes follow-up with social services team.

  • Conducts participant assessment and crisis intervention.

  • Participates in participant intake process, including selection and screening of residents.

  • Supervises interns assisting with social services work.

  • Prepares monthly reports (including statistics and other data) for program funding sources and agency reporting purposes.

  • Assists Assistant Executive Director with annual reports.

  • Approves timecards and changes in staff schedules; monitors attendance of social service staff.

  • Completes monthly calendar of events and schedules group activities.

  • Assists Assistant Executive Director with Human Resource matters, including interviewing and hiring, performance improvement plans and terminations.

  • Coordinates with Assistant Executive Director regarding office supply orders; may handle petty cash custodial duties and other administrative tasks if needed.

  • Serves as on-site liaison for participants.

  • Develops and maintains relationships with community resources.

  • Assists Assistant Executive Director with other functions related to the program, especially in overseeing day-to-day operations of the facility in Assistant Executive Director’s absence.

  • On call 24 hours/day, 7 days/week.

  • Adheres to confidentiality protocols outlined by the agency.

  • Demonstrates commitment to social justice and promotes equity by identifying and removing barriers, facilitating learning, cultivating community, and empowering others.

  • Represents Lutheran Social Service of New York’s mission and values; upholds agency Code of Conduct and other policies and procedures.

SUPERVISES:

  • Case Managers

  • Volunteers/Interns

  • Job Developer & Vocational Trainer

  • Other Muhlenberg staff (such as Rental Agent, maintenance personnel and security contractor) as requested by Assistant Executive Director.

title: Presales Engineering Manager
description:
Location: Schaumburg, IL

Salary Range: $150,000 - $170,000

Company Description

For over 50 years, DN Solutions has built machine tools that shape the world around us, including the cars we drive, the planes we fly, and the medical devices that save lives. We develop smart machines and customized solutions that advance these essential industries.

Join our applications engineering team and help coach, teach, manage the current and future members of DN Solutions!

Job Description

Lead the organization's technical sales and application engineering function by delivering innovative manufacturing solutions, validating customer success through proven machining processes, and developing a world-class team that drives profitable growth, customer satisfaction, and technology leadership in the CNC machine tool market.

This individual serves as the technical bridge between customers, sales teams (distributors and internal sales), product management (PSM team), and applications, ensuring proposed solutions meet customer productivity, quality, and profitability objectives while reporting to the Engineering Director.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Presales/Application Engineering team, establishing technical sales strategies and best practices that support company growth objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to customers, distributors, regional sales managers, and key account teams.
  • Evaluate customer manufacturing challenges, analyze engineering drawings and production requirements, and develop optimized machining solutions involving machine tools, tooling, work holding, automation, and software.
  • Oversee strategic machine demonstrations, proof-of-concept projects, test cuts, and customer runoffs to validate machining performance and meet customer requirements.
  • Direct the development of cycle time studies, process documentation, and competitive benchmarking to demonstrate solution performance and value.
  • Lead the technical development of turnkey and capital equipment proposals, including project scope, engineering estimates, statements of work, quotations, and customer deliverables.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop ROI analyses and business cases that support customer investment decisions.
  • Provide technical strategy and support for key accounts, major opportunities, and executive-level customer presentations across aerospace, medical, automotive, energy, defense, and general manufacturing industries.
  • Establish and monitor presales engineering performance metrics, including win rates, demonstration conversion, test cut success, cycle time improvements, and quote responsiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvement in application engineering processes, technical sales support, and team performance.
  • Recruit, train, and develop application engineering talent through technical training, coaching, and career development programs.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent manufacturing and machining experience may be considered.
  • 10+ years of experience in CNC machining, applications engineering, manufacturing engineering, or technical sales.
  • 5+ years of experience leading engineering or technical teams.
  • Demonstrated success supporting the sale of CNC machine tools, automation systems, or manufacturing solutions.
  • Extensive experience with multi-axis machining centers, turning centers, mill-turn systems, and automated manufacturing cells.
  • Strong knowledge of metal cutting processes, tooling, work holding, CAM programming, process optimization, and manufacturing economics.
  • Experience with CAD/CAM software, CNC programming, cutting tool selection, and fixture design.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T requirements, and complex manufacturing specifications.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, including customer presentations, proposal development, and customer engagement.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, strategic thinking, and business acumen, including capital equipment sales support and financial/ROI analysis.
  • Ability to travel approximately 25%.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting aerospace and other high-precision manufacturing applications.
  • Knowledge of robotics, automation systems, pallet systems, and flexible manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with digital manufacturing platforms, MES systems, machine monitoring, and process analytics.
  • Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma experience.
  • Project management experience supporting turnkey manufacturing solutions.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive pay based on experience.
  • 401(k)
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • Life Insurance and Short-Term Disability
  • Paid Time-Off including vacation, sick time, and Holidays.
  • Employee Referral Program

Our success is driven by our team of talented, dedicated individuals working closely together to meet or exceed customer expectations. Take the next step in your career and become part of our fast-growing company.

DN Solutions America is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status.

The ideal candidate should have experience in B2B sales, technical sales, or industrial sales, along with good communication and customer-handling skills. The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, understanding their technical requirements, presenting suitable solutions, and converting business opportunities into sales.
