title: Senior Scientist Bioconjugation
description:
Job Description


This is an exciting opportunity for a laboratory-based scientist to join the Bioconjugation and Analytical group in Oncology Targeted Discovery (OTD) at The Discovery Centre (DISC), Cambridge UK. You will become part of a team of Bioconjugation scientists and play a pivotal role in the delivery of robust and high-quality data to support drug discovery projects within the Oncology portfolio. Working collaboratively with other disciplines across AstraZeneca, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the research and development for early phase projects. You should have a background in Oncology/Biology/Chemical Biology and a strong passion for experimental work, automation and delivering data from the laboratory. You will use your scientific judgement, strong ability to analyse experimental data and use effective communication skills to contribute to decision making for early-stage drug discovery programmes. As a Bioconjugation Scientist, you'll have a deep understanding of the range of analytical procedures relating to bioanalysis/bioscience. You will expertly design and conduct laboratory projects/experiments, develop automation workflows and analytical methods, and generate, interpret, and report scientific data to relevant stakeholder.



What you’ll do

  • Develop, optimise and scale up drug discovery research lab experiments independently by applying the techniques of Bioconjugation of small molecules to antibodies and related scaffolds
  • Develop, implement and optimise HT bioconjugation workflows using automation e.g. liquid handlers
  • Perform routine interpretation of data with little or no guidance, with a clear understanding of its implications within drug discovery and effectively communicate to relevant stakeholders in a clear and concise manner
  • Works independently within a team and collaboratively with internal and external stakeholder
  • Maintains a well-developed understanding of approaches to targeted delivery of therapeutics within Oncology
  • Remain up to date with relevant recent advances and relevant technology including published papers/patents with peers
  • Authoring and reviewing relevant documents including laboratory notebooks, protocols and reports
  • Ensures own work, and work of peers, follows Good Laboratory Practice, Safety, Health and Environment standards and all other relevant internal AstraZeneca standards and external regulations

Skills and Experience

  • Ph.D in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Bio/Chemical engineering or relevant discipline
  • M.Sc or B.Sc in above disciplines with significant relevant industrial experience
  • Strong foundation in chemistry, protein biochemistry and bioconjugation
  • Hands on experience of performing a range of protein/bioconjugate characterisation by UV/Vis spectroscopy, size-exclusion/hydrophobic interaction/ion exchange chromatography HPLC and LCMS, ideally with Antibody-Drug Conjugates
  • Experience with executing preparative chromatography purifications using AKTA and TFF systems
  • Experience with programming, implementing and optimising automation workflows e.g. with liquid handlers is highly desirable
  • Knowledge and strong understanding of developing and optimising robust analytical methods for protein/bioconjugate characterisation might be beneficial
  • A track-record of protein/related scaffold modification experience
  • Proficiency in AI tools and their effective implementation might be beneficial

Why AstraZeneca?

At AstraZeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. There’s no better place to make a difference to medicine, patients and society. An inclusive culture that champions diversity and collaboration, and always committed to lifelong learning, growth and development. We’re on an exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare.


So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
POSITION TITLE: Manager, Software Engineering

POSITION LOCATION: San Carlos, CA, Austin, TX, or Remote, USA

POSITION SUMMARY:

Natera is seeking a hands-on, self-motivated Engineering Manager to lead a global software development team in the women's health domain in a fast-growing biotech company.

In this pivotal role, you will be at the forefront of cutting-edge research in the field of non-invasive prenatal testing, overseeing a team dedicated to advancing our revolutionary initiatives. Your responsibilities will encompass not only the development and direction of a distributed engineering workforce but also the orchestration of project management activities and the facilitation of clear and effective communication across all levels.This is not a pure people-management role. You will spend some amount of your time hands-on: writing code, reviewing merge requests, and testing alongside your team.We are looking for someone who pairs strong technical judgment with real care for people, is energized by change, and wants to make a direct impact on tests that families rely on.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead
    • Provide technical leadership for a software development team, US-based and international, to deliver high-quality software on time and on budget
    • Lead technical design, architecture, and implementation strategy for the team's services and integrations
    • Establish and model engineering best practices, including how AI tools are used safely in a regulated environment
  • Build
    • Write production code on the team's services, taking tickets yourself, especially on critical-path and cross-team work
    • Review merge requests every week. Hold a high bar for correctness, test coverage, and maintainability, whether the code was written by hand or with AI assistance
    • Contribute directly to testing: write and extend automated tests, verify changes before release, and help triage production issues
    • Stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls and credible estimates
  • Lead AI Transformation
    • Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools (for example Claude Code, GitHub, Cursor) in your own daily work, and coach your team to do the same
    • Redesign the team's workflow around AI:
      • AI-assisted ticket refinement and spec-driven development
      • AI-assisted code review
      • AI-generated tests
      • automation of repetitive work
    • Build a cross-functional team where developers and test engineers both build and verify, and no one verifies their own work
    • Measure AI's impact against the team's own baseline (cycle time, lead time, quality, time from grooming to ready) and share what works with other teams
    • Keep people accountable for AI-assisted work, so that it meets our review, traceability, validation, and compliance requirements
  • Manage
    • Manage multiple concurrent projects spanning product launches, platform migrations, and production support
    • Identify project objectives, the scope of software deliverables, external dependencies, resources, risks, and a framework for the project activities
    • Facilitate collaboration and resolve issues, evaluate project performance, bring projects to delivery, and act on the lessons learned
    • Lead team meetings and Agile rituals such as stand-ups, retrospectives, planning sessions, and demos
  • Nurture
    • Guide the career development of team members and grow their technical, interpersonal, and AI skills
    • Provide individual performance feedback focused on recognition of achievement and opportunities for growth
    • Conduct 1:1s, performance evaluations, and more
    • Recruit and hire strong, diverse talent
  • Collaborate
    • Build and maintain ongoing strong working relationships with stakeholders, focus on building effective communication channels
    • Build and maintain strong working relationships with product management, laboratory operations, bioinformatics, clinical, and quality partners
  • Effect change
    • Provide feedback to management and initiate change to optimize software development processes with focus on quality, innovation, and efficient product delivery

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of proven track record of building and managing high performance engineering teams
  • 5+ years of experience in software development using Java or similar languages
  • Practical, daily experience with AI coding tools and agentic workflows, and experience helping a team adopt them
  • Experience in and aptitude for leading remote teams
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Passion for people management and mentorship
  • Experience in biotech, diagnostics, healthcare, or another regulated industry a strong plus

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Proven record of managing highly effective engineering teams
  • Willingness and ability to manage global teams across multiple time zones
  • Focus on recruiting strong and diverse talent
  • Strong experience mentoring developers and test engineers, seeking out opportunities and giving guidance so engineers grow and excel
  • Excellent project management skills in Agile environments
  • Experience building enterprise back-end services using Java/Spring Boot or similar
  • Experience with distributed and event-driven systems such as Kafka, workflow orchestration such as Temporal, relational databases, and AWS
  • Hands-on coding, design, architecture, and code-review skills
  • Test automation experience, and a habit of building quality in rather than inspecting it in
  • A track record of using AI to measurably improve a team's delivery, backed by data rather than anecdotes
  • Sound judgment about where AI helps and where it needs guardrails: verification, security, patient data privacy, and validation of regulated software
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate effectively with reports, peers, and stakeholders
  • Initiative: a proactive approach to addressing issues and finding creative solutions
  • A strong work ethic and the ability to work well under pressure and in stressful circumstances
  • Experience with Next Generation Sequencing data, bioinformatics pipelines, or genomics workflow platforms is a plus
  • Experience developing software in a regulated environment (e.g., CLIA/CAP, FDA design controls, 21 CFR Part 11) is a plus

  • Ability to review and analyze P&L statement
  • Ability to recruit, select, hire and develop quality Team Members

  • Working knowledge of automotive systems preferred
  • Speak and write English (Spanish a plus); communicate effectively and build strong relationships with Customers, peers and upper management

Prior Experience that Sets a General Manager up for Success

  • 2-3 years of experience managing a team of 10 - 20 Team Members in a fast-paced and highly dynamic retail environment
  • Successful experience managing profitability; proven financial and business acumen

Education, Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

High school diploma or general education degree (GED), Bachelor’s degree in business or a related area preferred.

Must have a valid driver's license

ASE certification preferred, but not required

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The employee is also occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; risk of electrical shock; explosives; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Commercial Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for commercial customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from commercial properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points

  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards

  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.

title: AI Solutions Lead
location: Los Angeles, CA; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
description:
About Addition

Addition is R/GA's applied intelligence studio. We work with many of the world's leading brands to solve problems at the intersection of frontier AI and human-centered design. We collaborate with our clients to implement and scale AI systems that create real-world value—improving communications, customer experiences, and internal business workflows.

About R/GA

In our 40-year history, we’ve changed a lot—from a culture-defining film title studio (Superman, Alien, Ghostbusters); to an interactive advertising agency; to an award-winning product and marketing agency with design, technology, communications, ventures and IP practices. We like change, and like to navigate our clients through it too. Our approach to work is always human first. This unwavering focus helps us create meaningful and memorable experiences that live across digital platforms and often blur the line between the digital and real worlds. We believe disruptive thinking happens when you collide experts in design, technology and culture.

About the Role

As AI Solutions Lead, you run applied AI strategy on client engagements: assessing AI readiness, running discovery, defining solutions, and building the phased roadmaps and measurement plans that turn a client's ambition into work our designers, AI Engineers, and producers can ship. You work day-to-day with our AI Solutions Director and management team, at the intersection of business problems, customer needs, and technical problem solving.

This is a hands-on role. Our AI Solutions Director sets direction and vets what we take on; you make it real inside the engagement. You run the stakeholder interviews, distill the findings into an executive readout, and draft the roadmap and measurement plan that hold up under technical scrutiny. You're not selling; you make the work credible and comprehensible, and you are the day-to-day strategic voice the client team and our project team rely on.

We need someone who can own an engagement end to end: run the discovery, define the solution, build the plan, and make the recommendation hold up in the room. Someone who raises the bar for how we scope, measure, and deliver applied AI work, and brings the rigor to turn a client's ambition into something real.

This role sits within our Strategy team, reporting into our AI Solutions Director, and working closely with our designers, AI engineers, and producers.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Discovery + Stakeholder Interviews: During project planning phases, run structured interviews across client organizations, from product and engineering to executive leadership, to surface needs, constraints, and opportunities. Design and lead the user research (usability testing, journey mapping, interviews) that grounds solutions in real behavior rather than assumptions.
  • AI Readiness + Solution Definition: Lead readiness assessments and define solutions that connect business objectives and user needs to technical execution. Define what's feasible, what's valuable, and what to build first, and write it up as a phased plan the engineering team can scope against.
  • Measurement in Practice: Define success metrics, KPIs, and measurement frameworks for AI initiatives, then stand them up with engineering: instrument the evaluation, report against it, and share back what we're learning with the client.
  • Readouts + Strategic Deliverables: Synthesize research and discovery into clear, actionable readouts. Translate technical complexity into language that moves decisions forward, for C-suite and senior technical audiences alike.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with engineering, design, and production to shape scopes, validate approaches, and make sure roadmaps translate into deliverable work. You are the connective layer between "what the client needs" and "what we're building."
  • Operating the Playbook: Apply Addition's discovery, roadmapping, and measurement frameworks on every engagement and feed back what worked and what didn't, so the playbook improves with each client.

The Ideal Person

  • Has led discovery engagements end to end: stakeholder interviews, landscape assessments, and strategic readouts, not just contributed to them.
  • Has a background working in an agency, studio, or consultancy where projects run fast and strategy has to travel across diverse client work.
  • Has hands-on experience with AI implementation (not just strategy): has scoped, prototyped, or shipped something with LLMs, agents, or generative tools and knows what it takes to get it live.
  • Sits at the intersection of technology and applied creative, and can speak credibly to both marketing leadership and engineering.
  • Has built or contributed to repeatable frameworks for opportunity assessment, roadmapping, or measurement.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in strategy, solutions, or technical consulting roles at agencies, consultancies, or technology companies.
  • Proven experience leading discovery engagements: stakeholder interviews, landscape assessments, and strategic readouts.
  • Working technical fluency in Generative AI and AI systems.
  • Comfort presenting to senior client stakeholders and defending a recommendation under questioning.
  • Experience scoping and structuring AI or digital transformation workstreams.
  • Collaborative by default: you work across engineering, design, and production without friction.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-paced environments.

Why Join Addition?

  • Shape the Future: Lead and innovate at an AI-powered studio at the forefront of applied AI innovation.
  • High-Impact Work: Build and drive technological and creative solutions that redefine how global brands operate.
  • Direct Leadership Access: Collaborate closely with our CEO, leadership team, and R/GA network to help define how we scale.

This role is based in the NYC / Tri-State area, Greater Los Angeles area, or San Francisco Bay Area. Candidates must be located within commuting distance in the NYC area (NY, NJ, CT), Greater LA area (Southern California), San Francisco Bay Area, or be willing to relocate. This position offers a hybrid work model, with regular in-person collaboration and team / client workshops.

The hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $170,000. Where an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on, among other factors, actual ranges for current/former employees in the subject position; budgetary considerations; tenure and standing with the company (applicable to current employees); as well as the employee’s/applicant’s applicable skills, pertinent experience, and qualifications.

title: Reporter, Breaking News
description:
The Hill, a division of Nexstar Media Group, is looking for a journalist who prizes urgency and accuracy to join our team as a breaking news reporter. The Hill's breaking news reporters work as part of a team of journalists who cover DC newsmakers, policy decisions and key national news items through quick updates. The best applicant will show an ability to write clean, concise copy on a tight deadline where every minute counts in beating the competition. A strong interest in politics and national affairs and an ability to recognize news quickly will go a long way in the job. As with any breaking news role, this job may include night and weekend hours. The position is based at our Washington, DC offices.

About The Hill

Established in 1994, The Hill is the country's definitive digital source for non-partisan political news and information. Inside the Beltway, it's known as an essential, agenda-setting read for lawmakers and influencers. Beyond the Capitol, The Hill's trusted content is shared more often on social media than any other political news brand in America.

Our properties include TheHill.com, reaching a monthly audience of 41M; Hill.TV, the largest independent video platform within the Beltway with 1.4B annual views; The Hill's print edition, one of the most influential sources for law and policy makers; Elevate Studios, creating breakthrough branded content offerings for leading marketers; and The Hill Events, which hosted 70 virtual events last year, featuring 92 Members of Congress and 88 industry leaders in meaningful policy discussions.

About Nexstar Media Group

Nexstar Media Group, Inc. is a leading diversified media company that produces and distributes engaging local and national news, sports and entertainment content across its television and digital platforms, including more than 316,000 hours of programming produced annually by its business units. Nexstar owns America’s largest local broadcasting group comprised of top network affiliates, with more than 200 owned or partner stations in 116 U.S. markets reaching 220 million people.

Duties & Responsibilities:

• Write clean, concise copy on a tight deadline with a focus on immediacy and accuracy

• Conduct research and interviews to gather information and verify facts

• Craft articles with an eye towards audience engagement

• Work collaboratively with editors and other journalists to ensure appropriate coverage

• Utilize social media to share stories, interact with audience, and monitor trends

• Cultivate sources and contacts who are go-to sources for news and available for insights and analysis to contextualize breaking news coverage

• Perform other duties as assigned by leadership


Requirements & Skills:

• A bachelor’s degree in journalism or a related field is required

• Previous reporting experience in a metro or national media environment is preferred

• Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, MS Office)

• Basic familiarity with Google Trends, SEO skills and real-time analytics are a plus

• Commitment to being a self-starter who proactively seeks out tasks and opportunities for growth

• Excellent knowledge of current events and politics

• Must be detail-oriented and have excellent written and verbal communication

• Must have the ability to work under deadline pressure

• Must have the ability to handle multiple projects or assignments with attention to detail

• Must thrive in a collaborative work environment

•Must be able to work varied shifts: weekends, holidays, nights, overnights, or early mornings.



Compensation Range: $25.48 - $27.88 per hour based upon experience

Benefits: Our comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees includes, but not limited to, medical (with multiple plan options), dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) with company matching contributions, Paid Parental leave, life insurance and more. Part time employees are eligible for 401(k) and any local/state leave plans. Union positions are subject to the benefits outlined in their Collective Bargaining Agreement.

title: Quantitative Research Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary:

We are looking for a Quantitative Research Manager to join our Research and Market Insights team. Your job will be to publish cutting edge analysis and thought leadership pieces using athenahealth’s proprietary data assets. These topics can include patient engagement, provider burnout, disease surveillance, and most importantly, detailed analyses of client practice operations, clinical behavior, and best practices in care delivery.

But enough about us; let’s talk about you.

You are an intellectually restless, motivated, team-oriented data analyst with strong programming skills and a passion for health care. You are curious and have a strong familiarity with healthcare data and experience analyzing vast quantities of data. You possess the ability and willingness to get out and talk to stakeholders, come up with creative research ideas, and run with research initiatives from beginning to end. You understand the desired outcomes for success and prioritize work accordingly.


About the Team:

Our Research and Market Insights group is tasked with telling compelling data stories at the highest level, developing points of view on complex and nuanced industry issues through original research, while translating those perspectives into collateral that can be used across the entirety of athenahealth’s commercial and product organizations. We are passionate about research and using our knowledge to make healthcare more accessible, high-quality, and sustainable.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Use SQL, Python, R, and Excel to analyze and visualize healthcare data.
  • Develop, create, and deploy new de-identified research datasets for analysis.
  • Partner with our Marketing organization to turn findings into mature content for external consumption (i.e. presentations, data visualizations, reports, white papers, etc.).
  • Identify new research topics by talking to stakeholders and staying current on the latest trends in academic journals, popular press, policy changes, etc.
  • Develop a “trusted advisor” reputation across athenahealth. Become an expert on athenahealth’s business processes and data assets.
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to inform our broader research strategy.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in relevant quantitative field (i.e. Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, Public Health, or another quantitative field).
  • 3+ years of professional experience in data analytics, data science, machine learning, or applied data science.
  • Proven track record conducting exploratory data analyses with large, messy datasets.
  • Strong ability to write for technical and nontechnical audiences. Understanding of outpatient health care delivery, IT, research, and policy preferred.
  • Strong skills in SQL, R, and/or Python and experience in cloud-based environments (AWS & Snowflake preferred).
  • Demonstrated ability to create presentations that influence non-technical business audiences.
  • Experience with claims and/or EHR databases strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Expected Compensation

$96,000 - $162,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative workspaces — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

title: General Manager in Training
description:
Brandon, MS

Statement of Purpose:

The General Manager is responsible for executing the store plan to achieve established standards, sales, local marketing programs and profits. This is done primarily by staffing, personnel training, operating, and maintaining the store such that customer satisfaction is maximized.

ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Sales and Profits:

4. Develops (with DM) and executes a local store marketing plan (promoting Wendy's in the community) in response to market conditions such as competitor pricing and other competitor activities.

6. Develops and executes plan to improve sales and profits.

Operating Budget
1. Sets store budget goals monthly.
2. Meets monthly budget goals.
3. Communicates anticipated variances to the District Manager.
4. Develops appropriate time definite plans to resolve unfavorable trends in controllables, Q.S.C., sales and profits.

Staffing

2. Ensures and maintains adequate bench strength in management team.
3. Ensures co-manager has adequate crew depth for each shift.
4. Utilizes W.O.T.C. program.
5. Maintains process for handling applications and files.

Quality
1. Trains store personnel (management and crew) to execute procedures for preparation and serving of quality products.
2. Talks with customers during walk-throughs and when off-line to determine product and service quality.
3. Resolves customer complaints within 24 hours of receipt.

Service
1. Takes service times and determines efficiency.
2. Trains store personnel to respond promptly to customer needs.
3. Trains store personnel in customer courtesy.
4. Trains store personnel to solicit feedback to determine customer satisfaction.

Cleanliness
1. Trains store personnel to maintain store cleanliness during shifts.
2. Writes store cleaning plan.
3. Executes cleaning plan through delegation to the management team.
4. Achieves above satisfactory Q.S.C. scores consistently.

Training
1. Trains store personnel to execute new products to company standards.
2. Trains store personnel in company standards (Quality, Service and Cleanliness), as these standards are modified by operational changes.
3. Orients new managers and crew to the store.
4. Writes and manages a development plan for each manager based on position descriptions.
5. Manages Crew Orientation and Training process.
6. Promotes high-performing crew members to available crew leader and shift supervisor positions.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Solutions Engineer
description:
This position is full-time remote and requires the candidate have an active DoD secret clearance.


In this position, we will deliver enhanced capabilities and services to implement and operate an enterprise ITSM solution, enterprise service desk, endpoint management and security solution, as well as CONUS/OCONUS field support and life cycle support for end user devices to enable the DAF to transition focus from IT operations to mission operations.

Accelera Solutions is looking for a Senior Azure Cloud Solutions Engineer who architects, automates, and maintains scalable infrastructure services across our IL5 Azure platform. This role leads end-to-end solution design and implementation, driving complex cloud deployments, resolving technical challenges, and collaborating across engineering, networking, cybersecurity, and application teams to deliver secure, reliable, and mission-critical capabilities.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the design, engineering, and deployment of complex Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) and Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) solutions within enterprise DoD IL5 Azure environments.
• Serve as the technical lead for Azure deployments, translating application team requirements into scalable, secure, and operationally sustainable cloud solutions from initial design through production implementation.
• Architect, deploy, and configure Azure infrastructure, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity services, application hosting, and supporting platform components.
• Lead the deployment and integration of enterprise SaaS applications, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), containerized workloads, and supporting Azure services, resolving complex technical and architectural challenges.
• Design and implement cloud networking solutions, including Virtual Networks, DNS, Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, network security configurations, and hybrid connectivity to support application deployments.
• Develop and implement reusable Azure Bicep, ARM, and Terraform templates to standardize infrastructure provisioning, accelerate deployments, and reduce manual configuration errors.
• Develop and support Azure DevOps pipelines, Git-based workflows, and automated deployment processes to enable consistent, repeatable infrastructure and application deployments.
• Independently drive technical solutioning and coordinate with application teams, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, Microsoft partners, and other stakeholders to resolve deployment dependencies and deliver mission-critical capabilities.
• Diagnose and resolve complex Azure infrastructure, application integration, networking, and performance issues while recommending architectural improvements and optimizing deployed solutions.
• Ensure deployed solutions align with DoD IL5 security requirements, Zero Trust principles, and applicable cloud architecture standards while balancing mission requirements, performance, and operational efficiency.

title: Materials Coordinator
description:
Provides Material and Supply Chain Management activities for the division. Activities include materials planning, scheduling, inventory control, information flow and coordination, and asset management. Work with suppliers, business unit managers, purchasing, production planners, I/T, and other appropriate resources to strategically plan and coordinate the flow of materials and information from customers through procurement to delivery. Matrix management responsibilities with business units and support groups for production planning, shipping, receiving and inventory functions. Provide direct leadership and management of Purchasing and Supplier Quality functions for division.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Essential Job Functions:

  • Manage procurement and materials management activities including order placement, supplier price reduction/evaluation/certification, supplier follow-up
  • Accountable for division materials metrics and Standards of Performance.
  • Provide sourcing and procurement strategies with an emphasis on speed, cost reduction and secondary suppliers
  • Help define and implement automated systems to plan and track material flow from customers through procurement to delivery to support a supply chain management strategy
  • Facilitate corporate purchasing and materials initiatives including common part numbers, supplier managed inventory, consolidated purchasing agreements, supplier reduction and supplier quality certifications
  • Drives improvements in inventory accuracy/cycle count and inventory location accuracy
  • Advise on supplier managed inventory or supplier-based contracts with customers
  • Support internal or external audit requirements relative to the planning, procurement or inventory control functions
  • Effectively create and sustain procurement to delivery material and system cost reduction programs
  • Create aged inventory reports along with finance and create plans to reduce cost on inventory that is within the 3rd year of the current year, then oldest inventory first, through consumption and outright sales.
  • Actively support and implement lean principles at the division
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years applicable purchasing/materials management experience in a high-volume repair or manufacturing environment
  • Extensive managerial experience including supply chain management, and asset management
  • Four-year college degree in business, engineering, or materials management required or 5 years’ experience in scheduling and planning leading in a process diverse repair or manufacturing environment.
  • Possess analytical and technical skills required to understand business practices and recommend proper automation opportunities
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills for effective interface with all internal and external contacts
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft PC software (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, databases, and presentations)

SAFETY REQUIREMENTS

  • Will participate in and support safety initiatives, safe work practices and compliance.

title: Clinical Scheduler
description:
Clinical Scheduler

About City of Hope,
City of Hope's mission is to make hope a reality for all touched by cancer and diabetes. Founded in 1913, City of Hope has grown into one of the largest and most advanced cancer research and treatment organizations in the U.S., and one of the leading research centers for diabetes and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope research has been the basis for numerous breakthrough cancer medicines, as well as human synthetic insulin and monoclonal antibodies. With an independent, National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center that is ranked among the top in the nation for cancer care by U.S. News & World Report at its core, City of Hope’s uniquely integrated model spans cancer care, research and development, academics and training, and a broad philanthropy program that powers its work. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and cancer treatment centers and outpatient facilities in the Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix areas.


The successful candidate:

Hours: Monday - Friday 8:30am - 5:30pm


Job Responsibilities

The Clinical Scheduler position is responsible for maintaining schedules for the patients, providers, and departments. They must conduct face-to-face interviews, telephone interaction and electronic contact functions. Must coordinate all aspects of patient care and make informed decisions in meeting the patient’s own healthcare needs. The Scheduler must maintain accurate schedule and visit information to support patient satisfaction as well as accurate schedule and tracking functions while completing necessary documentation and pre-certifications of treatments and procedures.

High School Diploma or GED required

Bachelor’s degree preferred

3-5 years of professional experience in multifaceted online computer applications

3-5 years of professional experience in the medical field

title: Vice President, Equity Capital Markets

Summary:

Sitting between senior coverage officers and junior team members, this person manages client relationships, leads transaction workstreams, and mentor junior staff. Working closely with senior leaders and junior talent, the Vice President oversees the full transaction lifecycle, from pitch development and investor engagement through execution and closing. The role spans a broad range of offerings, including IPOs, follow-ons, ATMs, convertibles, and baby bonds. It demands strong technical expertise, market insight, and the ability to collaborate with product and industry teams to deliver integrated capital markets solutions.

Basic Requirements:

  • Series 7 & 63 required. Series 79 will be required within 6 months
  • One to three years of experience in investment banking, valuation, private equity, or related financial services
  • Strong understanding of financial statement analysis, valuation methodologies, and capital markets concepts.
  • Experience developing and maintaining complex financials models
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight deadlines

title: General Manager
description:
Monroe, LA

Writes store cleaning plan.

location: US, CA, San Jose, Rio Robles
description:
Come join Analog Devices (ADI) – a place where Innovation meets Impact. For more than 55 years, Analog Devices has been inventing new breakthrough technologies that transform lives. At ADI you will work alongside the brightest minds to collaborate on solving complex problems that matter from autonomous vehicles, drones and factories to augmented reality and remote healthcare.


ADI fosters a culture that focuses on employees through beneficial programs, aligned goals, continuous learning opportunities, and practices that create a more sustainable future.


About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Design Evaluation Engineer, Power Management ICs


Analog Devices is seeking an Entry-Level Design Evaluation Engineer to join our Power Management IC engineering team in San Jose, California starting Summer 2027. This hands-on laboratory role is designed for an engineer with a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline who wants to build expertise in post-silicon evaluation, validation, characterization, and test automation.

You will evaluate power-management integrated circuits such as step-down and step-up converters, low-dropout regulators, and related mixed-signal power products. Working with experienced engineers, you will plan and perform laboratory measurements, automate test equipment, analyze results, investigate unexpected behavior, and communicate clear technical conclusions.


This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with real hardware, learning how integrated circuits behave across operating conditions, and using experiments and data to solve engineering problems.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on laboratory evaluation and characterization of power-management ICs, including buck converters, boost converters, LDO regulators, and related mixed-signal functions.
  • Support first-silicon and evaluation-board bring-up under the guidance of experienced engineers.
  • Execute validation plans across input voltage, output voltage, load, switching frequency, operating mode, temperature, startup, shutdown, and fault conditions.
  • Measure parameters such as output accuracy, line and load regulation, efficiency, power loss, quiescent current, ripple, noise, transient response, switching behavior, current limit, and thermal performance.
  • Capture and analyze oscilloscope waveforms for startup, shutdown, mode transitions, load transients, switching nodes, protection events, and other dynamic behavior.
  • Develop Python/C# scripts to control laboratory instruments, automate parameter sweeps, collect data, create plots, and improve measurement repeatability.
  • Review test data for consistency, identify anomalies, and apply structured troubleshooting methods to isolate measurement, board, system, or silicon-related causes.
  • Compare bench measurements with design expectations, simulations, datasheet limits, and automated-test results as appropriate.
  • Assist with evaluation-board schematics, component selection, board bring-up, rework, fixture development, and review of power-layout and measurement considerations.
  • Collaborate with Design Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to resolve technical issues and support product introduction.
  • Continue developing expertise in power electronics, analog measurement, test automation, data analysis, and post-silicon validation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline, completed or expected before the employment start date.
  • Graduate-level foundation in analog circuits, electronics, and circuit analysis.
  • Academic understanding of power electronics or power-management circuits, including at least one of the following: linear regulators, buck converters, boost converters, feedback systems, or switched-mode power supplies.
  • Hands-on laboratory experience gained through university courses, research, thesis work, internships, teaching laboratories, student teams, or engineering projects.
  • Familiarity with oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, bench power supplies, and electronic loads.
  • Basic programming ability in Python or another technical programming language.
  • Ability to organize data, create plots, compare results, and communicate observations clearly.
  • Demonstrated curiosity, attention to detail, willingness to learn, and ability to collaborate respectfully with others.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

No prior semiconductor-industry employment is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework, research, or project experience in power electronics, analog integrated circuits, feedback and control, semiconductor devices, or mixed-signal systems.
  • Exposure to automated instrument control using Python, PyVISA, LabVIEW, C#, MATLAB, or similar technologies.
  • Experience measuring power-supply efficiency, ripple, noise, startup, load transients, or loop behavior.
  • Familiarity with schematic capture, PCB layout, SPICE simulation, or evaluation-board development.
  • Exposure to oscilloscopes with differential or current probes, SMUs, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, thermal equipment, or EMI measurement.
  • Familiarity with digital control interfaces such as SPI, I²C, or PMBus.
  • Experience documenting technical work through a thesis, laboratory report, publication, design review, or project presentation.

Why Join Our Team?

Join a team where graduate-level circuit knowledge becomes hands-on engineering experience. You will work directly with advanced power-management ICs, modern laboratory equipment, evaluation hardware, automation software, and real post-silicon data.


You will learn from engineers across Design, Applications, Product Engineering, Test Engineering, and Manufacturing while contributing to products used in industrial, communications, instrumentation, automotive, and other demanding applications. The role offers a path to build specialized expertise in power electronics, precision measurement, silicon debug, automated validation, and data-driven product decisions.


We value different perspectives, thoughtful experimentation, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous learning. Candidates do not need to meet every preferred qualification to apply.

location: US, CA, San Jose, Rio Robles
description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Principal Systems Architect

Data Center Platforms


The Opportunity

The rapid expansion of AI and cloud computing is transforming the data center.


Analog Devices is searching for a Principal Systems Architect to help define the next generation of embedded software and system architectures for data center infrastructure.


This is not simply a software implementation role. It is an opportunity to work at the intersection of silicon, embedded computing, software, power, sensing, communications, security, and large-scale infrastructure.


You will partner with analog, digital, firmware, software, systems, applications, and product teams to turn complex customer problems into scalable product architectures. You will influence products from their earliest architectural decisions through implementation and deployment.


We are looking for an engineer who is curious by nature, passionate about engineering across disciplines, and energized by problems that don't fit neatly within one technical domain.


You should expect to be challenged. You should expect to challenge others. And you should have the technical credibility and leadership skills to inspire teams to accomplish things that initially appear difficult.


What You’ll Do

Define System Architecture

  • Recognize unseen relationships between industry needs and ADI capabilities to seed innovative solutions.
  • Define system architectures spanning platforms, silicon, hardware, embedded compute, software, communications, sensing, control, and security.
  • Translate customer and system requirements into clear architectural requirements, partitioning, interfaces, and implementation choices.
  • Drive architectural decisions early in product development, when those decisions have the greatest impact on capability, schedule, cost, reuse, and differentiation.
  • Establish architectures that can scale across products and product generations without compromising the needs of individual applications.

Turn Architecture into Products

Architecture is valuable only when it produces results.

You will:

  • Convert ambiguous customer and system problems into concrete technical architectures.
  • Determine where functions should reside within the system, making deliberate tradeoffs among silicon, hardware, firmware, software, communications, and control.
  • Identify technical risks and critical dependencies early and use analysis, modeling, experimentation, and prototypes to resolve them.
  • Apply sound business judgment to architectural decisions, balancing innovation and differentiation with schedule, cost, risk, and customer value.
  • Drive decisions to closure and take ownership for results.
  • Provide technical leadership across teams, challenge assumptions constructively, mentor engineers, and build alignment around critical architectural decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Broad Technical Capability

The successful candidate will bring significant engineering depth together with demonstrated capability across multiple technical disciplines.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Analog and mixed-signal systems
  • Power conversion, power management, and control
  • Digital systems and hardware architecture
  • Microcontrollers, SoCs, and embedded compute
  • Embedded firmware and real-time systems
  • Software and system architecture
  • Communications protocols and system interfaces
  • Sensing, measurement, and telemetry
  • Control algorithms and signal processing
  • Reliability, diagnostics, and fault management
  • Embedded and system security

A successful Systems Architect must be able to move comfortably among disciplines, understand their languages and constraints, recognize where decisions in one domain affect another, and engage specialists deeply enough to reach sound system-level conclusions.


Why This Role Matters

Data-center infrastructure is entering a period of significant architectural change.


As a Principal Systems Architect, you will work where multiple technologies converge, help make architectural decisions that shape future products, and work alongside engineers across disciplines to turn those decisions into real systems.


If you are passionate about complex systems, willing to venture outside the boundaries of your own expertise, and motivated by turning difficult customer problems into successful solutions, we want to hear from you.

title: Grant Manager (47565)
description:
THE POSITION:

EverHope is seeking an experienced and motivated Grants Manager to lead and grow the organization’s grants program. This position plays a critical role in identifying, securing, and stewarding funding from foundations, corporations, and government agencies to advance EverHope’s mission and long-term sustainability.

Working closely with the Chief Development Officer (CDO), the Grants Manager oversees the full grant lifecycle, from prospect research and proposal development to reporting and funder stewardship. This position collaborates across departments to connect organizational priorities with funding opportunities and supports the broader Development team through prospect research, proposal development, and donor database operations as needed.

The ideal candidate is a compelling writer, curious researcher, and strategic thinker who enjoys building relationships and turning organizational needs into funding opportunities. They are a collaborative team player who can manage multiple deadlines, adapt to changing priorities, and take ownership of projects from beginning to end.

Key Responsibilities (may include, but not limited to):

Grant Strategy & Management

  • Lead all aspects of EverHope’s grants program, including prospect research, funding strategy, proposal development, submission, reporting, compliance, and stewardship.
  • Identify and pursue new funding opportunities aligned with EverHope’s mission, organizational priorities, and fundraising goals.
  • Write compelling grant proposals, letters of inquiry, applications, reports, and supporting materials for foundation, corporate, and government funders.
  • Build and steward relationships with current and prospective funders through meaningful communication and engagement.
  • Collaborate with Programs, Finance, and organizational leadership to develop grant budgets, gather impact data, and communicate funding needs and outcomes.
  • Manage the annual grants calendar, maintain accurate records, and ensure deadlines and reporting requirements are met.
  • Track grant revenue, pipeline activity, and performance against annual funding goals.

Prospect Research &Development Support

  • Research prospective individual, corporate, and foundation donors to support development team priorities.
  • Assist the CDO and Gift Officers with donor briefings, customized proposals, funding requests, and case for support materials.
  • Collaborate with the Development team on donor stewardship, fundraising initiatives, and other departmental priorities as needed

Database & Donor Operations (Backup Support)

  • Provide backup support for gift entry, donor acknowledgments, and donor record maintenance.
  • Assist with generating donor reports, lists, and queries as needed.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of donor records when serving in this capacity.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes

  • Passion for EverHope’s mission and commitment to serving children and families impacted by trauma.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and research skills with the ability to develop compelling proposals, reports, and funding requests.
  • Strong knowledge of grant funding, research tools, and management practices,with the ability to identify opportunities and manage the full grant lifecycle.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to balance multiple deadlines and priorities.
  • Ability to translate organizational needs, program outcomes, and financial information into persuasive funding requests.
  • Strong relationship building and communication skills with the ability to engage funders and collaborate across departments.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently while contributing to team success.

title: Creative Brand Producer
description:
About WithCoverage:

WithCoverage replaces the traditional insurance brokerage with AI-supercharged risk management designed for the modern economy.

We partner with hundreds of high-growth, category-defining companies, including GoPuff, Eight Sleep, Bombas, Chomps, and Blank Street Coffee. Our clients span iconic consumer brands, hospitality leaders, GCs, advanced manufacturers, and next-generation defense contractors. They operate in complex risk environments and need a partner that can move at their speed.

Instead of a fragmented, manual brokerage stack, we have built a new category: elite risk advisors operating on top of proprietary technology. Our in-house Agency Management System gives our team and AI agents full visibility into policies, exposures, claims, billing, and commissions. This platform enables deep automation, better decisions, and a fundamentally higher standard of service.

WithCoverage was founded by JD Ross (co-founder of Opendoor) and Max Brenner (Bain, Compound).

We have raised over $43M from leading investors including Sequoia, 8VC, Khosla Ventures and Crystal Venture Partners.

Our ambition is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how risk is managed across the economy.

Why Join Us

  • Grow Faster – We're scaling quickly, giving you real opportunities to lead, shape strategy, and accelerate your career.
  • Work That Matters – We protect the world's most innovative brands: consumer icons, hospitality leaders, next-gen defense contractors, and US manufacturers.
  • Redefine an Industry – Insurance is one of the largest, slowest-moving markets. We rewrite the playbook with proprietary technology, automation, and AI.
  • Financial Rewards – We hire the best and invest in you. Competitive comp, meaningful equity, and excellent benefits. We believe strongly in internal promotion and lay out a plan for everyone's career growth.

Location: In-office, NYC HQ.

About The Role
We’re looking for an AI-native creative producer and storyteller to help build WithCoverage’s multimedia content engine.

You’ll have the fundamentals of a digital producer and the instincts of a creator. You know how to light an interview, record clean sound, and shape a story people watch to the end. Then you find the moments worth clipping and turn them into short edits, graphics, and social content that land with audiences on every platform.

Working closely with the Head of Content & Brand, you’ll produce customer story videos, founder content, premium series, drive paid campaigns and ads, product launch animations, event coverage, and formats we haven’t thought of yet. You’ll be hands-on at every stage, from pre-production through shoot, edit, and delivery, using AI to make more, faster, without lowering the bar.

You might come from a production company, a creative agency, branded content studio, creator team, newsroom, or an in-house brand team. Maybe you’ve built and monetized your own channels successfully. What matters is that you have excellent production craft, digital savvy, curiosity about new tools, and the drive to grow quickly in a role with real ownership.

What You'll Do

  • Shoot and edit our customer stories. Run camera, lighting, and audio on client shoots, then edit films built around what broke in the client's previous setup, what WithCoverage found or delivered, and what changed.
  • Get more out of every shoot. Quickly turn each production into hero cuts, vertical social clips, and assets optimized for distribution across organic and paid channels.
  • Make it native to every feed. Package each piece for how people actually watch on LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and X, with the hooks, pacing, captions, thumbnails, and formats each platform rewards.
  • Produce creative for growth and paid media. Partner with our Growth team and agencies to make campaign and ad creative, from concepts and scripts to finished spots and variations. Then test hooks, formats, and messaging, and iterate on what performs.
  • Bring our founders and experts to the screen. Capture and edit founder videos, expert explainers, and premium podcast and video series.
  • Push what’s possible with AI. Use generative video, image, and audio tools for b-roll, motion graphics, voice, and new formats, and share what works with the team.
  • Keep production running smoothly. Manage shoot logistics, release forms, file organization, and our asset library so every project is easy to find and reuse.

Who You Are

  • 3-5 years of hands-on production experience, with a reel showing shooting, editing, and storytelling.
  • Strong production fundamentals: camera, lighting, on-set audio, and editing in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.
  • AI-native in how you work: comfortable with tools like Descript, Runway, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Midjourney, or the generative features in Adobe.
  • You understand where AI helps and where craft and judgment matter more.
  • Comfortable directing non-actors and helping people who aren't used to being on camera feel at ease.
  • Experience producing paid media creative, including campaign assets and ads for paid social, and working with growth teams and agencies to iterate based on performance data.
  • Organized, fast, and resourceful; you can juggle several projects and figure things out without waiting for direction.
  • A strong communicator who takes feedback well and wants to grow quickly.

For candidates based in the United States, the expected pay range for this position at the start of employment is $110,000 – $130,000 a year. Actual compensation will vary based on individual factors, including market location, relevant experience, and role scope. WithCoverage's Total Rewards package for full-time employees also includes equity participation and comprehensive benefits. If you're excited about the role but your compensation expectations are outside this range, we'd still love to hear from you; final offers reflect experience, scope, and leveling.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation that includes equity
  • Comprehensive benefit plans for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
  • Pre-tax accounts (FSA, HSAs, dependent care FSAs, commuter savings)
  • Human Interest: 401(k) provider
  • Time Off: Flexible time off, sick leave, family and medical leave, and major national holidays
  • A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
  • Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture

title: VP Product Management (Hybrid - Newark, NJ or NYC)
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Broadridge is hiring! We are seeking a VP of Product Management to lead the strategy, commercialization, and scaled delivery of Standing Voting Instructions (SVI) for public-company issuers. This leader will take a high-profile, early-stage product from successful client launches to a repeatable, market-leading issuer platform.


The role owns the issuer SVI product vision and roadmap across enrollment, preference management, ProxyVote experiences, persistent digital access, shareholder targeting, employee programs, reporting, and future integrations with broker platforms. The VP will work closely with Issuer Services, Regulatory Communications, Engineering, Legal, Operations, Sales, and senior client leaders to create a solution that is simple for shareholders, scalable for clients, and durable in a highly regulated market.


The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial product leader who can balance strategic vision with disciplined execution, communicate credibly with C-suite clients, and turn complex regulatory and operational requirements into products that clients will adopt.Standing Voting Instructions enable shareholders to establish a preference for how their shares should be voted on eligible proxy matters, while preserving their ability to vote directly on any individual meeting. SVI represents an important opportunity for issuers to increase shareholder participation and for Broadridge to build a differentiated, scalable voting and engagement platform.


As VP of Product Management, SVI — Issuers, you will define where the product goes next and ensure it gets there. You will lead the transition from bespoke launches and client-specific solutions to a repeatable product model that can be deployed across issuer segments and shareholder populations.

This is a highly visible leadership role with direct exposure to senior executives, major clients, and critical industry partners.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and commercial proposition for SVI for issuers.
  • Define the product vision for scalable shareholder enrollment, instruction management, annual reminders, opt-out and update experiences, and issuer reporting.
  • Lead the evolution of SVI across key capabilities
  • Translate client needs, market signals, regulatory developments, and operational constraints into clear product requirements and prioritized roadmaps.
  • Build a repeatable product model that reduces dependency on one-off development while preserving the flexibility required for strategic clients.
  • Partner with Engineering, UX, Architecture, Operations, and Quality Assurance to drive high-quality delivery, launch readiness, and continuous improvement.

title: Journeyman Tree Trimmer - Travel Crew
description:
Job Title: Advanced Tree Trimmer

Pay Rate Type: Non-Exempt

Creation Date/Revision Date: 04/24/2026

Job Summary:

The Advanced Tree Trimmer role is a qualified Line Clearance Tree Trimmer responsible for pruning and removing trees, limbs and shrubs away from power lines to reduce vegetation interference. This role utilizes various types of equipment, tools, and techniques to perform advanced tree care while addressing growth patterns and ensuring tree health, and appearance.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Loads vehicles and equipment with manageable size limbs and logs not suited for wood chipping.

  • Trims, removes and/or fells trees using climbing equipment, such as a powered trimmer lift truck, safety belt, climbing line, and ladder. Also works on the ground using hand saws, ground saws, pruners or other applicable tools.

  • Works aloft to cut branches or trunk sections and drop or lower them to the ground with rigging lines.

  • Uses appropriate tools on the ground to fell trees or spars and split them into manageable pieces.

  • Works around hazardous equipment and may work in close proximity to energized power lines while providing direct supervision of the activities of non-qualified employees working in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Applies herbicide with growth regulators to brush and stumps. Maintains appropriate application records.

  • Adheres to and helps educate less experienced employees on company policies, procedures, on-the-job safety practices, approved work methods and OSHA regulations.

  • Repairs minor damage to property that occur on the job site. Escalates situations to General Foreperson’s when necessary and in a timely manner.

  • Feeds brush and debris into woodchipper.

  • Sets up warning signs, barriers, flags, relays hand-signals, directs traffic and other applicable traffic control devices to protect employees and members of the public from hazards in and around the work area. Cooperates with property owner, customer, and emergency personnel when blocking streets or driveways.

  • Conducts vehicle and equipment inspections to ensure proper working conditions. Conducts routine maintenance on company vehicles, equipment and tools. Reports specialized vehicle maintenance or equipment needs to General Foreperson.

  • During emergencies or natural disasters may be required to be on duty for the duration of the disaster.

  • Support, actively participate, and act in accordance with Wright’s culture of safety and employee ownership.

  • Comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations; maintain knowledge of and follow all company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance at work and meetings.

Other Duties:

  • Drives and operates vehicles and equipment as assigned.

  • May assist with obtaining written permission from property owners. Helps promote and maintain good customer and public relations as well as with employees.

Supervisory Duties:

Knowledge, Skills & Ability Requirements:

  • Knowledge of trees, including identification, growth habits and arboricultural techniques specific to trimming, pruning, repairing, maintaining and removing, in close proximity to energized conductors.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills focused on rapport-building, listening, questioning and patience. Ability to communicate effectively with the general public, customers and employees.

  • Knowledge and understanding of the American National Standards for Tree Care Operations (ANSI Z133.1-current version) and American National Standards for Proper Pruning (ANSI A300).

  • Ability to adhere and coach employees on company and industry safety requirements.

  • Knowledge of electrical circuits and skilled in reading and understanding of circuit maps.

  • Knowledge of OSHA electric power generation, transmission, and distribution standards, including 29 CFR 1910.269. Ability to determine nominal voltage, proper use of insulated tools near energized parts and distinguish exposed live parts from other parts of electric equipment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and to follow instructions accurately.

  • Must be able to communicate with others and represent Wright Tree Service in a professional manner.

  • Must be able to comprehend and/or read and write both written and verbal job instructions and safety information.

  • Ability to recognize poisonous plants and take proper safeguard against them.

  • Must be able to wear necessary personal protective equipment (PPE) as required.

  • Ability to work long hours and overtime during emergencies (including holidays, weekends, storm work) and will be subject to call-out work.

  • Demonstrate knowledge and trained to perform tree and bucket rescue.

  • Ability to operate and service all required tools and equipment.

  • Ability to work both independently and in a group.

Education, Certification & Experience Requirements:

  • Has a minimum of 1 year of experience working on tree trimming or clearing crews or has successfully completed applicable skills assessments.

  • High School diploma or equivalent preferred, but not required.

  • Must have valid First-Aid and CPR cards or ability to obtain within 90 days of hire.

Other Preferred Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a valid driver’s or commercial driver’s license (dependent upon Division and utility/contract requirements) and DOT medical card in accordance with FMCSA regulations.

  • Drive a vehicle with an attached chipper or other trailing unit to, from or within the work area.

  • Maintain herbicide application certification or equivalent as required by Wright Tree Service and local, state, and federal law.

  • Keeps informed of new equipment and specifications, standards, practices, and operating procedures.

Language Requirements (read, write, speak):

English - ☒ Read, ☒ Write, ☒ Speak

Spanish - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Other Language _________________ - ☐ Read, ☐ Write, ☐ Speak

Travel Requirements:

☐No-Seldom

☐Yes-Occasional (up to 5%)

☐Yes-Moderate (5% to 25%)

☐Yes-Substantial (25% to 50%)

☒Yes-Extensive (greater than 50%)

Physical Characteristics:

This position may require physical demands and activities including:

  • Effective bending, reaching, standing, walking, climbing, lifting, carrying, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. Occasionally reach upward and downward.

  • Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 50 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

  • Possesses the ability to lift, move, and maneuver up to 50 pounds on an infrequent basis and up to 30 pounds on a frequent basis.

  • Must be able to have visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of work assigned or make general observations of the community; close visual acuity, such as reading a computer screen, reading printed material, inspection of small defects, and using measurement devices.

  • Ability to enter and exit vehicles and equipment numerous times per day.

Environmental Factors:

This position may be exposed to the following factors:

  • Routine exposure to indoor and outdoor working conditions.

  • Routine exposure to weather, climate and temperature, such as rain, heat, sun, cold, snow.

  • Routine exposure to nature, such as irritating plants, biting or stinging insects, dust, etc; position works outdoor on rugged terrain.

  • Routine exposure to noise, vibration, working hazards such as proximity to moving parts, mechanical equipment, moving vehicles, gasoline powered equipment, electrical current, heights, exposure to heat, exposure to chemicals, work in close quarters, narrow aisles or passageways, communicable diseases, bloodborne pathogens, cleaning chemicals, dust, odors, and a variety of pests.
