  • Company-paid holidays
  • Choice holidays

Financial Well-Being

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Tuition assistance
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan discount

What we’re looking for

Education:

High School diploma or GED is required; Associate degree or BA/BS Degree in science preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum 1-2 years’ experience in a laboratory setting highly desired. Undergraduate lab work will be considered
  • Microsoft Office experience required with proficiency in Word and Excel.
  • Must be flexible, forward- thinking, motivated, and can act independently.
  • High level of customer service skills with a professional, can-do demeanor.
  • Requires laboratory knowledge including using various instruments to prepare for and perform tests.
  • Able to lift 25 lbs.
  • Effective communication, both verbal and written, with customer and internal stakeholders required.
  • Ability to follow site protocols, policies, and procedures to stay safe, prioritize tasks, solve problems, ensure quality, and meet goals.
  • Conform to all customer requirements for background checks, health and safety issues, and security clearances required.

How you will thrive and create an impact

Avantor’s Advanced Laboratory Services team is a crucial part of the Avantor Services group serving over 500 customers in biopharma, pharmaceutical, educational, industrial, and high-tech industries with customizable, flexible solutions and end-to-end laboratory operations support.

The Lab Resource Coordinator (LRC) is a key member of the laboratory operations team, providing essential support to scientific research groups. This role serves as a critical liaison between scientists and laboratory operations, ensuring smooth and efficient lab operations while maintaining a safe and productive work environment. The vivarium LRC directly supports the operations of the Animal Sciences and Technologies team, as well as the various In Vivo science groups that utilize this area.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operational Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for scientific groups, addressing their day-to-day lab operational needs and inquiries.
  • Lab Operations Compliance: Ensure adherence to all lab operations protocols and initiatives by science groups.
  • Inventory Management:
    • Maintain accurate records and inventory of common lab supplies, group specific lab supplies and chemicals and consumables related to cage management.
    • Coordinate with Avantor services teams (consumables, glass wash, solvents, etc.) to meet lab needs.
    • Catalog and maintain certain common stock items to minimize storage needs.
  • PPE Management: Stock, organize and maintain all PPE locations, including in holding and procedure rooms.
  • Reference Document Upkeep: Ensure all Work Instructions and SOPs are updated to properly reflect current processes, guaranteeing compliance and safety.
  • Equipment Maintenance:
    • Coordinate with Lab Instrument Services (LIST) for equipment tagging, calibration, and maintenance.
    • Submit and track maintenance requests for lab equipment.
  • Facility Maintenance:
    • Assist with the upkeep of common lab areas (consumable racks, carboard removal, general upkeep of procedure and holding rooms, equipment rooms, etc.).
    • Submit work orders for lab issues and follow up on progress.
  • Gas and cylinder support:
    • Swaps out oxygen cylinders used for procedures
    • Fills dry ice bins
    • Swaps LN2 dewars
  • Communication:
    • Ensure vivarium staff (AST and In-Vivo groups) are kept aware of any changes to the floor or upcoming maintenance.
    • Attend department meetings and effectively communicate information between science groups, lab operations, and other relevant teams.
  • Space Optimization: Contribute to lab decluttering efforts and space utilization improvements.
  • General Lab Assistance: Help AST team effectively and efficiently move items through the misting tunnel and into the vivarium.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science.

The work we do changes people's lives for the better. It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.

title: Ambulatory Care Asst - MA
description:
Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position.

Perform various duties related to patient care and treatment as directed by attending providers in an outpatient clinic setting. Provide clerical and clinical support to medical staff in assigned unit.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. High school diploma or equivalent.

2. Graduate of a Medical Assistant Program OR graduate of the Med Ed Program OR one (1) year of clinical experience.

3. Obtain certification in Basic Life Support within 30 days of hire.

4. State criminal background check and Federal (if applicable), as required for regulated areas

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:

1. Registration or Certification as a medical assistant.

EXPERIENCE:

1. One (1) year experience as a Medical Assistant or patient care.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Provide support to medical staff to assure patients' needs are met and to assure efficient operation of outpatient unit.

2. Assist providers when possible in completing requisitions or forms for patient examination or testing. May assure availability of test results for patient visits. Assist patients and providers with medical office visits.

3. Administer prescribed medication under supervision of attending provider.

4. Perform qualitative and quantitative tests and examinations of specimens.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
About Us

Endor Labs is building the premium Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster.

Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40-year old C++ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures.

Endor Labs has been named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Agentic Development Security Tools, Q4 2026 Blog (Nov 2026)

Endor Labs + OpenAI Integration Blog (Nov 2026)

Take the next big leap in security innovation at Endor Labs!

How You'll Make an Impact

As Director of Engineering, you will play a critical role in shaping the foundation of our engineering organization. You’ll partner closely with product, security-research, and executive leadership to drive technical excellence, scale our teams, and deliver customer impact. This is a highly visible role where you’ll balance strategic leadership with tactical execution, ensuring we deliver high-quality products while building a healthy, collaborative, and high-performing engineering culture.

You’ll manage and mentor engineering managers, guide technical direction across infrastructure and platform areas, and bring strong execution discipline to help us scale effectively. If you thrive in fast-paced startup environments, love working on hard technical problems, and are passionate about building secure products that developers love, we’d love to talk.

  • Lead and grow engineering teams across UI, Platform, Infrastructure, and Services, with responsibility for both technical outcomes and team health.
  • Mentor and develop engineering managers and senior ICs, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Build organizational structures and processes that enable cohesion, velocity, and scale as we grow.
  • Partner with product, design, and security leaders to align engineering strategy with business priorities.
  • Drive execution on complex technical projects, ensuring timely delivery and high quality.
  • Maintain a data-driven approach to decision making, measuring and improving team performance.
  • Balance short-term tactical needs with long-term strategic investments in architecture, tooling, and scalability.
  • Champion DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure to increase reliability and developer velocity.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with stakeholders across the company, ensuring clear communication and alignment.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and ownership while keeping customer value and security at the core of decision making.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Bachelors or Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering management roles.
  • Prior experience scaling teams in a high-growth startup with deeply technical product; Series A–C experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing engineering teams in multi-geo, hybrid and distributed environments.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture, API design, and infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and modern infrastructure tooling
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with day-to-day execution.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align engineering with business needs.
  • Strong mentorship track record, including developing engineering managers and growing senior talent.
  • Experience delivering security products, developer tools, or working within the cybersecurity space is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with open-source ecosystems and community dynamics is a plus.

What Makes Us... Us

  • Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.
  • Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.
  • Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.
  • Strive to make the complex simple.
  • Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.
  • Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.
  • Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.
  • Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.

What Makes Us... Us

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans.
  • 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.
  • Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)
  • Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.
  • A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

title: AI Systems Engineer
description:
AI Systems Engineer

Who we are:

Nimble is a boutique technology consultancy based in the UK North; Sheffield, Leeds and

Manchester. We partner with ambitious clients across the public and private sectors to design,

build, and optimize digital services that deliver real value. We pride ourselves on our agile

mindset, our creative problem-solving, and our collaborative culture.

Our projects are diverse and different, just like our ways of working and our people. One of our

key focusses is maintaining a strong culture of pragmatic, skilled, egoless people who

collaborate to get things done and have lots of fun along the way.

The people we want

We want curious, tenacious problem solvers who create forward momentum. We value people

with a high learning capacity: people who get to the real problem, learn fast in unfamiliar

territory and turn ambiguity into a useful next step. We also want kind, low-ego colleagues who

are direct but constructive, generous with knowledge and good to work with. Brilliance is not a

licence for poor behaviour. People should strengthen the team, not make it harder to work in.

The role

The role sits within Nimble’s Frontier AI Business Unit. While you will be working with a remote

client, you must be based in either our Leeds or Manchester office.

As an AI Engineer, you will be trusted to deliver complete AI features or small services

independently, from integration through release and support. Your work will span the core

disciplines required to build secure, useful AI products:

• Product framing

• Data and retrieval

• Application & context engineering

• Evaluation

• Reliable operation

What you will do

• Build and integrate production AI services, select suitable models, and configure

parameters while understanding the trade-offs between static context length, latency,

and output costs.

• Build and test functional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that respect

source permissions, handling document parsing, retrieval filtering, citation generation,

and context caching.

• Implement agentic patterns—such as task routing and stateful tool execution—within

production services, ensuring safe execution through deterministic fallbacks and retry

limits.

• Set human approval points for higher-risk automated actions and implement

programmatic guardrails to mitigate prompt manipulation and sensitive data leakage.

• Implement automated, repeatable evaluation checks for feature accuracy, response

latency, and token cost to validate prompt and agent updates before deployment.

• Instrument AI applications with structured logging and tracing to capture latency, error

rates, and token spend per call.

• Help define, size, and break down delivery tickets, evaluating whether a proposed

feature delivers tangible user value relative to its cost, latency, and failure rate.

What good looks like after 90 days

• You are independently delivering robust, complete AI features, ensuring non-

deterministic failures degrade gracefully for the user.

• You have implemented automated evaluation checks and programmatic guardrails that

the squad relies on to deploy updates safely.

• You are collaborating effectively across disciplines, consistently documenting patterns

for the team, and explaining technical decisions and AI constraints clearly in reviews.

• You have established a strong working cadence with product, data, and security

colleagues to test systems before release and investigate any failures in use.

What you bring

Essential

• Has SC Clearance or eligibility for clearance.

• You are curious, low-ego, willing to challenge assumptions, and able to explain

technical decisions clearly to engineers and clients.

• Proven ability to build robust AI features including tool calling, streaming responses,

state management, and error handling.

• Hands-on experience with RAG pipelines, embedding models, and implementing

context caching to optimise latency and cost.

• Experience running automated, repeatable evaluation checks for feature accuracy and

basic safety/injection filtering.

• Ability to verify that cloud API integrations enforce zero-data-retention and non-training

agreements, securely managing API credentials.

Desirable

• Familiarity with standard protocols like MCP or OpenAPI schemas for building tool

connectors.

• Experience using an interactive coding workflow with AI assistants while rigorously

validating the generated logic.

• A pragmatic approach to product value, recognising where simple rule-based logic or

standard databases might solve a problem more reliably than generative models.

What we offer:

• Private healthcare for you and a family member through Westfield Health

• Flexible / Hybrid working

• Enhanced Parental pay

Award nights, Bowling, Bouldering and more!

description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.


We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world’s most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come.


As Manager, Government Affairs, you will be an integral part of a fast-paced, highly collaborative Federal Government Affairs (FGA) team, partnering with Government Affairs & Policy and cross-functional colleagues to devise, execute, and track strategic plans and substantive projects across the enterprise.


Reporting to the Vice President, Federal Government Affairs, you will play a central role in developing and implementing coordinated strategies, initiatives, and engagements around issues that impact Gilead/Kite and our patients. The ideal candidate is a motivated and detail-oriented self-starter who writes clearly and tracks work rigorously to completion.


Key Responsibilities:

· Partner with the Federal Government Affairs team and Government Affairs leadership to devise, execute and track operating plans, ensuring those plans are aligned to broader company priorities.

· Serve as project manager for substantive GA and enterprise projects of increasing complexity: define scope, develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, including timelines, milestones, owners, deliverables, and resource requirements, and drive projects to on-time, high-quality completion.

· Coordinate project activities across functions, ensuring alignment with overall project goals and objectives; run timely, efficient, and action-oriented project meetings and track decisions, action items, and deliverables.

· Build and maintain structured systems, documents, trackers, dashboards, and repeatable processes for GA priorities, legislative and regulatory developments, stakeholder engagements, and enterprise initiatives.

· Draft, edit, and quality-check high-quality written products, including strategic plans, briefing memos, presentations, position summaries, and leadership updates.

· Monitor federal legislation, regulations, programs, and executive branch actions impacting Gilead/Kite; over time, you will become adept at flagging implications for GA priorities.

· Develop and maintain a high-impact GA communications platforms to deliver timely updates informing internal stakeholders regarding key government actions impacting Gilead.

· Support preparation of materials for leadership and governance reviews, Congressional engagements, and trade association workgroups; staff workgroups as needed, reflect Gilead’s perspective in those discussions, and share outputs with the GA team and partners as appropriate.

· Coordinate with cross-functional internal partners, including Legal, Commercial, Research, Development and Public Affairs, to identify opportunities to advance Gilead’s legislative and regulatory priorities and to ensure an aligned policy perspective.

· Support GA operations, including the annual planning cycle, budget tracking, coordination of external consultants.

· Identify opportunities for process improvement and optimization, including via leveraging AI, and drive adoption of best practices across the team.

· Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, exercising sound judgment and discretion with confidential information.


Basic Qualifications:

  • 6+ Years with BS/BA
    OR
  • 4+ Years with MS/MA

Preferred Qualifications:

· Strong project management capabilities with a proven ability to prioritize and execute across multiple workstreams, and a track record of managing complex projects and meeting challenging deadlines.

· Excellent written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to synthesize complex policy and business material into clear and accurate products for senior audiences.

· A resourceful self-starter with problem-solving and critical thinking skills; self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership.

· Attention to detail, organized and thorough, with strong organizational and time management skills.

· Excellent collaboration, interpersonal, and communication skills, with demonstrated success working in fast-paced, dynamic environments and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

· Experience in health policy, in government, or with a trade association is a plus.

· Familiarity with the legislative and regulatory process, including drug coverage, reimbursement, and access policy, is a plus.


People Leader Accountabilities

•Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.

•Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.

•Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

Position Overview:

The Production Assistant Manager supports daily production operations to ensure safe, high-quality food while meeting daily and weekly production demands. This role works closely with the Production Manager to help coordinate production activities, support and guide production associates, and maintain strong standards for quality, sanitation, and safety.


The Production Assistant Manager plays a key role in keeping our production floor running smoothly. You’ll help coordinate people, processes, and product while leading by example in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.


What You'll Do:

  • Support the Production Manager with daily production coordination, including labor scheduling, opening and closing assigned production areas, managing par levels, overseeing inventory, and maintaining quality standards.
  • Ensure all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) are consistently followed.
  • Maintain documentation related to corrective actions and Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOPs).
  • Facilitate daily and bi-weekly production meetings focused on quality, sanitation, GMPs, and overall team performance.
  • Lead sanitation processes for assigned areas while maintaining a clean and safe work environment.
  • Ensure compliance with all City and FDA health code regulations and required documentation.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement and communicate them to the Production Manager.
  • Provide hands-on, in-the-moment coaching and training to production team members.

What We're Looking For:

  • Must be bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Previous experience in food production, manufacturing, or a similar fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work effectively and train on all production stations.
  • Positive, personable, and team-oriented mindset.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach and support others in the moment.
  • Ability to work well with others in a fast-paced production environment.

Schedule Requirements:

This position follows a rotating four-day workweek. Employees are scheduled to work four days per week, with shifts falling on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and/or Saturday, based on operational needs. This means you may work four of these five days in a given week. Wednesdays and Sundays are typically days off, but occasional scheduling on those days may be required to support business needs.


What You'll Get:

  • Competitive pay ranging from $18 - $23, depending on experience.
  • Paid time off, sick leave, and holiday pay.
  • Eligibility for health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
  • 50% gym membership discount with Defined Fitness or Sports & Wellness.
  • Opportunities for growth.

title: Seasonal Doughnut Maker
description:
Since its founding in 1937, Krispy Kreme’s focus has remained the same - making fresh doughnuts using our founder’s original recipe. The brand’s iconic Hot Light lets consumers know when doughnuts are being made in the shop so they can stop in and enjoy them hot, right off the line.


Our Doughnut Makers have one of the most critical roles within our shops! You are responsible for making our iconic doughnuts while ensuring a level of quality that meets Krispy Kreme standards and in turn, satisfying our customers. You will prepare the dough, the yeast brew, the glaze, and the fillings. Don’t worry, we will make sure you know how to do all of that to become a key member of our team.


During peak seasons, we rely on a flexible, seasonal staffing model to ensure our A-Glazing customers receive friendly, efficient service and a well-maintained store appearance. Join us for a fun and rewarding seasonal experience.


A TASTE OF WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Prepare all ingredients necessary for doughnut production - brew, dough, glaze, fillings, and icings.
  • Accurately weigh ingredients, measure liquids, mixing, and frying doughnuts
  • Record keeping (times and temperatures) of all products prepared to ensure freshness and reduce waste.
  • Maintain sanitation standards within production area to ensure proper cleanliness and smooth operation of equipment.

YOUR RECIPE FOR SUCCESS:

  • Two (2) years of experience in a job involving food handling and safety.
  • Must be 18 years of age or over.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Open availability and flexibility is a must – ability to work any shift
  • Ability to understand weights and measurements.
  • Has a steadfast commitment to nurture an equitable, unbiased culture where our peeps are empowered to showcase their originality.
  • Present self in a professional manner, including adhering to uniform standards.
  • Must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature of work performed by the employees assigned to this job and are not the official job description for the position.


BENEFITS:

•Weekly Pay

•Career opportunities- we are growing!


WHY KRISPY KREME?

At Krispy Kreme, we focus on:

Loving People:

  • Our global culture is best captured by our Leadership Mix, a dozen behaviors that define how we work with one another across the world and give back to our communities. Check out our leadership mix here.
  • Belonging happens once each Krispy Kremer knows their bold authentic self is welcomed, dignified, and loved, where their wonderfully original identities flourish and thrive.

Loving Communities:

  • At Krispy Kreme, sharing joy is at the center of everything we do, and we strive to inspire this in our communities. Our brand purpose truly shines through our Acts of Joy and community fundraising initiatives.
  • In the U.S., we have been donating unsold doughnuts to local food banks, with a goal of bringing a smile to our consumers as they enjoy a small, sweet treat. We partner with Feeding America and Convoy of Hope, who in turn partner with organizations nationwide to distribute donations to people in need through diverse types of programs and services.
  • In 2022, we helped community groups raise $40 million globally. Last year in the U.S., we supported more than 83,000 fundraising events, raising nearly $37 million.

Loving Planet:

  • We have been conducting a multi-year global GHG emissions assessment to establish an emissions baseline, using this foundation to soon set goals for greenhouse gas emission reductions.
  • We are working on reducing food waste through donation efforts, animal feed, and composting programs.


Krispy Kreme is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

At Krispy Kreme, we believe that your originality sweetens our recipe. We value the diverse ingredients of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, gender, intersex, or veteran status of every individual. We strive for an inclusive culture that allows each of our peeps to bring their bold authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.


About Krispy Kreme

Headquartered in Charlotte, N.C., Krispy Kreme is one of the most beloved and well-known sweet treat brands in the world. Our iconic Original Glazed® doughnut is universally recognized for its hot-off-the-line, melt-in-your-mouth experience. Krispy Kreme operates in more than 35 countries through its unique network of fresh doughnut shops, partnerships with leading retailers, and a rapidly growing Ecommerce and delivery business with more than 14,000 fresh points of access. Our purpose of touching and enhancing lives through the joy that is Krispy Kreme guides how we operate every day and is reflected in the love we have for our people, our communities and the planet. Summary
The sterile process technician is responsible for daily operations to support the operating rooms and various other units as needed. Responsible for ensuring surgical supplies, instruments, scopes and equipment are properly inventoried, decontaminated, assembled, inspected, packaged, sterilized, stored, distributed and tracked in a safe, quality and timely manner. Examine and test instruments meticulously to ensure proper integrity, function and cleanliness prior to being sterilized or High Level disinfected.

  • Infection Control Utilizes knowledge of patient safety and error prevention to impede the spread of infection and disease.
  • Accuracy and Attention to Detail Understanding of the necessity and value of accuracy and attention to detail, ability to process information with high levels of accuracy.

  • Operating Room Management Knowledge of and ability to apply appropriate policies, procedures and management methods to maximize operating room efficiency and productivity.
  • CSPDT - Certified Sterile Processing and Distribution Technicians - Certification Board for Sterile Processing and Distribution or
  • CRCST - Certified and Registered Central Service Technicians - Healthcare Sterile Processing Association

Additional Qualifications
  • Ability to read and communicate in the English language.

Physical Demands
Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

Job Title:

Simulated Participant - PRN - Jackson/Oxford

Job Summary:

A "Simulated Participant" (SP) is a person who has been carefully trained to portray all of the characteristics of a real patient, family member, or clinical team member in order to provide an opportunity for a student or provider to learn, or be evaluated, on clinical skills first hand. SPs portray cases, which are based on actual encounters by healthcare providers. Simulated Participants are utilized in the training and evaluation of health care professionals and are trained to simulate the signs and symptoms of the actual patient. SP’s are often physically examined by learners as part of the learning environment. SPs are carefully trained to provide feedback to the learners, especially with regard to communication and interpersonal skills. Simulated Participants are interviewed and examined by health care learners and may be audio or videotaped during simulation.

Education & Experience

High school diploma/GED preferred; must be at least 16 years of age. Work or life experience may include but is not limited to theater, public speaking, medicine, teaching, social work, counseling, sales, public relations, public or community service, or past experience as a standardized patient or simulated participant.

Certifications, Licenses or Registration Required: N/A

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Must have good verbal communication skills. Must be proficient in the English language. Must be able to read and memorize scripts and checklists. Must be able to comprehend and carry out instructions. Must be competent in basic computer skills. Must be able to lift light equipment and supplies. Requires the ability to handle discretionary and confidential information.

Responsibilities

  • Report for learner exam sessions and training sessions as scheduled.
  • Work in a professional manner when interacting with learners, faculty, simulation specialists, supervisors and peers.
  • Be comfortable having repeated physical examination maneuvers performed on self with exception of breast, rectal, pelvic, and genital examinations.
  • Be willing to wear a hospital gown with only undergarments underneath, while on camera and/or observed live through an observation window or video monitor.
  • Simulate all aspects of scenarios, including history of current problem, affect/behavior and physical findings, in a standardized, accurate, and reliable manner.
  • Accurately and consistently complete learner checklists and deliver constructive feedback on communication skills, data gathering skills, and physical exam skills according to the checklists provided.
  • Accept and implement ongoing feedback from SP Coordinator and incorporate into case simulation.
  • Prepare exam room daily by cleaning, restocking, and placing items back in their place as needed.
  • Responding to Clinical Skills staff in a time manner (within 48 hours of contact).
  • The duties listed are general in nature and are examples of the duties and responsibilities performed and are not meant to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Physical and Environmental Demands
Requires occasional travel to offsite locations, occasional bending, occasional carrying/lifting up to 10 pounds, constant sitting, and occasional walking. (occasional-up to 20%, frequent-from 21% to 50%, constant-51% or more)

description:
Discover your potential. Build your legacy.
Go the distance with Capital Group

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.


The Role

As a Capital Group Global Technology Summer Associate, you’ll gain hands-on experience working alongside technology professionals who design, build, secure, and evolve the platforms and solutions that power Capital Group. You’ll contribute meaningful work on a specific Global Technology team while strengthening your technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills through coaching, mentorship, and collaboration. Your work will help connect technology solutions to the needs of investment professionals, associates, and clients around the world, while building skills for the long term.


The Team

You’ll spend the program on a specific Global Technology team, working alongside engineering, product, data, security, and business partners. Depending on your placement, you may contribute to software engineering and application development; data engineering, analytics and AI; cloud and infrastructure; digital products and user experience; technology strategy and solutions; or other Global Technology functions. Across these areas, teams apply technology to real business challenges and build secure, scalable solutions for Capital Group.


Your Impact

  • Design, develop, test, or enhance applications, services, data solutions, or technology capabilities that address real business needs.
  • Analyze data and technical requirements to identify insights, opportunities, and practical solutions.
  • Contribute to cloud, infrastructure, digital product, automation, AI, or platform work based on your team placement.
  • Troubleshoot technical challenges and help improve the reliability, usability, or scalability of technology solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, data, security, and business partners to connect technical work with user and business outcomes.
  • Apply feedback, coaching, and new learning to strengthen your technical skills and deliver high-quality work.
  • Participate in mentorship, networking, professional development, and learning opportunities throughout the program.

What You’ll Bring

  • Currently pursuing a technical bachelor’s degree with an anticipated graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028.
  • Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0, 3.75/5.0, or equivalent.

  • Foundational technical experience gained through coursework, projects, internships, research, hackathons, or extracurricular activities.
  • Familiarity with programming, software development, data, cloud, or related technical concepts, including foundational programming experience with Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, SQL, R, or similar languages.

What you’ll get
When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. title: Enterprise Sr. Systems Analysts
description:
About Baptist Health
Recognized as a top place to work in health care, Baptist Health cares for more patients in Northeast Florida than any other provider, ranking as “most preferred” for more than 30 years. We’re Jacksonville's only locally governed, faith-based, not-for-profit health system and provide a full spectrum of preventive and specialty care through 200+ locations and six hospitals. Our centers of excellence include Baptist MD Anderson Cancer Center, Baptist Heart Hospital, Baptist Neurological Institute and Wolfson Children's Hospital.

Enterprise Sr. Systems Analysts serve as technical leaders responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting highly complex enterprise-wide Workday and UKG solutions that enable Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and operational teams across Baptist Health. This role requires extensive knowledge of Human Capital Management (HCM), Workforce Management (WFM), enterprise systems architecture, integrations, security, and technical infrastructure. Analysts act as a strategic bridge between business operations and Information Systems, translating complex business requirements into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen system performance, and support organizational initiatives A significant portion of an analyst's day is devoted to leading technical projects, troubleshooting complex application and system issues, supporting enterprise integrations, and maintaining highly available business-critical systems. Responsibilities include resolving multifaceted issues involving application configuration, integrations, interfaces, databases, security, middleware, and system performance while supporting Workday and UKG releases, enhancements, and optimization efforts. Analysts collaborate with vendors, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity, database administrators, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure enterprise applications remain secure, reliable, and aligned with organizational objectives. Much of this work is coordinated through Microsoft Teams, email, project meetings, technical design sessions, and cross-functional governance activities.


Enterprise Sr. Systems Analysts also spend time leading enterprise initiatives alongside Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, Information Systems, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and vendor partners. Their week may include project planning sessions, architecture reviews, implementation meetings, production support, change management activities, and executive stakeholder discussions. Throughout the day, they mentor junior analysts, provide technical leadership across multiple projects, establish best practices, perform quality assurance and integrated testing, and coordinate cross-functional initiatives that support the organization's enterprise technology strategy.

Enterprise Sr. Systems Analyst Responsibilities:

  • Lead highly complex enterprise-wide application initiatives, serving as both technical lead and project leader while mentoring application analysts and promoting technical and operational best practices.
  • Provide technical expertise in the architecture, development, implementation, configuration, optimization, and support of Workday, UKG, and other enterprise business applications.
  • Design, support, and troubleshoot complex application configurations, integrations, interfaces, security models, databases, middleware, and enterprise system connectivity.
  • Analyze and translate Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Timekeeping, Talent Management, Compensation, Recruiting, Workforce Management, and enterprise business requirements into scalable technology solutions.
  • Plan, design, develop, validate, test, implement, evaluate, maintain, and support enterprise information system components and integrated technologies.
  • Lead enterprise application upgrades, releases, technical implementations, optimization initiatives, and large-scale cross-functional projects.
  • Perform quality assurance, integrated testing, change management, and release validation to ensure application reliability, performance, and system integrity.
  • Develop technical documentation, system architecture diagrams, workflow documentation, implementation plans, and support documentation.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Database Administration, Integration teams, vendors, and operational leaders to support enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot multifaceted issues involving software, hardware, interfaces, integrations, databases, security, and enterprise applications.
  • Participate in enterprise-wide project teams while simultaneously managing multiple initiatives and priorities.
  • Provide 24/7 operational support for assigned enterprise applications and systems as part of an on-call rotation.

Experience:

  • 2+ years of project leadership or project management experience required.
  • Minimum of 4 years supporting Workday, UKG, or other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) or Workforce Management (WFM) platforms required.
  • Experience implementing, configuring, optimizing, and supporting enterprise Workday and/or UKG applications preferred.
  • Strong understanding of Human Resources, Payroll, Benefits, Timekeeping, Talent Management, Compensation, Recruiting, Workforce Management, and enterprise business operations preferred.
  • Experience supporting enterprise integrations, APIs, middleware, security, reporting, data conversions, and system architecture preferred.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex issues across software, hardware, databases, interfaces, integrations, and enterprise security.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional technical projects and mentor junior analysts.
  • Strong experience using Microsoft Visio for workflow documentation, architecture diagrams, and implementation planning preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, technical, communication, customer service, and problem-solving skills required.

Education/Degree Required:

Bachelor's Degree

Certifications:

  • Workday and/or UKG Certification required within six months of hire, if not already certified.
  • Current Workday or UKG certifications in HCM, Payroll, Benefits, Time Tracking, Absence, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, Integrations, Security, or related modules preferred.
  • Experience supporting other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms or Workforce Management (WFM) solutions preferred.

title: Long-Term Escrow Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

The Long-Term Escrow Coordinator is a critical operational hub, providing specialized support across our escrow accounting, legal, and closing departments. In this detail-intensive role, you will take ownership of long-term escrow files—reviewing complex agreements, reconciling bank statements, processing builder draws, and ensuring strict compliance at every step.

You will act as a central liaison for internal teams, clients, and banking partners to manage the full lifecycle of these accounts, from initial deposit to final closeout. If you possess a highly analytical mindset, particularly with a background in reviewing contracts or paralegal work, and excel at managing intricate financial processes while delivering exceptional customer service, this role offers a highly rewarding opportunity to safeguard and streamline our operations.

Why Join Land Title?

At Land Title, we believe our most precious resource is our people. We take a holistic approach to caring for our team, ensuring you have the support you need to thrive. Here is what you can look forward to when you join us:

  • Incredible Culture – Step into an environment where everything we do is deeply grounded in our core values of Excellence, Efficacy, Responsibility, Altruism, and Honesty.
  • Meaningful Work – Elevate your daily impact by surrounding yourself with passionate professionals. You will collaborate with industry experts who know Colorado real estate laws, customs, and markets inside and out.
  • Professional Growth – We are committed to your future. We actively invest in your training and development, providing a variety of avenues for you to continuously grow and expand your professional skills.
  • Personal Wellness – We encourage you to live your best life. We champion true work-life balance and provide robust support and resources through our Employee Assistance Program to ensure your overall well-being.
  • Opportunities to Serve – Be part of a company that gives back. Our leadership starts at the top—our executive team regularly donates their time to professional and civic organizations that promote and support the communities in which we live and work.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will support the strategic direction of the organization by managing long-term escrow accounts and facilitating accurate disbursements. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Contract Review & Compliance: Review long-term escrow agreements, contracts, and related documents to verify completeness, ensure compliance, and determine accurate disbursement instructions. You will collaborate regularly with the legal, closing, and accounting departments regarding escrow compliance.
  • Financial Operations & Disbursements: Process builder draws, review deposits into LTE files, and transfer funds from long-term escrows to closing files. You will execute disbursements via check or wire and perform verbal verifications for all wiring instructions.
  • Banking & Reconciliation: Reconcile bank statements by verifying balances and inputting monthly interest to ensure our files are perfectly in balance with the bank. You will prepare requests to withdraw or close out funds from investment banks and credit closing files accordingly.
  • Account Administration: Monitor and process monthly scheduled deposits and disbursements. You will also prepare letter of credit reductions, cancellation letters, FedEx mailings, and process recurring monthly and account activity reports for clients.
  • Communication & Support: Manage communications from individual and shared disbursing email accounts, maintaining daily contact with clients and closers to follow up on pending documents or approvals. You will also model the Land Title culture, provide department backup (including phone coverage and file updates), and act as a mentor to the team.

What You Bring

To be successful in this role, you will bring a mix of analytical rigor, process management, and clear communication. We are looking for candidates who possess:

  • Analytical Contract Review: A strong aptitude for reading, interpreting, and reviewing complex contracts and legal documents to determine exact requirements and next steps.
  • Process Management: A talent for figuring out the best workflows to get things done. You know how to organize activities, simplify complex processes, and maximize efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Priority Setting: The ability to quickly zero in on critical tasks, put trivial matters aside, eliminate roadblocks, and create focus for yourself and your team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer Focus: A dedication to meeting the expectations of internal and external customers. You actively use firsthand information to improve services, establish effective relationships, and gain the trust and respect of your clients and peers.

Your Education & Experience

We believe there are specific educational backgrounds and professional experiences necessary to be successful in this position.

Necessary:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Solid working knowledge of email platforms, the Microsoft Office Suite, and Google systems.

Preferred:

  • A strong background in reviewing contracts (previous paralegal, legal assistant, or similar experience is highly desired).
  • Previous professional experience in the title or escrow industry.
  • Previous experience working with and interpreting legal descriptions.

Why You’ll Love It Here

We don't just offer jobs; we offer stable, rewarding careers. To support you both inside and outside the office, Land Title provides:

  • Competitive Pay: We offer a base salary from $55,000 to $65,000 per year, based on knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.
  • Total Wellness: Enjoy top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus the ultimate convenience of 24/7 Teledoc services.
  • Long-Term Security: Build your wealth with Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement options—complete with a company match. We also provide life insurance and both short-term and long-term disability for your peace of mind.
  • Time to Recharge: Rest and recharge with a generous time-off package that includes vacation and sick time, and 10 paid holidays.
  • Career Advancement: We invest in your continuous evolution through dedicated training opportunities and an Education Assistance program.
  • Beyond the Office: Access confidential, professional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and enjoy unique industry perks like title and closing reimbursement discounts for your own real estate milestones.

Land Title is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, ethnicity, genetic information, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

title: Director Transformation Office
description:
Location Address:

9521 San Mateo NE
Albuquerque, NM 87113-2237


Summary:

Presbyterian Healthcare Services (PHS) seeks an experienced, highly influential, and execution-focused leader to serve as its next Director, Transformation Office. This enterprise leadership role sits at the center of Presbyterian's strategic transformation agenda and serves as a critical partner to executive leadership in driving organizational performance, accountability, and sustainable change.

As healthcare organizations face increasing pressure to improve affordability, operational performance, access, workforce effectiveness, and consumer experience, Presbyterian has established a Transformation Office designed to accelerate strategic priorities and ensure initiatives deliver measurable value. The Director serves as the operational leader of this function, ensuring transformation efforts are governed effectively, executed consistently, and translated into quantifiable operational and financial outcomes.

Reporting to the Vice President of Transformation, this role functions as the primary extension of Transformation Office leadership and serves as a trusted advisor to executive sponsors, workstream leaders, finance partners, and operational stakeholders. The Director creates the discipline, transparency, governance, and accountability necessary to ensure transformation initiatives achieve intended outcomes.

This is an ideal opportunity for a leader who thrives in complex environments, excels at bringing structure and accountability to large-scale initiatives, and can influence leaders across a matrixed organization without direct authority.

Work Arrangement
• Remote: Open to applicants residing in the United States, excluding Illinois, North Dakota, New York, Ohio, Washington, and Wyoming.
• Hybrid (Strongly Preferred): For candidates residing within 60 miles of Albuquerque, New Mexico, in-office presence is expected Tuesday through Thursday.

Job Description:

Transformation Governance & Workstream Enablement

  • Lead the weekly Transformation Office governance process and operating cadence.
  • Facilitate weekly meetings with workstream leaders to assess initiative progress, identify risks, remove barriers, and accelerate execution.
  • Ensure initiatives progress effectively through stage-gate governance requirements and organizational approval processes.
  • Proactively identify escalation needs and engage executive leadership when intervention is required.
  • Drive accountability and reinforce transformation standards, methodologies, decision-making routines, and performance expectations.
  • Monitor initiative health and ensure transformation efforts remain aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Help workstream leaders develop sustainable operating practices and become increasingly self-sufficient over time.

Portfolio & Initiative Management

  • Maintain enterprise-wide visibility into the transformation initiative pipeline, including status, stage, value creation, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with initiative sponsors and leaders to accelerate progress and address execution challenges.
  • Ensure initiatives remain aligned with organizational objectives and transformation priorities.
  • Facilitate enterprise portfolio reviews and strategic initiative assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to improve execution effectiveness and organizational performance.

Workstream Development & Capability Building

  • Strengthen the maturity and effectiveness of transformation workstreams across the organization.
  • Coach leaders on governance, initiative planning, structured problem-solving, change leadership, performance management, and value realization.
  • Develop tools, frameworks, and methodologies that support sustainable transformation outcomes.
  • Establish consistent operating models, governance structures, and transformation practices.
  • Build organizational capability so leaders can independently manage initiatives with greater effectiveness and discipline.

KPI Development & Performance Management

  • Partner with workstream leaders to establish meaningful KPIs, success measures, and performance targets.
  • Collaborate with Analytics teams to develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting tools.
  • Ensure initiatives have clear accountability structures and measurable outcome targets.
  • Monitor progress toward operational and financial objectives.
  • Drive adoption of performance management disciplines across the transformation portfolio.

Steering Committee & Executive Governance Support

  • Support workstream leaders in the development of Steering Committee (SteerCo) materials and executive presentations.
  • Assist teams in identifying strategic decisions, risks, escalation items, and discussion topics requiring executive attention.
  • Ensure governance forums focus on accountability, performance, value realization, and strategic alignment.
  • Help executive sponsors effectively communicate initiative progress and organizational impact.

Executive Reporting & Decision Support

  • Develop executive-level reporting, dashboards, presentations, and transformation updates.
  • Prepare materials for Transformation Office meetings, Senior Leadership Team reviews, executive governance forums, and CTO briefings.
  • Surface key decisions, risks, opportunities, dependencies, and performance issues requiring leadership attention.
  • Translate complex transformation activities into concise, executive-ready insights and recommendations.
  • Support executive decision-making through structured analysis and strategic guidance.

Cross-Workstream Integration

  • Identify dependencies, risks, and opportunities across transformation workstreams.
  • Develop scalable Transformation Office solutions that benefit multiple initiatives.
  • Facilitate collaboration between workstreams to solve common challenges and address enterprise barriers.
  • Promote consistency in governance, reporting, communication, performance management, and execution methodologies.

Transformation Communications

  • Partner with the Communications team to develop enterprise transformation messaging and communication strategies.
  • Create executive-ready communications, presentations, updates, organizational announcements, and transformation summaries.
  • Communicate priorities, accomplishments, risks, progress, and outcomes to stakeholders throughout the organization.
  • Support organizational alignment through clear, transparent, and consistent communication.

Transformation Tools, Processes & Systems

  • Continuously enhance Transformation Office methodologies, tools, templates, governance models, and operating standards.
  • Develop scalable processes that improve consistency and effectiveness across the transformation portfolio.
  • Ensure transformation systems support execution discipline while maintaining organizational agility.
  • Promote adoption of standardized transformation management approaches across the enterprise.

Value Realization & Impact Measurement

  • Partner with workstream sponsors and finance leaders to validate operational and financial impact.
  • Ensure anticipated benefits are measured, achieved, sustained, and communicated.
  • Track enterprise value creation resulting from transformation initiatives.
  • Develop KPI dashboards and benefit-realization reporting frameworks.
  • Drive accountability for committed outcomes and measurable organizational impact.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Transformation Office team members.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability standards.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and learning.
  • Build organizational capability in transformation management, governance, change leadership, and structured problem-solving.
  • Support succession planning and leadership development efforts.

Vice President Partnership & Representation

  • Serve as the primary operational partner and extension of the Vice President of Transformation.
  • Represent the Transformation Office in executive forums, governance meetings, workstreams, and strategic discussions.
  • Provide leadership continuity across transformation activities.
  • Support highly sensitive, high-priority, and confidential enterprise initiatives.

Success Measures

Within the first 12–24 months, the Director will be expected to:

  • Establish a highly effective governance and execution framework across enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Improve workstream maturity and increase self-sufficiency of workstream leaders.
  • Increase transparency, accountability, and executive visibility into initiative performance.
  • Improve the organization's ability to identify risks, remove barriers, and accelerate execution.
  • Strengthen KPI development, reporting, and outcome measurement across transformation initiatives.
  • Improve tracking and realization of operational and financial benefits.
  • Develop scalable tools, governance structures, and methodologies that strengthen organizational performance.
  • Build a highly effective Transformation Office team.
  • Increase enterprise adoption of transformation disciplines and performance management practices.
  • Accelerate measurable operational, financial, and strategic outcomes across the transformation portfolio.

Additional Job Description:

Education


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), Organizational Leadership, Finance, or a related discipline.

Experience


Required

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in:Business Transformation Enterprise Program Management Strategy Execution Organizational Effectiveness Healthcare Operations Management Consulting Performance Improvement
  • Experience leading large-scale, cross-functional transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success working with executive leaders and governance bodies.
  • Experience developing governance systems, portfolio management processes, performance tracking frameworks, and executive reporting.
  • Proven ability to drive measurable operational and financial outcomes.
  • Experience influencing leaders across a matrixed organization without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Healthcare delivery system, health plan, or integrated healthcare environment experience.
  • Consulting experience with organizations such as Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG, Huron, ECG, Kaufman Hall, McKinsey, Bain, or BCG.
  • Experience supporting enterprise transformation offices, PMOs, operational excellence functions, or strategy execution teams.
  • Experience leading cost transformation, operational improvement, or large-scale organizational change initiatives.

Preferred Certifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP)
  • Prosci Change Management Certification
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt
  • Program Management Professional (PgMP)
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM)

Benefits
Benefits are effective day-one (for .45 FTE and above) and include:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Full medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Free wellness programs
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Retirement plans, including matching employer contributions
  • Continuing education and career development opportunities
  • Life insurance and short/long term disability programs

About Us
Presbyterian Healthcare Services is a locally owned, not-for-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, it is the state's largest private employer with approximately 11,000 employees.

Presbyterian's story is really the story of the remarkable people who have chosen to work here. Starting with Reverend Cooper who began our journey in 1908, the hard work of thousands of physicians, employees, board members, and other volunteers brought Presbyterian from a tiny tuberculosis sanatorium to a statewide healthcare system, serving more than 700,000 New Mexicans.

We are part of New Mexico's history - and committed to its future. That is why we will continue to work just as hard and care just as deeply to serve New Mexico for years to come.

About New Mexico
New Mexico's unique blend of Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences contribute to a culturally rich lifestyle. Add in Albuquerque's International Balloon Fiesta, Los Alamos' nuclear scientists, Roswell's visitors from outer space, and Santa Fe's artists, and you get an eclectic mix of people, places and experiences that make this state great.

Cities in New Mexico are continually ranked among the nation's best places to work and live by Forbes magazine, Kiplinger's Personal Finance, and other corporate and government relocation managers like Worldwide ERC.

New Mexico offers endless recreational opportunities to explore, and enjoy an active lifestyle. Venture off the beaten path, challenge your body in the elements, or open yourself up to the expansive sky. From hiking, golfing and biking to skiing, snowboarding and boating, it's all available among our beautiful wonders of the west.

Prior Experience that Sets a Salesperson up for Success

  • 2-3 years of successful sales experience in a diverse retail environment, providing superior customer experiences

Physical Demands

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will predominantly be walking or standing. The employee is required to be able to talk and hear, and use hands and fingers to handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job, with or without reasonable accommodation. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is usually working inside; however, they will occasionally be outside and exposed to various weather conditions while performing such tasks as installing batteries and wiper blades. The Leasing Consultant will provide information pertaining to the apartment community, and attend to residents’ needs by displaying outstanding service which, in turn, will aid in retaining residents and promote a community atmosphere. This position will also assist the Property Administrator with administrative functions and duties. As a Leasing Consultant, you will be the first point of contact for prospective and current residents. Your role is vital in building lasting connections and promoting a sense of community.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Answer telephone calls and respond to prospective residents’ questions about lease terms and community features.
  • Tour the property and vacant apartments with prospective residents, while highlighting key benefits of living in the community.
  • Provide accurate information about rental rates, deposits, and lease terms in line with company policies.
  • Collect and process rental applications, deposits, and lease agreements while maintaining compliance with company standards.
  • Assist in promoting a positive community atmosphere by helping to retain current residents and responding promptly to their needs.
  • Prepare move-in packages, traffic reports, and availability updates to support smooth operations.
  • Handle maintenance requests with accuracy and ensure timely completion for residents.
  • Prepare notices, legal packages, and assist in community activities, newsletters, and resident engagement efforts.
  • Maintain resident files, reports, and inspection checklists with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Perform additional office and administrative duties as assigned by the Property Administrator and Regional Supervisor.
  • Use property management software to track tenant information, lease agreements, and financial transactions.
  • Assist with HUD Wait List management and accepting, updating and contacting Applicants for applications/status updates.
  • Assist with HUD and Tax Credit Move In Files and Mass Annual Recertification files including interviews and processing certifications with Applicants/Tenants.
  • Assist with HUD Interim Recertifications through year including interviews and processing of certifications with Tenants.
  • Assist with generating and verifying HUD/EIV-required Monthly and Income Reports.
  • Assist with obtaining verifications, other required documents and Tenant signatures for certifications in HUD-TRACS Software.
  • Assist with apartment inspections, including generating work orders for HUD and TCAC required program inspections.
  • Manage and update property records in digital systems to ensure accuracy and compliance.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack (Node.JS, Typescript, API, React)
description:
• We're transforming home lending with cloud-native engineering, quality and automation.
  • You have Staff-level expertise across TypeScript, Node.js, React, APIs and architecture.
  • Together we will build scalable technology that makes home ownership simpler and faster.

Do work that matters:

At Bankwest, we’re reimagining the home loan experience by building modern, scalable origination platforms that make the journey from application through approval and settlement simpler and faster. As a Staff Software Engineer, Full Stack, you’ll work across the full engineering lifecycle, staying close to customers, understanding real pain points and turning complex lending challenges into intuitive digital experiences. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, helping shape technical direction and architecture while remaining hands-on in designing, building and evolving the platform.

This is a build-focused role with genuine end-to-end ownership, where you’ll influence architecture, accelerate delivery and raise engineering standards across our Home Loan Origination ecosystem. You’ll solve meaningful problems at scale, guide technical decisions across teams and help engineers navigate complexity without losing sight of the customer outcome. It’s an opportunity to lead through engineering, not just direction, creating technology that has a tangible impact on how customers achieve one of life’s biggest milestones: owning a home.

See yourself in our team:

The Home Loan Origination Chapter, within the wider Seamless Lending Crew, is transforming the technology behind one of the biggest moments in our customers’ lives, buying a home. We’re modernising our core home lending services, platforms and digital experiences to make the journey simpler, faster and more seamless for new and existing customers.

We’re building and scaling cloud-native home loan origination platforms, spanning digital applications, broker and lender workflows, credit and decisioning integrations, verification and document orchestration, and event-driven processing. Working with technologies including TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL, you’ll help shape the future of home lending and build technology that makes the Australian dream of home ownership easier to achieve.

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

  • Operate at Staff Engineer level, providing hands-on technical leadership across architecture, design, code and engineering standards.
  • Design scalable, modular, API-first and event-driven architectures, translating complex business workflows into production-ready solutions.
  • Bring strong TypeScript and Node.js full-stack expertise, including React, Next.js and NestJS.
  • Have deep PostgreSQL experience, including schema design, indexing, transactional performance and optimisation at scale.
  • Lead delivery end to end, from discovery and technical design through build, test, deployment, production ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Champion a build it, deploy it, run it, own it mindset, supported by DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing and secure-by-design engineering.
  • Balance speed, scalability, reliability and security, making pragmatic technical trade-offs while driving rapid concept-to-production delivery.
  • Influence engineers and teams through strong technical credibility, mentoring, architectural direction and modern engineering best practice.
  • Ideally bring experience in regulated financial services, home lending or mortgage origination, although this is highly regarded rather than essential.
  • Experience with AI agentic engineering and AI-powered orchestration using LangChain or similar frameworks are highly regarded.

Tech skills

We don't expect you to know everything, but experience in several of the following will set you up for success:

  • Front-End Engineering: React, Next.js, TypeScript.
  • Back-End Engineering: Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, Microservices.
  • Architecture & Solution Design: Enterprise architecture, scalable design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD).
  • Event-Driven Architecture: Kafka, event streaming, asynchronous messaging, pub/sub patterns.
  • Data Engineering & Databases: AWS Aurora and DynamoDB, MongoDB.
  • Cloud-Native Engineering: AWS services, serverless, containerised workloads.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, automated CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps practices.
  • Quality Engineering & Test Practices: TDD, BDD, Unit, Component, Integration, E2E, Contract Testing (Specmatic).
  • Source Code & Repository Strategy: GitHub workflows, branching strategies, Monorepo, TurboRepo.
  • AI & Agentic Development: GenAI, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex.
  • Observability & Reliability Engineering: Observe, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

description:
